meaning: 填充口的蓋子；填充蓋
sentences: The mechanic tightened the fillercap on the reservoir. 修理工旋緊了儲液槽上的填充蓋。
A missing fillercap left the bottle open to dust. 填充蓋遺失後，瓶子便敞開而容易進灰塵。

meaning: 特別用作頭帶的帶狀或窄條材料
sentences: She wore a velvet fillet around her hair. 她在頭髮上戴了一條天鵝絨髮帶。
The costume designer embroidered pearls onto the fillet. 戲服設計師在髮帶上繡了珍珠。

meaning: 替魚去骨取肉的人；魚片工
sentences: A skilled filleter removed the bones in seconds. 熟練的魚片工在幾秒內去除了魚骨。
The filleter sharpened the knife before cutting cod. 魚片工在切鱈魚前把刀磨利。

meaning: 正在把魚或肉切成薄片的；切片用的
sentences: His filleting knife made a clean cut through the fish. 他的剔魚刀俐落地切過魚身。
The filleting station stood beside the market stall. 切魚片的工作台設在市場攤位旁。

meaning: 像窄帶或細長片狀物的
sentences: A filletlike strip of paint marked the doorway. 一條窄帶狀的油漆痕標示著門口。
The sculpture has a filletlike band across its base. 這座雕塑底部有一道細長帶狀結構。

meaning: 製作槽口的刨子；槽口刨
sentences: The cabinetmaker selected a filletster for the narrow groove. 細木工選了一把槽口刨來製作窄槽。
A well-sharpened filletster cut the rabbet smoothly. 一把磨利的槽口刨順暢地刨出搭接槽。

meaning: 法語中的教子
sentences: In French, filleul means a godson. 在法語中，這個詞是教子的意思。
The baptism card called him her filleul. 受洗卡片稱他為她的教子。

meaning: 用於填充牙齒空腔的任何材料或使用此類材料的結果。
sentences: I will be using a rapid-setting cement filling. 我將使用速凝水泥填充物。
My temporary filling fell out and got lost. 我的臨時填充物掉落並丟失了。

meaning: 以填滿的方式；充分地
sentences: The thick soup spread fillingly through the bowl. 濃湯充分地鋪滿了碗底。
He answered fillingly, leaving no important point out. 他回答得很完整，沒有漏掉重要事項。

meaning: 令人有飽足感的特質；填滿的程度
sentences: The fillingness of beans makes a small meal satisfying. 豆類的飽足感能讓簡單的一餐令人滿足。
Chefs compare the fillingness of different grains. 廚師比較不同穀物帶來的飽足程度。

meaning: 小小的刺激或提振；一彈指
sentences: The award gave the young artist a welcome fillip. 這個獎項給了年輕藝術家一股可喜的提振。
A short walk provided a fillip before the afternoon meeting. 短暫散步為下午會議前帶來一點精神振奮。

meaning: 雙仁果實遊戲；雙仁果實或其約定的贈禮
sentences: The family described their almond game as fillipeen. 這家人把他們的杏仁遊戲稱為雙仁果遊戲。
Finding a twin-kernel nut started a fillipeen between the friends. 找到雙仁果實讓兩位朋友開始了這項約定遊戲。

meaning: 可調式槽口刨；窗扇桿外緣的槽口
sentences: The carpenter used a fillister to cut the window rabbet. 木匠用槽口刨削出窗框的搭接槽。
A traditional fillister rests among the hand tools. 一把傳統槽口刨放在手工具之間。

meaning: 製造甜菜糖時使用的糖膏
sentences: The sugar worker stirred fillmass in the copper pan. 製糖工人在銅鍋裡攪拌糖膏。
Crystals formed as the hot fillmass cooled. 熱糖膏冷卻時形成了晶體。

meaning: 輕浮放蕩的女孩（舊式用語）
sentences: The old ballad calls its mischievous heroine a fillock. 那首古老民謠把淘氣的女主角稱為輕浮女孩。
Readers may meet fillock in dated Scottish writing. 讀者可能在過時的蘇格蘭文獻中遇到這個詞。

meaning: 一種含錳、鐵、鈉等元素的含水磷酸鹽礦物
sentences: The geologist identified fillowite in the granite pegmatite. 地質學家在花崗偉晶岩中辨認出這種磷酸鹽礦物。
Brown fillowite lined a cavity in the rock. 棕色的這種礦物覆在岩石的空洞內壁。

meaning: 一個年輕、有魅力的女人。
sentences: Hey, Homer, get a load of the gams on that filly! 嘿，荷馬，讓那匹母馬盡情玩耍吧！
The term filly refers to a young, attractive woman. 「小雌馬」一詞指的是年輕、有魅力的女性。

meaning: 電影，薄膜，膠捲
sentences: What is your favorite film of all time? 你最喜歡的電影是哪一部？
The surface of the pond was covered with a thin film of oil. 池塘表面覆蓋著薄薄的一層油。

meaning: 適合拍攝或改編成電影的
sentences: The vivid memoir seemed highly filmable. 這本生動的回憶錄似乎很適合拍成電影。
A filmable script needs clear scenes and strong action. 適合拍攝的劇本需要清楚的場景與有力的動作。

meaning: 電影界；電影業
sentences: She became a familiar name in filmdom. 她成了電影界熟悉的名字。
Changes in filmdom often follow new viewing habits. 電影業的變化常跟隨新的觀影習慣。

meaning: 短小的電影或影片
sentences: The festival screened a filmet before the main feature. 影展在主片前放映了一部短片。
A student uploaded her first filmet to the library archive. 一名學生把自己的第一部短片上傳到圖書館檔案庫。

meaning: 常看電影的人
sentences: Every filmgoer recognized the director's signature style. 每位影迷都認出了導演的招牌風格。
The theater offered discounts to loyal filmgoers. 那家戲院給忠實影迷提供折扣。

meaning: 與看電影或電影觀眾有關的
sentences: Filmgoing habits changed after home streaming became common. 家庭串流普及後，看電影的習慣改變了。
The magazine studied filmgoing audiences across the city. 這本雜誌研究了全市的電影觀眾。

meaning: 電影的、與電影有關的或像電影的
sentences: The director gave the landscape a dreamy filmic quality. 導演讓風景帶有夢幻的電影質感。
Her photographs use filmic shadows and bold framing. 她的照片運用電影般的陰影與大膽構圖。

meaning: 呈薄膜形的；以薄膜形式存在的
sentences: A filmiform coating covered the metal surface. 一層薄膜狀塗層覆蓋了金屬表面。
The plant leaf had a delicate filmiform layer. 植物葉片有一層細薄的膜狀結構。

meaning: 以電影的方式
sentences: Writers use filmily to mean in a filmy manner. 作家們用「以電影的方式」來表示「以電影的方式」。
She acted filmily when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她就會表現得像電影一樣。

meaning: 薄膜般的質地或狀態；朦朧薄紗感
sentences: The filminess of the glaze let the blue paint show through. 釉料的薄膜質感讓藍色顏料透了出來。
Morning mist had a soft filminess over the lake. 晨霧在湖面覆上一層柔和的薄紗感。

meaning: 帶有電影風格的；有薄膜般質地的
sentences: The music video has a stylishly filmish mood. 這支音樂錄影帶有時髦的電影風格。
A filmish layer formed on the cooling broth. 冷卻中的高湯表面形成了一層薄膜。

meaning: 電影製作者；電影工作者
sentences: The young filmist carried a camera through the village. 年輕的電影工作者帶著攝影機穿過村莊。
A veteran filmist spoke about silent movies. 一位資深電影工作者談起了默片。

meaning: 把作品改編成電影；使電影化
sentences: The studio plans to filmize the popular novel. 製片公司打算把那部暢銷小說改編成電影。
Directors often filmize stories with visual settings. 導演常把有鮮明場景的故事拍成電影。

meaning: 電影界；電影世界
sentences: The singer entered filmland after one successful role. 那位歌手演出一個成功角色後進入了電影界。
Rumors moved quickly through filmland. 謠言很快就在電影圈傳開。

meaning: 像薄膜的；薄而半透明的
sentences: A filmlike skin appeared on the warm milk. 溫牛奶表面出現了一層薄膜。
The artist painted a filmlike veil over the scene. 藝術家在畫面上畫了一層薄膜般的薄霧。

meaning: 成膜物質；能形成薄膜的物質
sentences: The coating contains a filmogen that binds the pigment. 這種塗層含有能黏住顏料的成膜物質。
Chemists tested the filmogen on a glass plate. 化學家在玻璃片上測試了這種成膜物質。

meaning: 用於投影的照相透明膠片
sentences: The curator placed a filmslide in the slide viewer. 策展人把一張投影膠片放進幻燈片閱覽器。
A faded filmslide showed the museum before renovation. 一張褪色的投影膠片展示了博物館整修前的樣子。

meaning: 含有一系列影像、用來逐格投影的膠片
sentences: The children watched a filmstrip about ocean life. 孩子們觀看了一卷介紹海洋生物的連環膠片。
Each frame on the filmstrip showed a different step. 那卷膠片的每格都展示不同步驟。

meaning: 薄紗般的；薄而半透明的
sentences: A filmy curtain softened the afternoon light. 薄紗窗簾柔化了午後陽光。
The soup developed a filmy layer as it cooled. 湯冷卻後形成了一層薄膜。

meaning: 用極薄麵皮分層製成的酥皮；這種麵皮
sentences: The baker layered filo with spinach and cheese. 麵包師把極薄酥皮與菠菜、起司分層疊放。
Crisp filo covered the sweet nut filling. 香脆的酥皮覆在甜美的堅果餡上。

meaning: 具有絲羽的；像絲羽的
sentences: The filoplumaceous feather was barely visible on the bird. 那根絲羽在鳥身上幾乎看不見。
Ornithologists compared the filoplumaceous down with ordinary feathers. 鳥類學家比較了絲羽狀絨羽與普通羽毛。

meaning: 絲羽；細長羽軸上只有少數羽枝的羽毛
sentences: A filoplume rose beside the bird's contour feathers. 一根絲羽從鳥的輪廓羽旁伸出。
The researcher examined the filoplume under gentle light. 研究人員在柔和光線下檢查那根絲羽。

meaning: 細長的絲狀偽足，例如神經細胞或血小板的突起
sentences: A growing neuron extended a filopodium toward its neighbor. 正在生長的神經元向鄰近細胞伸出絲狀偽足。
Under the microscope, each filopodium touched the surface. 在顯微鏡下，每個絲狀偽足都碰觸著表面。

meaning: 絲狀的；細如絲的
sentences: The filose roots spread through the wet soil. 細絲狀的根在濕土中延展。
A filose growth hung from the pond plant. 一縷絲狀生長物掛在池塘植物上。

meaning: 刺繡用的柔軟絲線
sentences: The embroiderer chose blue filoselle for the flowers. 刺繡師選用藍色軟絲線來繡花。
Gold thread was mixed with filoselle in the border. 金線與軟絲線混用在邊框上。

meaning: 接在姓氏後表示兒子、用來區分父子的稱呼
sentences: The younger man was listed as Martin fils. 名冊把年輕的男子列為馬丁之子。
Historians added fils after the surname to avoid confusion. 歷史學家在姓氏後加上表示兒子的稱呼以免混淆。

meaning: 過濾、過濾器
sentences: The water needs to be filtered to remove impurities before it is safe to drink. 水需要過濾以去除雜質，然後才能安全飲用。
Sunlight filtered through the thick leaves of the trees in the forest. 陽光透過樹林茂密的葉子過濾（滲）了下來。

meaning: 可被過濾的性質或狀態
sentences: The lab measured the filterability of the muddy water. 實驗室測量了泥水的可過濾性。
Particle size strongly affects filterability. 顆粒大小會大幅影響可過濾性。

meaning: 能被過濾或通過濾器的
sentences: The liquid is filterable through ordinary paper. 這種液體可以用普通濾紙過濾。
Only filterable particles passed through the mesh. 只有可通過過濾的顆粒穿過了網孔。

meaning: 可被過濾的性質或程度
sentences: Engineers tested the filterableness of the recycled oil. 工程師測試了回收油的可過濾程度。
Higher filterableness makes the process faster. 較高的可過濾性會讓流程更快。

meaning: 操作過濾流程的工人；過濾工
sentences: The filterer checked the press before the morning shift. 過濾工在早班前檢查了壓濾機。
A skilled filterer can spot a blocked screen quickly. 熟練的過濾工能迅速發現堵塞的濾網。

meaning: 用來分離懸浮物的多孔材料或過濾作用
sentences: The filtering removed sand from the drinking water. 過濾作用去除了飲用水中的砂粒。
Fine filtering keeps dust out of the machine. 細密過濾能防止灰塵進入機器。

meaning: 負責操作過濾流程的工人；過濾工
sentences: The filterman replaced the cloth on the press. 過濾工更換了壓濾機上的濾布。
A filterman monitored the tanks throughout the night. 一名過濾工整晚監看那些槽罐。

meaning: 污垢；污物；弄髒或玷污的東西。
sentences: Before we start cooking we need to clean up the filth in this kitchen. 在我們開始做飯之前，我們需要清理廚房裡的污物。
The term filth refers to dirt; foul matter; that which soils or defiles. 污穢一詞指的是污垢；污物；弄髒或玷污的東西。

meaning: 使變髒；使沾滿污穢
sentences: Oil spills can filthify the shore within hours. 漏油可能在幾小時內弄髒海岸。
Careless dumping will filthify the stream. 隨意傾倒垃圾會污染溪流。

meaning: 以骯髒的方式
sentences: Writers use filthily to mean in a filthy manner. 作家們用 以骯髒的方式 來表示以骯髒的方式。
She acted filthily when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她就會做出骯髒的行為。

meaning: 骯髒或污穢的狀態
sentences: The inspector was shocked by the kitchen's filthiness. 檢查員對廚房的骯髒程度感到震驚。
Regular cleaning prevents filthiness in crowded shelters. 定期清潔能防止擁擠收容所變得污穢。

meaning: 沒有污穢的；乾淨的
sentences: The mountain spring looked filthless and clear. 山泉看起來乾淨又清澈。
She kept the small clinic filthless through careful cleaning. 她透過仔細清潔讓小診所保持乾淨。

meaning: 沾滿污穢的；非常髒的
sentences: Mud left his boots filthy after the hike. 健行後，泥巴讓他的靴子沾滿污垢。
The filthy alley needed immediate cleaning. 那條骯髒的小巷需要立刻清理。

meaning: 可被過濾的性質或程度
sentences: Researchers compared the filtrability of three oils. 研究人員比較了三種油的可過濾性。
Temperature can change filtrability during processing. 加工時，溫度可能改變可過濾性。

meaning: 能被過濾或通過濾器的
sentences: The cloudy mixture became filtrable after settling. 混濁混合物沉澱後變得可以過濾。
Filtrable liquid passed through the cotton plug. 可過濾的液體穿過了棉塞。

meaning: 能夠被過濾的
sentences: The chemist found the suspension filtratable by gravity. 化學家發現這種懸浮液可用重力過濾。
A filtratable mixture is easier to clarify. 可過濾的混合物較容易澄清。

meaning: 通過濾器後得到的液體
sentences: The clear filtrate collected in a glass flask. 澄清的濾液收集在玻璃燒瓶中。
Chemists tested the filtrate for dissolved salts. 化學家檢測濾液中的溶解鹽類。

meaning: 過濾的行為或過程；將液體與漂浮在其中的不溶解顆粒進行機械分離。
sentences: The term filtration refers to the act or process of filtering; the mechanical separation of a liquid from the undissolved particles floating in it. 術語「過濾」是指過濾的行為或過程；將液體與漂浮在其中的未溶解顆粒進行機械分離。
The lesson introduced filtration as a useful term to understand. 本課程介紹了過濾這個易於理解的有用術語。

meaning: 雄性大麻植株；這種植株的纖維
sentences: The farmer removed fimble plants before they shed pollen. 農夫在雄性大麻植株散播花粉前將它們拔除。
Historically, fimble fiber was used for rough cordage. 歷史上，這種植株的纖維曾用來製作粗繩。

meaning: 邊緣或細緣，尤其是輸卵管末端的傘狀突起
sentences: The surgeon examined a fimbria at the end of the tube. 外科醫師檢查了管末端的一個傘狀突起。
Each fimbria helps guide the egg toward the opening. 每個傘狀突起都有助於引導卵子朝向開口。

meaning: 菌毛的；與細緣或傘狀突起有關的
sentences: The fimbrial surface was covered with tiny points. 那個菌毛表面覆滿微小突起。
Doctors examined the fimbrial end of the tube. 醫生檢查了輸卵管的傘狀末端。

meaning: 邊緣有細絲或流蘇狀突起的
sentences: The fimbriate leaf had a delicate fringe. 那片邊緣有細絲的葉子帶著精緻流蘇。
A fimbriate petal framed the yellow center. 一片流蘇邊花瓣環繞著黃色花心。

meaning: 邊緣有細絲或流蘇狀突起的
sentences: The fimbriated wing showed fine marginal hairs. 那片有細緣的翅膀露出細小邊毛。
A fimbriated membrane bordered the opening. 一層有細絲邊緣的膜環繞著開口。

meaning: 細緣或流蘇狀邊緣；形成細緣的狀態
sentences: The leaf's fimbriation was visible under the glass. 玻璃下可看見葉子的細緣。
Scientists measured the fimbriation along the tissue edge. 科學家測量了組織邊緣的細絲狀結構。

meaning: 拉丁文中表示「有流蘇狀邊緣」的中性形容詞形式
sentences: In a species name, fimbriatum describes a fringed structure. 在物種名稱中，這個拉丁形容詞描述有流蘇狀邊緣的結構。
The label uses fimbriatum for a neuter botanical name. 標籤在中性植物名稱中使用這個拉丁形式。

meaning: 邊緣呈細絲狀或流蘇狀的
sentences: The fimbricate bracts surrounded the flower head. 細絲狀苞片環繞著花序。
A fimbricate margin gave the leaf a feathery look. 細緣讓葉片看起來像羽毛。

meaning: 邊緣有細絲狀或流蘇狀突起的
sentences: The fimbricated tissue had many slender points. 那片有細緣的組織帶有許多細長突起。
A fimbricated petal edged the bright blossom. 一片流蘇邊花瓣圍住了鮮豔花朵。

meaning: （植物學）花托上的細絲狀附屬物；小繸毛
sentences: Fimbrilla is a tiny threadlike appendage on some flower heads. 某些花序上的這種構造是細小的絲狀附屬物。
A plant researcher noted one fimbrilla beside the flower head. 一名植物研究者在花序旁記下了一根小繸毛。

meaning: 邊緣有細小流蘇狀突起的
sentences: Fimbrillate leaves have a narrow fringe along their edges. 這種葉片邊緣有一圈細小的流蘇狀突起。
The flower's fimbrillate rim looked soft under the glass. 那朵花的細流蘇狀邊緣在玻璃下看來很柔細。

meaning: 帶有小繸毛或細小流蘇狀突起的
sentences: Fimbrilliferous bracts bear many minute fringe-like processes. 這種苞片帶有許多細小的流蘇狀突起。
The plant's fimbrilliferous receptacle was easiest to see after flowering. 這株植物帶小繸毛的花托在開花後最容易看清。

meaning: 邊緣有細小流蘇狀突起的
sentences: Fimbrillose petals carry a delicate fringe at the margin. 這種花瓣邊緣帶有細緻的流蘇狀突起。
An illustrator marked the fimbrillose edge with tiny strokes. 一名插畫家用細小筆觸標出那道細流蘇狀邊緣。

meaning: 邊緣有細毛狀齒突的
sentences: Fimbriodentate scales have fringed, toothlike edges. 這種鱗片的邊緣有細毛狀齒突。
The plant researcher described the leaf margin as fimbriodentate. 植物研究者把葉緣描述為細毛齒狀。

meaning: 生長在糞便上或其中的
sentences: Fimetarious fungi grow on or among animal dung. 這種真菌會在動物糞便上或其中生長。
A dung pile supported several fimetarious mushrooms. 一堆糞便養育了幾朵糞生蘑菇。

meaning: 棲息或生長在糞便上的
sentences: Fimicolous insects feed and breed on dung. 這種昆蟲以糞便為食並在其上繁殖。
The beetle's fimicolous habit helps recycle waste in pasture. 這種甲蟲的糞生習性有助於分解牧地上的廢物。

meaning: 鰭、魚翅
sentences: The shark's sharp dorsal fin could be seen clearly above the water. 鯊魚尖銳的背鰭可以清晰地在水面上看到。
The diver watched as the large fish moved its fins and swam away. 潛水員看著那條大魚擺動魚鰭游走了。

meaning: 須繳納罰款的；可處以罰款的
sentences: Finable offenses include parking in a restricted area. 可處罰款的違規行為包括停在限制區域。
The ordinance lists which actions are finable. 那項條例列出哪些行為可處以罰款。

meaning: 可處以罰款的性質
sentences: Finableness depends on the wording of the local rule. 是否可處罰款取決於地方規則的措辭。
A lawyer questioned the finableness of the minor breach. 一名律師質疑那項輕微違規是否可罰款。

meaning: 透過間接或涉及的方式獲得（某物）。如何使用 fingle 造句
sentences: Older manuals use finagle to mean to obtain (something) by indirect or involved means. How to use finagle in a sentence. 較舊的手冊使用 透過間接或涉及的方式獲得 來表示透過間接或涉及手段來獲得（某物）。如何在句子中使用 透過間接或涉及的方式獲得。
In practice, people finagle when that action is required. 實際上，當需要採取這種行動時，人們會進行欺騙。

meaning: 耍手段的人；騙子
sentences: Finagler describes someone who gets what they want by trickery. 這個詞指靠耍手段取得所求的人。
The clever finagler talked his way past the locked gate. 那名狡猾的騙子靠花言巧語通過了上鎖的門。

meaning: 最終的
sentences: The final decision on the project will be made at tomorrow's meeting. 專案的最終決定將在明天的會議上做出。
I'm currently studying hard for my final English exam next week. 我目前正為下週的期末英文考試努力唸書。

meaning: 某事的盛大結局，尤其是一場演出或一首音樂的盛大結局。
sentences: The term finale refers to the grand end of something, especially of a show or piece of music. 結局一詞指的是某件事的盛大結局，尤其是一場表演或一首音樂。
The lesson introduced finale as a useful term to understand. 本課介紹了結局作為一個易於理解的有用術語。

meaning: 認為事物由最終目的或目的因支配的學說；目的論
sentences: Finalism explains natural events through their supposed purposes. 這種學說以假定的目的解釋自然事件。
The philosopher compared finalism with a purely mechanical view of nature. 那位哲學家把目的論與純機械式的自然觀相比。

meaning: 正在學習最後一年的大學生；一名高級。
sentences: The term finalist refers to a university student in their final year of study; a senior. 「決賽入圍者」一詞是指處於最後一年學習的大學生；一位前輩。
The lesson introduced finalist as a useful term to understand. 本課程介紹了決賽入圍者作為一個易於理解的有用術語。

meaning: 定案而不可更改的狀態；終局性
sentences: Finality means that a decision is settled and cannot be reversed. 這表示決定已定案且無法撤回。
The signed order gave the sale a sense of finality. 簽署的命令讓這場出售帶有塵埃落定的感覺。

meaning: 使最終的或確定的；完成或完成。
sentences: As soon as we get the plane tickets, we'll finalize our reservations with the hotel. 拿到機票後，我們就和飯店確定預訂。
People often finalize when the situation calls for it. 人們通常會在情況需要時做出最終決定。

meaning: 最後
sentences: After hours of discussion, they finally reached an agreement. 經過數小時的討論，他們終於達成了協議。
We finally arrived at our destination after a long journey. 經過長途跋涉，我們終於到達了目的地。

meaning: 金融
sentences: The government is taking steps to stimulate international finance. 政府正採取措施刺激國際金融。
Starting your own business requires a significant amount of finance. 創業需要大量的資金（金融）。

meaning: 金融的
sentences: The company reported a significant increase in financial profit now. 公司現在報告其財務（金融的）利潤大幅增加。
He works as a senior financial advisor at an international firm. 他在一家國際公司擔任高級財務顧問。

meaning: 金融家；精通金融的人
sentences: Financialist refers to a person skilled in finance or banking. 這個詞指精通金融或銀行業的人。
The financialist advised the family to spread its investments. 那位金融家建議這家人分散投資。

meaning: 在財務或金錢方面。
sentences: He helped his daughter out financially, paying her rent and utilities, until she recovered from the accident. 他在經濟上幫助女兒擺脫困境，支付她的房租和水電費，直到她從事故中康復。
If someone acts financially, they do so in a way that is in terms of finance or money. 如果某人在財務上採取行動，他們會以財務或金錢的方式這樣做。

meaning: 一名負責財務管理；管理公共收入的官員；財務主管。
sentences: The term financier refers to one charged with the administration of finance; an officer who administers the public revenue; a treasurer. 金融家一詞是指負責財務管理的人；管理公共收入的官員；財務主管。
The lesson introduced financier as a useful term to understand. 本課介紹了金融家這個術語，這是一個需要理解的有用術語。

meaning: 金融家；管理資金的人（古語）
sentences: Financiery is an old word for a financier or money manager. 這是金融家或資金管理者的古語。
The financiery advised the crown on a costly loan. 那名金融家為王室提供昂貴貸款的建議。

meaning: 金融家；金融專業人士
sentences: Financist denotes a person who manages or studies finance. 這個詞指管理或研究金融的人。
The financist weighed the loan against the expected income. 那位金融家把貸款與預期收入仔細權衡。

meaning: 長鬚鯨
sentences: Finback is another name for the fin whale. 這是長鬚鯨的另一個名稱。
A finback surfaced beside the research boat. 一頭長鬚鯨在研究船旁浮出水面。

meaning: 任何歐亞金翅雀（Caruelis carduelis 種，同義詞 Fringilla carduelis）。
sentences: The term finch refers to any Eurasian goldfinch (of species Carduelis carduelis, syn. Fringilla carduelis). 雀科一詞是指任何歐亞金翅雀（屬於 Carduelis carduelis 種，同義詞 Fringilla carduelis）。
The lesson introduced finch as a useful term to understand. 本課介紹了芬奇這個術語，這是一個需要理解的有用術語。

meaning: （指牛）背部有條紋或斑點的
sentences: Finchbacked cattle have streaks or spots along the back. 這種牛的背部有條紋或斑點。
The farmer chose a finchbacked heifer for the local show. 農夫挑了一頭背部有斑紋的小母牛參加地方展覽。

meaning: （指牛）背部有白色條紋或斑點的
sentences: Finched cattle show a pale stripe or spots on the back. 這種牛的背部有淡色條紋或斑點。
The finched bull stood out among the dark animals. 那頭背有白紋的公牛在深色牛群中很醒目。

meaning: 誘捕雀鳥的設施；捕雀圍欄
sentences: Finchery means a structure where finches are lured into a net. 這個詞指把雀鳥誘入網中的設施。
The abandoned finchery stood beside the hedge. 那座廢棄的捕雀圍欄立在樹籬旁。

meaning: 尋找
sentences: I can't find my keys anywhere; have you seen them? 我到處找不到我的鑰匙，你看到了嗎？
It's difficult to find a good parking space in the city center. 在市中心很難找到好的停車位。

meaning: 容易被找到的程度；可尋找性
sentences: Findability measures how easily people can locate information. 這個概念衡量人們找到資訊的難易度。
Clear labels improved the findability of the clinic's services. 清楚的標籤提升了診所服務的可尋找性。

meaning: 找得到的；容易尋獲的
sentences: Findable means able to be located or discovered. 這表示能被找到或發現。
The address is findable on the town map. 那個地址在城鎮地圖上找得到。

meaning: 發明；裝置（古語）
sentences: Findal is an old word for an invention or device. 這是指發明或裝置的古詞。
The craftsman praised the findal that lifted the heavy stone. 工匠稱讚那個抬起重石的裝置。

meaning: 發現或發現某事的人；發現者。
sentences: Finders keepers, losers weepers. 勝利者守門，失敗者哭泣。
The term finder refers to one who finds or discovers something; a discoverer. 發現者一詞指發現或發現某物的人；一個發現者。

meaning: 進行不利的批評。如何用找錯造句
sentences: Older manuals use findfault to mean to criticize unfavorably. How to use find fault in a sentence. 較舊的手冊使用 進行不利的批評。如何用找錯造句 來表示不利的批評。如何在句子中使用「查找錯誤」。
In practice, people findfault when that action is required. 實際上，當需要採取行動時，人們就會挑剔。

meaning: 調查或研究得到的發現；結論
sentences: Finding can mean a discovery reached through careful inquiry. 這個詞可以指經過仔細調查得到的發現。
The key finding linked clean water with better health. 關鍵發現指出乾淨的水與較佳健康狀況有關。

meaning: 阿拉伯咖啡壺；細口咖啡壺
sentences: Findjan is an alternative spelling of finjan, a small coffee pot. 這是一種小型咖啡壺的異拼。
The host poured cardamom coffee from a brass findjan. 主人從黃銅咖啡壺倒出豆蔻咖啡。

meaning: 美好的
sentences: The weather is fine today, so let's go for a picnic. 今天天氣很好，我們去野餐吧。
He had to pay a heavy fine for speeding on the highway. 他因為在高速公路上超速而不得不支付一筆鉅額罰款。

meaning: 須繳納罰款的；可處以罰款的
sentences: Fineable is a spelling variant of finable. 這是另一個拼寫變體。
The notice explains which parking violations are fineable. 那張通知說明哪些停車違規可處以罰款。

meaning: 細彎草；細葉翦股穎屬的草
sentences: Finebent is a fine-leaved bent grass, especially Rhode Island bent. 這是一種細葉翦股穎屬草，尤其指羅德島翦股穎。
Finebent covered the dry pasture with a short green mat. 細彎草在乾燥牧地上形成一層低矮的綠毯。

meaning: 略微精細的；有點纖細的
sentences: Fineish means somewhat delicate or refined, but not extremely so. 這表示有些精細或雅緻，但不至於非常精緻。
The fineish thread was suitable for a light scarf. 那條略細的線適合織輕薄的圍巾。

meaning: 細葉植物的俗稱；葉片細長的植物
sentences: Fineleaf is a common name for a plant with slender leaves. 這是葉片細長植物的俗稱。
The gardener planted fineleaf beside the broad-leaved shrubs. 園丁把細葉植物種在闊葉灌木旁。

meaning: 無盡的；沒有界限的
sentences: Fineless describes something without an end or limit. 這形容沒有終點或界限的事物。
The poem imagines a fineless road beneath the stars. 那首詩想像一條星空下無盡的道路。

meaning: 從而產生細膩的質感；切成小、薄或精緻的碎片。
sentences: Fledglings can only be fed finely chopped meat. 雛鳥只能餵切碎的肉。
If someone acts finely, they do so in a way that is so as to produce a fine texture; into small, thin, or delicate pieces. 如果一個人的行為很好，那麼他的行為方式就是為了產生良好的質感；切成小、薄或精緻的碎片。

meaning: 罰款；罰金（古語）
sentences: Finement is an old word for a monetary penalty. 這是指金錢刑罰的古詞。
The charter imposed a finement for damaging the bridge. 那份特許狀規定損壞橋梁須繳罰金。

meaning: 精細或精美的程度；純度
sentences: Fineness describes delicacy, excellence, or purity in something. 這可指事物的精細、優良或純度。
The fineness of the silver was stamped on the coin. 銀幣上刻有銀的純度。

meaning: 精煉或純化的人；精煉工
sentences: Finer is a person who purifies metal or another substance. 這指純化金屬或其他物質的人。
The finer removed the dross from the molten silver. 那名精煉工從熔化的銀中去除雜質。

meaning: 華服與珠寶等裝飾品；華麗服飾
sentences: Finery means elegant clothing, jewelry, or other decoration. 這指華麗服裝、珠寶或其他裝飾品。
She wore her finest finery to the evening banquet. 她穿上最華麗的服飾參加晚宴。

meaning: 極其細緻或精心構思的；過分細微的
sentences: Finespun describes ideas or materials made with extreme delicacy. 這形容想法或材料極其細緻。
His finespun argument depended on a very small distinction. 他那套過分細密的論點依賴一個極小的差別。

meaning: 小心或熟練地處理或管理；以狡猾的方式操縱。
sentences: To finesse means to handle or manage carefully or skilfully; to manipulate in a crafty way. 技巧意味著小心或熟練地處理或管理；以狡猾的方式操縱。
People may finesse in different situations depending on the context. 人們可能會根據具體情況在不同的情況下採取策略。

meaning: 善於巧妙周旋或操弄局勢的人
sentences: Finesser means a person who handles matters with subtle skill. 這指善於用細膩技巧處理事情的人。
The finesser settled the dispute without insulting either side. 那名周旋高手化解了爭端，也沒有侮辱任何一方。

meaning: 用糖蜜等含糖物蒸餾出酒精
sentences: Finestill means to distill spirits from molasses or another sugary mixture. 這指從糖蜜或其他含糖混合物蒸餾酒精。
The distiller will finestill the fermented molasses tonight. 蒸餾工今晚會把發酵糖蜜再次蒸餾。

meaning: 用糖蜜等含糖物蒸餾酒精的人
sentences: Finestiller means a person who finestills spirits. 這指用糖蜜等物蒸餾酒精的人。
The finestiller checked the copper still before heating it. 那名蒸餾工加熱前檢查了銅製蒸餾器。

meaning: 細頂草；紅頂草的一種
sentences: Finetop is a name for a fine form of redtop grass. 這是一種細葉紅頂草的名稱。
Finetop stayed short on the dry, poor pasture. 細頂草在乾瘠牧地上維持低矮的高度。

meaning: 有鰭魚；非甲殼類或貝類的魚
sentences: Finfish means a fish with fins, distinguished from crustaceans and mollusks. 這指有鰭的魚，與甲殼類或貝類不同。
The market sells finfish beside its tanks of prawns. 市場在蝦類水槽旁販售有鰭魚。

meaning: 鰭足鷉；生活在水邊的涉水鳥
sentences: Finfoot is a waterbird with lobed toes and a broad bill. 這是一種腳趾具瓣膜、嘴寬的水鳥。
A finfoot slipped quietly through the reeds. 一隻鰭足鷉安靜地穿過蘆葦。

meaning: 能形成或塑造的；柔韌可塑的
sentences: Fingent describes something able to form or be shaped. 這形容能形成或被塑造的事物。
The artist found the warm clay fingent beneath her hands. 藝術家發現溫熱的黏土在手下柔韌可塑。

meaning: 手指
sentences: She wore a beautiful diamond ring on her finger. 她在手指上戴了一枚漂亮的鑽石戒指。
Be careful not to cut your finger with the sharp knife. 小心別被那把鋒利的刀割傷了手指。

meaning: 適合用手指觸摸或操作的
sentences: Fingerable describes something that can be touched or played with the fingers. 這形容能用手指觸摸或操作的事物。
The musician chose a fingerable melody for beginners. 那位音樂家為初學者選了一段容易用指法演奏的旋律。

meaning: 黑莓的別名
sentences: Fingerberry is an old common name for a blackberry. 這是黑莓的舊俗名。
The child picked a ripe fingerberry from the hedge. 孩子從樹籬上摘下一顆熟黑莓。

meaning: 以手指寬度為單位的長度；一指寬
sentences: Fingerbreadth is a length roughly equal to the width of a finger. 這是大約等於一根手指寬度的長度。
Add a fingerbreadth of water to the pot. 在鍋裡加一指寬的水。

meaning: 有手指或手指狀突起的；指狀分裂的
sentences: Fingered describes a part divided into fingerlike lobes or outgrowths. 這形容部分分成手指狀的裂片或突起。
The fingered leaf spread five narrow lobes around the stem. 那片指狀葉繞著莖展開五個狹長裂片。

meaning: 製作手套手指部分的人或機器
sentences: Fingerer means a person or machine that makes the fingers of gloves. 這指製作手套手指部分的人或機器。
The fingerer shaped each glove tip before stitching. 那台製指機在縫合前塑好每個手套指端。

meaning: 指魚；一種體深而側扁的銀色魚
sentences: Fingerfish is a small silvery fish with a deep, flattened body. 這是一種體深而側扁的銀色小魚。
A fingerfish hovered in the warm estuary water. 一條指魚懸游在溫暖的河口水中。

meaning: 毛地黃
sentences: Fingerflower is another name for the foxglove plant. 這是毛地黃的另一個名稱。
A tall fingerflower opened purple bells beside the path. 一株高大的毛地黃在小徑旁開出紫色鐘形花。

meaning: 供手指抓握或支撐的地方
sentences: Fingerhold means a small place where the fingers can grip or rest. 這指手指可以抓住或靠住的小地方。
The climber searched for a firm fingerhold in the rock. 攀岩者在岩石上尋找穩固的指扣點。

meaning: 把手指彎成鉤狀的抓法
sentences: Fingerhook is a grip made by bending a fingertip toward the palm. 這是把指尖朝掌心彎曲形成的抓法。
She used a fingerhook to lift the tiny ring. 她用鉤指法提起那枚小戒指。

meaning: 使用手指演奏樂器的特定方法。
sentences: That chord has two fingerings. 這個和弦有兩個指法。
The term fingering refers to A specific method of using the fingers to play an instrument. 指法一詞是指使用手指演奏樂器的特定方法。

meaning: 指葉植物；葉片分成手指狀裂片的植物
sentences: Fingerleaf is a plant name based on its handlike leaves. 這是因葉片像手掌而得名的植物名稱。
The fingerleaf vine spread narrow lobes over the dry ground. 指葉藤蔓在乾地上伸展出狹長裂片。

meaning: 沒有手指的；失去手指的
sentences: Fingerless means lacking fingers or having the fingers removed. 這表示沒有手指或手指已失去。
He wore fingerless gloves that left his fingertips free. 他戴著露出指尖的無指手套。

meaning: 小手指；小型指狀部分
sentences: Fingerlet means a small finger or fingerlike outgrowth. 這指小手指或小型指狀突起。
A fingerlet of new growth curled around the twig. 一小段指狀新芽纏住了細枝。

meaning: 像手指的；細長而具指狀的
sentences: Fingerlike describes a long, narrow shape resembling a finger. 這形容細長、像手指的形狀。
The cactus sent out fingerlike arms from its base. 那株仙人掌從基部長出手指狀枝條。

meaning: 小魚，尤其是一歲以下的魚
sentences: Fingerling means a young fish, often less than a year old. 這指幼魚，通常不到一歲。
The hatchery released fingerlings into the restored stream. 魚苗場把小魚放入修復後的溪流。

meaning: 手指甲
sentences: She painted her fingernails bright red. 她把指甲染成鮮紅色。
He has a habit of biting his fingernails when he is nervous. 他緊張時有咬指甲的習慣。

meaning: 分裂成手指狀裂片的；掌狀分裂的
sentences: Fingerparted describes a leaf divided into narrow fingerlike sections. 這形容葉片分成狹長的手指狀部分。
The fingerparted leaf cast a star-shaped shadow. 那片掌狀分裂的葉子投下星形影子。

meaning: 指紋；可辨識某物的獨特特徵
sentences: The glass still had his fingerprint on it. 玻璃杯上還留著他的指紋。
Every artist leaves a personal fingerprint on the work. 每位藝術家都會在作品中留下個人獨特風格。

meaning: 採集指紋以辨識身分的行為或程序
sentences: Fingerprinting is the process of recording fingerprints for identification. 這是為了辨識身分而記錄指紋的程序。
Fingerprinting confirmed that the two cards belonged to one person. 採集指紋確認兩張卡片屬於同一人。

meaning: 指薑；一種薑科植物
sentences: Fingerroot is a ginger plant with finger-shaped underground rhizomes. 這是一種地下根莖呈指狀的薑科植物。
The cook grated fingerroot into the spicy paste. 廚師把指薑磨入辛香醬裡。

meaning: 手藝靈巧的人；善於用手做事的人
sentences: Fingersmith means a person highly skilled with the hands. 這指雙手技巧非常高超的人。
The fingersmith repaired the tiny watch without scratching it. 那名手藝高手修好小手錶，沒有刮傷錶面。

meaning: 用手指使物體旋轉的技巧
sentences: Fingerspin is a trick that keeps an object rotating on a finger. 這是讓物體在手指上持續旋轉的技巧。
The performer balanced a spinning disk with a smooth fingerspin. 表演者用流暢的指旋讓圓盤保持平衡。

meaning: 保護手指的指套
sentences: Fingerstall means a covering worn to protect one finger. 這指用來保護單根手指的套子。
The seamstress wore a fingerstall to avoid needle pricks. 女裁縫戴著指套以免被針刺傷。

meaning: 箭石化石；形似箭頭或手指的化石
sentences: A fingerstone resembles a pointed finger or arrowhead. 一枚箭石化石像尖銳的手指或箭頭。
Collectors often find fingerstone in old seabed rock. 收藏家常在古老海床岩石中找到箭石化石。

meaning: 手指末端；指尖
sentences: Fingertip means the very end of a finger. 這指手指最末端的部分。
A drop of paint rested on her fingertip. 一滴顏料停在她的指尖上。

meaning: 用手指地；以手指寬度為單位地
sentences: Fingerwise means by using fingers to count or measure. 這表示用手指計數或測量。
The mason checked the gap fingerwise before adding mortar. 石匠用手指估量縫隙後才加上灰漿。

meaning: 手指的技巧性運用；指法
sentences: Fingerwork means skilled movement of the fingers, especially in music. 這指手指的熟練運動，尤其是音樂中的指法。
Her fast fingerwork made the difficult passage sound easy. 她快速的指法讓那段難曲聽來很簡單。

meaning: 具有手指狀分枝的；像手指的
sentences: Fingery describes a shape divided into several fingerlike branches. 這形容分成數個手指狀分枝的形狀。
The fingery coral spread across the shallow reef. 那片手指狀珊瑚在淺礁上延展。

meaning: 刺藤；牙買加的一種多刺攀緣灌木
sentences: Fingrigo is a prickly climbing shrub found in Jamaica. 這是牙買加的一種多刺攀緣灌木。
The gardener wore thick gloves while cutting fingrigo. 園丁修剪刺藤時戴上了厚手套。

meaning: 頂飾；建築物或物件頂端的裝飾
sentences: Finial is an ornament placed at the top of a building or object. 這指放在建築物或物件頂端的裝飾。
A stone finial crowned each corner of the roof. 每個屋角頂端都有一個石製頂飾。

meaning: 裝有頂飾的；以頂飾收尾的
sentences: Finialed means fitted with a decorative piece at the top. 這表示頂端裝有裝飾件。
The finialed gate marked the entrance to the garden. 那座裝有頂飾的門標示著花園入口。

meaning: 對小事過分講究的；過於挑剔的
sentences: Finical describes someone overly particular about small details. 這形容對小細節過分講究的人。
His finical taste rejected every plain button. 他過於挑剔的品味拒絕了每一顆普通鈕扣。

meaning: 過分講究小事的性質；挑剔
sentences: Finicality is the quality of being excessively particular about trifles. 這是對瑣事過分講究的性質。
The tailor's finicality slowed the final fitting. 裁縫的過度挑剔拖慢了最後試衣。

meaning: 以財務的方式。如何使用finally造句
sentences: Writers use finically to mean in a finical manner. How to use finically in a sentence. 作家們使用 以財務的方式。如何使用finally造句 來表示以財務的方式。如何在句子中使用以財務的方式。如何使用finally造句。
She acted finically when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她最終採取了行動。

meaning: 過分挑剔的狀態；對細節的吹毛求疵
sentences: Finicalness means an overly fussy concern with minor details. 這指對小細節過度吹毛求疵。
Her finicalness made a simple meal take an hour to arrange. 她的過分挑剔讓一頓簡餐花了一小時才擺好。

meaning: 過分講究細節的態度；挑剔作風
sentences: Finicism denotes an excessively finical manner or attitude. 這指過分挑剔的作風或態度。
The critic's finicism focused on tiny flaws in the border. 那名評論家的挑剔作風專注於邊框的微小瑕疵。

meaning: 在言行上故作精緻；故作斯文
sentences: Finick means to behave in an affectedly refined or delicate way. 這指以矯揉造作的精緻方式行事。
He began to finick when the guests praised his manners. 客人稱讚他的禮儀時，他開始故作斯文。

meaning: 挑剔地；過分講究地
sentences: Finickily means in an excessively fussy or particular manner. 這表示以過分挑剔或講究的方式。
She finickily arranged the berries by exact size. 她挑剔地按照精確大小排列莓果。

meaning: 挑剔的性質或狀態
sentences: Finickiness is the habit of being hard to please about small matters. 這是在小事上難以取悅的習性。
The child's finickiness made dinner difficult for everyone. 那孩子的挑食讓所有人吃晚餐都很困難。

meaning: 挑剔的；過分講究細節的
sentences: Finicking describes someone who fusses over tiny details. 這形容對微小細節吹毛求疵的人。
A finicking editor changed the spacing between two letters. 一名挑剔的編輯改動了兩個字母之間的間距。

meaning: 以一種挑剔的方式
sentences: Writers use finickingly to mean in a finicking manner. 作家們用「以一種挑剔的方式」來表示「以一種挑剔的方式」。
She acted finickingly when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她就會表現得小心翼翼。

meaning: 挑剔或過分講究細節的性質
sentences: Finickingness is the quality of fussing over unimportant details. 這是對不重要細節吹毛求疵的性質。
His finickingness delayed the repair of the old chair. 他的過度挑剔延誤了舊椅子的修理。

meaning: 使事情結束的；終結性的
sentences: Finific describes something that brings an action or process to an end. 這形容使行動或過程結束的事物。
The finific clause closed the agreement after payment. 那項終結條款在付款後使協議正式結束。

meaning: 使精美；裝飾；使外表更漂亮
sentences: Finify means to make something fine or to adorn it. 這指使事物變精美或加以裝飾。
The artisan used gold leaf to finify the wooden frame. 工匠用金箔裝飾木框，使它更精美。

meaning: 一種冠羽似鬃毛的鴿子
sentences: Finikin names a pigeon with a crest resembling a mane. 這個詞指一種冠羽像鬃毛的鴿子。
An aviary once kept a finikin with a high feathered crest. 一座鳥舍曾飼養一隻冠羽高聳的鬃冠鴿。

meaning: 挑剔的；對瑣事過分講究的
sentences: Finiking is a variant spelling of finicky, meaning overly particular. 這是另一個拼寫變體，指過分挑剔。
Her finiking habits made choosing a ribbon take all morning. 她挑剔的習慣讓挑選緞帶花了整個上午。

meaning: 精煉或澄清液體、金屬等的過程；澄清劑
sentences: Fining is the process of refining or clarifying a liquid or metal. 這是精煉或澄清液體、金屬的過程。
The brewer used fining to clear the cloudy cider. 釀酒師用澄清處理去除混濁蘋果酒中的懸浮物。

meaning: 結束；作品末尾表示完結的字樣
sentences: Finis means the end or conclusion, often at the close of a work. 這指結束或結尾，常見於作品末端。
The word finis appeared beneath the last scene. 「完」字出現在最後一幕下方。

meaning: 結束
sentences: I need to finish my homework before I can watch TV. 我需要先做完功課才能看電視。
When will you finish your project? 你什麼時候會完成你的專案？

meaning: 可以完成的；能做完的
sentences: Finishable describes something that can be completed. 這形容可以完成的事物。
The short trail is finishable before sunset. 那條短步道可以在日落前走完。

meaning: 已完成; 結論; <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="/="done" 完成。
sentences: I won't be finished until just before lunch. 直到午餐前我才會 完成 。 直到午餐前我才會完成。 直到午餐前我才會完成。

meaning: 完成或完成某事的人。
sentences: The early finishers waited for the other runners to reach the finish line. 較早到達終點的選手等待其他選手到達終點。
The term finisher refers to a person who finishes or completes something. 術語“完成者”指完成或完成某事的人。

meaning: 結束：終止。如何在句子中使用完成。 Finish 的同義字討論
sentences: Older manuals use finishing to mean to come to an end: terminate. How to use finish in a sentence. Synonym Discussion of Finish. 較舊的手冊使用“結束：終止。如何在句子中使用完成。 Finish 的同義字討論”來表示結束：終止。如何在句子中使用完成。完成的同義詞討論。
In practice, people finishing when that action is required. 在實踐中，人們會在需要採取行動時完成。

meaning: 有限的
sentences: The earth's natural resources are finite, and we must use them wisely. 地球的自然資源是有限的，我們必須明智地使用它們。
The human lifespan is finite, which is why we should cherish every moment. 人的壽命是有限的，這就是為什麼我們應該珍惜每一刻。

meaning: 具有明確的或可定義的限制。如何使用有限造句
sentences: Writers use finitely to mean having definite or definable limits. How to use finite in a sentence. 作者使用有限來表示有明確的或可定義的限制。如何在句子中使用有限。
She acted finitely when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她的行動是有限的。

meaning: 有限的性質或狀態
sentences: Finiteness is the condition of having a limit or boundary. 這是具有界限或邊界的狀態。
The mathematician used finiteness to distinguish the set from an infinite one. 那位數學家用有限性區分該集合與無限集合。

meaning: 極其微小的；幾乎無法測量的
sentences: Finitesimal particles drifted through the narrow tube. 極其微小的粒子飄過狹窄的管子。
Mina noticed a finitesimal crack in the glass. 米娜注意到玻璃上有一道極細微的裂縫。

meaning: 表示終結或完成的詞；終結詞
sentences: Finitive marks the end of an action in the sentence. 終結詞在句中標示動作的結束。
Linguists found a finitive near the final verb. 語言學家在最後一個動詞附近找到終結詞。

meaning: 有限性；有終點的狀態
sentences: Finitude reminds us that every resource has a limit. 有限性提醒我們每種資源都有極限。
The poem reflects on human finitude. 這首詩思索人類生命的有限性。

meaning: 有限性；有界限的性質
sentences: Finity gives the sequence a definite endpoint. 有限性讓這個序列有明確的終點。
Mathematicians discussed finity in the proof. 數學家在證明中討論有限性。

meaning: 中東地區用來煮或盛咖啡的小壺或咖啡杯
sentences: Finjan held the sweet coffee for each guest. 小咖啡壺盛著要給每位客人的甜咖啡。
Noura poured coffee from a finjan into a tiny cup. 努拉從小咖啡壺把咖啡倒進小杯子。

meaning: 令人鄙夷的人；告密者；破壞罷工者
sentences: Fink betrayed the group by informing the police. 告密者向警方通報，背叛了團體。
Rosa called the strikebreaker a fink. 蘿莎把那名破壞罷工者叫作卑鄙的人。

meaning: 含雜醇油的未精製烈酒；劣質烈酒
sentences: Finkel often has a harsh smell and taste. 含雜醇油的未精製烈酒常有刺鼻的氣味和口感。
The distiller rejected the finkel as unsafe to sell. 蒸餾師拒絕販售那批劣質烈酒。

meaning: 芬蘭；北歐國家，首都為赫爾辛基
sentences: Finland is known for its many lakes and forests. 芬蘭以眾多湖泊和森林聞名。
Lauri moved to Finland for a research job. 勞里為了研究工作搬到芬蘭。

meaning: 沒有鰭的
sentences: Finless fish moved through the mud without visible fins. 無鰭魚在泥中游動，看不見明顯的鰭。
The finless larva used its body to steer. 那隻無鰭幼體用身體轉向。

meaning: 小鰭；魚身背部或腹部的小型鰭
sentences: Finlet appeared behind the main dorsal fin. 主背鰭後方出現一片小鰭。
The biologist counted each finlet on the tuna. 生物學家數了鮪魚身上的每片小鰭。

meaning: 像鰭的；形狀或功能似鰭的
sentences: Finlike flaps helped the creature turn quickly. 像鰭的薄片幫助那隻生物快速轉向。
A finlike ridge ran along the small robot. 一道像鰭的脊線沿著小機器人延伸。

meaning: 白鱒；蘇格蘭對某種鱒魚的稱呼
sentences: Finnac thrives in the cold stream near the village. 白鱒在村旁的寒冷溪流中生長良好。
The angler released a finnac after taking a quick look. 釣客看了一眼後便放走那條白鱒。

meaning: 有鰭的；裝有鰭片的
sentences: Finned fish turned sharply beside the reef. 有鰭的魚在礁石旁急轉彎。
The engineer tested a finned rocket in the wind tunnel. 工程師在風洞中測試裝有鰭片的火箭。

meaning: 長鬚鯨；體型細長的鬚鯨
sentences: Finner surfaced beside the quiet research boat. 長鬚鯨在安靜的研究船旁浮出水面。
The crew watched a finner blow mist into the air. 船員看著一頭長鬚鯨向空中噴出水霧。

meaning: 芬蘭式馴鹿皮靴，毛皮朝外
sentences: Finnesko kept the traveler warm on the snowy path. 芬蘭式馴鹿皮靴讓旅人在積雪小路上保持溫暖。
Anja dried her finnesko beside the stove. 安雅把馴鹿皮靴放在爐子旁烘乾。

meaning: 五英鎊鈔票；舊時的五英鎊俗稱
sentences: Finnip was enough to buy a simple meal in that era. 五英鎊鈔票在那個年代足以買一頓簡單的飯。
The old letter mentions a finnip tucked under the mat. 那封舊信提到墊子下藏著一張五英鎊鈔票。

meaning: 有鰭的；像魚的
sentences: Finny shapes flashed beneath the clear water. 有鰭的身影在清澈水下閃過。
The finny creature vanished among the reeds. 那隻魚般的生物消失在蘆葦間。

meaning: 茴香；球莖可食的香草植物
sentences: Finochio added a mild anise flavor to the soup. 茴香為湯增添淡淡的茴香味。
Carla sliced finochio into a fresh salad. 卡拉把茴香切片放進新鮮沙拉。

meaning: 峽灣；兩側有陡峭山壁的狹長海灣
sentences: Fiord cut deep into the green mountain coast. 峽灣深入翠綠的山海岸。
Erik photographed the fiord at sunrise. 埃里克在日出時拍下峽灣。

meaning: 有峽灣的；被峽灣切割的
sentences: Fiorded shores made the coastline difficult to cross. 峽灣縱橫的海岸讓人難以穿越。
The fiorded region attracts hikers and kayakers. 那片有峽灣的地區吸引健行者和划艇者。

meaning: 紅頂草；一種細葉牧草
sentences: Fiorin covered the damp meadow with soft green blades. 紅頂草以柔軟的綠葉覆蓋潮濕草地。
The farmer planted fiorin beside the stream. 農夫在溪流旁種下紅頂草。

meaning: 溫泉附近形成的灰白色蛋白石結殼
sentences: Fiorite formed as a pale crust around the hot spring. 灰白色的溫泉蛋白石在溫泉周圍形成結殼。
The mineral collector stored a piece of fiorite carefully. 礦物收藏家小心收好一塊溫泉蛋白石。

meaning: 五便士硬幣；舊時五便士的俗稱
sentences: Fip bought a small loaf at the village stall. 五便士硬幣能在村裡攤位買一小條麵包。
The child found a fip beneath the wooden bench. 孩子在木長椅下找到一枚五便士硬幣。

meaning: 值五便士的；五便士硬幣的
sentences: Fipenny coins were once common in small purchases. 五便士硬幣曾經常用於小額購物。
The shopkeeper marked the toy as fipenny. 店主把那個玩具標成五便士的價格。

meaning: 吹口樂器中的導流塞；使氣流發聲的塞子
sentences: Fipple directs air across the edge of the whistle. 導流塞把氣流引向哨子的邊緣。
The maker replaced the cracked fipple in the recorder. 製作者更換了直笛中裂開的導流塞。

meaning: 菲克纖維；取自熱帶美洲植物葉片的耐用纖維
sentences: Fique makes strong rope for baskets and mats. 菲克纖維能製成結實的籃子和蓆子繩。
Workers dried the fique leaves before extracting the fibers. 工人先把菲克植物的葉子曬乾，再抽取纖維。

meaning: 冷杉
sentences: The mountains are covered with evergreen fir trees. 山上覆蓋著常綠的冷杉樹。

meaning: 社區；部落或地方團體
sentences: Firca gathered to repair the shared water channel. 社區聚在一起修理共用的水道。

meaning: 火
sentences: Don't play with matches; you might start a fire. 不要玩火柴，你可能會引起火災。

meaning: 可被解雇的；足以成為解雇理由的
sentences: Fireable conduct can end a worker’s contract immediately. 足以解雇的行為可能立刻終止工作合約。
The manager warned that repeated dishonesty was fireable. 經理警告，反覆不誠實足以成為解雇理由。

meaning: 火器，槍支
sentences: You need a license to own a firearm in this country. 在這個國家擁有槍支需要許可證。
Police recovered several illegal firearms during the raid. 警方在突擊行動中查獲了幾支非法槍支。

meaning: 持有或配備槍械的
sentences: Firearmed guards stood at the gate during the crisis. 危機期間，持槍警衛站在門口。
The firearmed patrol followed strict safety rules. 配備槍械的巡邏隊遵守嚴格安全規則。

meaning: 壁爐後方的鑄鐵護板
sentences: Fireback protected the brick wall from intense heat. 壁爐護板保護磚牆免受高熱損傷。
The antique fireback showed a carved family crest. 那塊古老的壁爐護板刻有家族徽章。

meaning: 爆炸成火球或火焰。
sentences: The car swerved off a road, hit a wall, and fireballed as the petrol tank exploded. 汽車突然衝出道路，撞到牆上，油箱爆炸，產生火球。
People often fireball when the situation calls for it. 當情況需要時，人們常常會火冒三丈。

meaning: 羽色亮橙或鮮紅的小鳥，如巴爾的摩金鶯或猩紅唐納雀
sentences: A firebird flashed through the red maple leaves. 一隻火鳥穿過紅色楓葉間，身影一閃而過。
The bright firebird fed on berries near the fence. 那隻色彩鮮明的火鳥在籬笆旁吃莓果。

meaning: 火閃礦；一種硫銻銀礦物，也稱焦硫銻銀礦
sentences: Fireblende showed a dark red shine under the lamp. 火閃礦在燈下呈現暗紅色光澤。
The museum placed fireblende in its mineral display. 博物館把火閃礦放進礦物展示櫃。

meaning: 壁爐封板；不用壁爐時遮住爐口的裝飾板
sentences: Fireboard hid the empty hearth during the summer. 壁爐封板在夏天遮住空的爐膛。
The carved fireboard matched the wooden mantel. 雕花壁爐封板與木製壁爐架相配。

meaning: 消防船；配備消防設備的船
sentences: Fireboat sprayed water toward the burning pier. 消防船朝燃燒的碼頭噴水。
The harbor sent a fireboat after the alarm sounded. 警報響起後，港口派出一艘消防船。

meaning: 火箭般的閃電；猛烈迅疾的閃光
sentences: Firebolt split the dark sky above the ridge. 一道火箭般的閃電劃破山脊上方的黑天空。
The wizard sent a firebolt across the courtyard. 巫師讓一道猛烈的火光穿過庭院。

meaning: 被閃電或火焰般的力量擊中的
sentences: Firebolted clouds glowed red above the storm. 被閃電擊中的雲層在暴風雨上方泛著紅光。
The firebolted tree stood black against the snow. 被雷擊的樹在雪地前呈現黑色剪影。

meaning: 火柴木權；佃戶取用木材生火的權利或該木材
sentences: Firebote allowed the tenant to gather fallen wood for heating. 火柴木權允許佃戶撿拾落木取暖。
The lease preserved the family’s firebote on the estate. 租約保留了那家人在莊園取用柴薪的權利。

meaning: 火箱；爐子或蒸汽鍋爐中燃燒燃料的空間
sentences: Firebox held the coal that heated the old locomotive. 火箱盛放煤炭，為老火車提供熱力。
The engineer inspected the firebox before departure. 工程師出發前檢查了火箱。

meaning: 在火爐旁添煤或照料火的人
sentences: Fireboy carried coal to the furnace before dawn. 添煤工人在黎明前把煤炭搬到熔爐旁。
The young fireboy kept the engine warm overnight. 年輕的爐火工整晚維持引擎溫度。

meaning: 燃燒的木柴；煽動動亂或激烈主張的人
sentences: Firebrand leaped from the campfire onto the dry grass. 一塊燃木從營火跳到乾草上。
The political firebrand urged the crowd to resist. 那名激進的政治煽動者鼓動群眾抵抗。

meaning: 火蠹，一種喜愛溫暖潮濕環境、與衣魚近親的無翅昆蟲
sentences: A firebrat hid beneath the warm kitchen boiler. 一隻火蠹躲在溫暖的廚房鍋爐下。
The firebrat prefers damp places with steady heat. 火蠹偏好持續溫熱的潮濕地方。

meaning: 防火隔離帶；阻止野火蔓延的清空地帶
sentences: Firebreak slowed the flames before they reached the houses. 防火隔離帶在火焰到達房屋前減緩了火勢。
Rangers widened the firebreak along the dry hillside. 護林員加寬了乾燥山坡旁的防火帶。

meaning: 耐火磚；能承受高溫的磚
sentences: Firebrick lined the inside of the pottery kiln. 耐火磚砌在陶窯內側。
Mason replaced the cracked firebrick near the flame. 石匠更換了火焰旁裂開的耐火磚。

meaning: 縱火者；有縱火癖的人
sentences: Firebug set several empty sheds alight at night. 縱火者在夜裡點燃了幾間空棚屋。
Police caught the firebug near the abandoned lot. 警方在廢棄空地附近抓到了縱火者。

meaning: 被火燒傷的人；遭火焚燒的狀態
sentences: Fireburn left a painful mark on his arm. 火灼傷在他的手臂上留下疼痛的痕跡。
The rescue team treated the fireburn with cool water. 救援隊用冷水處理火灼傷。

meaning: 防火塗層；加熱金屬前用來防止氧化的保護層
sentences: Firecoat protected the silver while the jeweler heated it. 防火塗層在珠寶師加熱銀器時保護了銀面。
The craftsperson brushed firecoat over the metal before soldering. 工匠在焊接前把防火塗層刷在金屬上。

meaning: 鞭炮、爆竹
sentences: The children enjoyed setting off colorful firecrackers during the festival. 孩子們喜歡在節慶期間燃放彩色的鞭炮（爆竹）。
The loud sound of firecrackers filled the air in the small village yesterday. 昨天小村莊裡到處都是響亮的鞭炮聲。

meaning: 火冠鶥；頭頂有鮮紅冠羽的小型鳥
sentences: Firecrest perched briefly on the garden fence. 火冠鶥短暫停在花園籬笆上。
Birdwatchers spotted a firecrest among the pine branches. 賞鳥者在松樹枝間看見一隻火冠鶥。

meaning: 以特定燃料燃燒或加熱的；以某燃料為動力的
sentences: A coal-fired boiler heats the old factory. 燃煤鍋爐為老工廠供熱。
The ship uses an oil-fired engine for power. 那艘船使用燃油引擎提供動力。

meaning: 礦井瓦斯；主要含甲烷且可爆炸的氣體
sentences: Firedamp collected near the roof of the mine tunnel. 礦井瓦斯聚集在礦坑通道頂部附近。
Sensors warned the miners when firedamp levels rose. 感測器在瓦斯濃度升高時警告礦工。

meaning: 壁爐架；支撐柴薪的金屬架
sentences: Firedog lifted the logs above the hearth floor. 壁爐架把木柴抬離爐膛地面。
The iron firedog had curled feet and a simple design. 那個鐵製壁爐架有彎曲的腳和簡單的設計。

meaning: 噴火龍，尤其指日耳曼神話中的龍
sentences: A firedrake guarded the treasure in the legend. 一條噴火龍在傳說中守護寶藏。
Old German tales describe the firedrake with burning breath. 古老的日耳曼故事描述噴火龍能吐出烈焰。

meaning: 因地面火災燒毀根部而倒下的樹
sentences: Firefall blocked the trail after the forest blaze. 林火過後，一棵火倒木擋住了小徑。
Workers cleared a firefall from the mountain road. 工人把山路上的火倒木清除。

meaning: 由於有機物緩慢氧化分解而變得過熱、過度乾燥和損壞——尤其是糞便或穀物
sentences: Older manuals use firefang to mean to become overheated, excessively dry, and damaged as a result of slow oxidative decomposition of organic matter —used especially of manure or grain. 較舊的手冊使用“由於有機物緩慢氧化分解而變得過熱、過度乾燥和損壞——尤其是糞便或穀物”來表示由於有機物（尤其是糞便或穀物）緩慢氧化分解而導致的過熱、過度乾燥和損壞。
In practice, people firefang when that action is required. 實際上，當需要採取行動時，人們就會開火。

meaning: 由於有機物緩慢氧化分解而變得過熱、過度乾燥和損壞——尤其是糞便或穀物
sentences: Older manuals use firefanged to mean to become overheated, excessively dry, and damaged as a result of slow oxidative decomposition of organic matter —used especially of manure or grain. 較舊的手冊使用 由於有機物緩慢氧化分解而變得過熱、過度乾燥和損壞——尤其是糞便或穀物 來表示由於有機物（尤其是糞便或穀物）緩慢氧化分解而導致過熱、過度乾燥和損壞。
In practice, people firefanged when that action is required. 實際上，當需要採取行動時，人們會怒火中燒。

meaning: 片狀閃電；流星、鬼火或極光
sentences: Fireflaught spread across the clouds without a loud thunderclap. 片狀閃電掠過雲層，卻沒有巨大的雷聲。
The villagers called the strange glow fireflaught. 村民把那道奇異的光稱為片狀閃電。

meaning: 喜歡玩火或輕率挑戰危險的人
sentences: Fireflirt touched the hot iron despite the warning. 那個玩火者不顧警告碰了熱鐵。
Everyone watched the fireflirt step too close to the flames. 所有人看著那名玩火者走得太靠近火焰。

meaning: 墨西哥火焰花；開鮮紅花朵的觀賞植物
sentences: Fireflower brightened the balcony with scarlet blooms. 墨西哥火焰花以鮮紅花朵讓陽台明亮起來。
Gardeners watered the fireflower before the hot afternoon. 園丁在炎熱午後前替火焰花澆水。

meaning: 螢科甲蟲，在黃昏時表現出生物發光。
sentences: The term firefly refers to any beetle of the family Lampyridae, which exhibit bioluminescence during twilight. 螢火蟲一詞指的是螢科的任何甲蟲，它們在黃昏時表現出生物發光。
The lesson introduced firefly as a useful term to understand. 本課程介紹了螢火蟲作為一個易於理解的有用術語。

meaning: 防火看守人；負責監看或撲滅火災的人
sentences: Fireguard checked the campfires before the hikers left. 防火看守人在健行者離開前檢查營火。
The fireguard carried a hose along the dry boundary. 消防看守員沿著乾燥邊界帶著水管巡查。

meaning: 消防隊駐地；消防局
sentences: Firehouse opened its doors to the neighborhood after the storm. 暴風雨後，消防局向鄰里敞開大門。
The crew returned to the firehouse before midnight. 消防隊在午夜前回到消防局。

meaning: 沒有火的；不使用明火的
sentences: Fireless cooking kept the small room free of smoke. 無火烹調讓小房間沒有煙霧。
The fireless heater warmed the tent with electricity. 不用明火的暖氣以電力溫暖帳篷。

meaning: 火光；火焰發出的光
sentences: Firelight flickered across the stone walls. 火光在石牆上閃爍。
Jon read the final page by firelight. 喬恩借著火光讀完最後一頁。

meaning: 像火的；具有火焰般外觀或特性的
sentences: Firelike colors filled the sky after sunset. 日落後，像火焰的色彩布滿天空。
The mineral gave off a firelike glow under pressure. 那種礦物受壓時發出火焰般的光。

meaning: 小火焰；微小的火
sentences: Fireling danced at the tip of the candle wick. 小火焰在燭芯頂端跳動。
A child protected the fireling from the wind. 孩子替小火苗擋住風。

meaning: 被火光照亮的
sentences: Firelit faces gathered around the quiet hearth. 被火光照亮的臉龐聚在安靜的壁爐旁。
The firelit cabin looked warm from the snowy path. 從積雪小徑望去，那間火光照亮的小屋顯得很溫暖。

meaning: 火繩槍的槍機；使用慢燃火繩點燃火藥的槍
sentences: Firelock used a smoldering cord to ignite the powder. 火繩槍用慢燃的繩子點燃火藥。
The museum displayed an unloaded firelock behind glass. 博物館在玻璃後展示一把未裝彈的火繩槍。

meaning: 消防員
sentences: The fireman carried the child outside safely. 那名消防員安全地把孩子抱到屋外。
A fireman checked the alarm before bedtime. 一名消防員在睡前檢查了警報器。

meaning: 消防員；女消防員
sentences: The poster shows a fireman/firewoman beside a truck. 海報上有一名消防員站在卡車旁。
A fireman/firewoman taught us how to use an extinguisher. 一名消防員教我們如何使用滅火器。

meaning: 消防實務；滅火的技能或職業
sentences: Firemanship requires calm decisions under intense pressure. 消防實務要求人在巨大壓力下冷靜決策。
Her firemanship improved after years of emergency drills. 她經過多年緊急演練後，消防技能更加純熟。

meaning: 消防隊長；歷史上監督煙火配製的砲兵官
sentences: Firemaster ordered the brigade to protect the hillside homes. 消防隊長下令保護山坡上的住家。
The historical firemaster supervised the making of display rockets. 歷史上的煙火監製官負責監督展示用火箭的製作。

meaning: 壁爐
sentences: We spent the whole evening sitting near the warm stone fireplace. 我們整個晚上都坐在溫暖的石造壁爐旁。
The children were happily decorating the fireplace for Christmas. 孩子們正開心地裝飾壁爐準備過聖誕節。

meaning: 消防栓；供消防車取水的接水口
sentences: Fireplug supplied water to the hose beside the warehouse. 消防栓為倉庫旁的水管供水。
A red fireplug stood at the corner of the street. 街角立著一個紅色消防栓。

meaning: 火力；有效攻擊目標的武器射擊能力
sentences: Firepower allowed the small unit to hold the bridge. 火力讓小部隊得以守住橋梁。
The vessel increased its firepower with two new cannons. 那艘船以兩門新大砲增強火力。

meaning: 防火的、耐火的
sentences: The company is required by law to have fireproof storage for documents. 法律要求公司必須備有防火的檔案儲存空間。
Firefighters wear special fireproof clothing to protect themselves from heat. 消防員穿著特殊的防火服以保護自己免受熱浪傷害。

meaning: 防火材料或防火處理
sentences: Fireproofing reduced heat damage to the steel beams. 防火處理降低了熱力對鋼樑的損害。
Builders added fireproofing beneath the wooden stairs. 建築工人在木梯下方加上防火材料。

meaning: 防火性；抵抗火焰或高熱的能力
sentences: Fireproofness matters when walls surround a furnace. 當牆壁包圍熔爐時，防火性十分重要。
Tests confirmed the fireproofness of the new panel. 測試證實新面板的防火能力。

meaning: 點火者；負責加燃料或操作火的裝置或人
sentences: Firer fed the kiln until the clay hardened. 燒窯工持續添燃料，直到黏土變硬。
The automatic firer kept the brick kiln at a steady heat. 自動燃燒器讓磚窯維持穩定高溫。

meaning: 輪船的鍋爐室；司爐室
sentences: Fireroom grew hot as the ship crossed the bay. 船隻渡過海灣時，鍋爐室變得很熱。
The engineer entered the fireroom to check the boilers. 工程師進入司爐室檢查鍋爐。

meaning: 防火的；能降低火災風險的
sentences: Firesafe doors slowed the smoke in the hallway. 防火門減緩了煙霧在走廊中的擴散。
The archive used firesafe cabinets for fragile papers. 檔案室用防火櫃保存脆弱文件。

meaning: 防火性；降低起火或火勢擴大的程度
sentences: Firesafeness was a key concern in the building plan. 防火性是建築計畫中的重要考量。
Inspectors measured the firesafeness of every exit door. 檢查員測量每扇出口門的防火程度。

meaning: 消防安全；預防火災和保護人員的措施
sentences: Firesafety training taught residents how to leave calmly. 消防安全訓練教居民如何冷靜離開。
The hotel improved its firesafety with alarms and clear exits. 旅館以警報器和清楚的出口改善消防安全。

meaning: 火焰柱；向上延伸的狹長火道
sentences: Fireshaft rose from the furnace through the open roof. 火焰柱從熔爐穿過敞開的屋頂向上升起。
The forge worker watched the fireshaft twist in the draft. 鍛造工看著火焰柱在氣流中扭動。

meaning: 火光；火焰的閃耀或微光
sentences: Fireshine glowed on the wet stones beside the hearth. 火光映在壁爐旁的濕石頭上。
The traveler followed the faint fireshine through the dark camp. 旅人沿著微弱火光穿過昏暗營地。

meaning: 爐邊；靠近火爐或壁爐的地方
sentences: Fireside became our favorite place on cold evenings. 爐邊成了我們寒冷夜晚最喜歡的地方。
Grandmother told stories while sitting at the fireside. 祖母坐在爐邊講故事。

meaning: 坐在爐邊的人；喜歡居家閒坐的人
sentences: Firesider listened quietly while the kettle boiled. 爐邊客安靜聽著水壺沸騰。
As a firesider, Mei preferred calm evenings at home. 梅是個喜歡爐邊閒坐的人，偏愛在家度過平靜夜晚。

meaning: 爐邊相聚的親密情誼；溫暖閒談的氣氛
sentences: Firesideship grew during their long winter conversations. 他們漫長的冬夜談話培養了爐邊情誼。
The reunion restored a sense of firesideship among friends. 這次重聚恢復了朋友間溫暖相聚的氣氛。

meaning: 火焰柱；噴出的火舌
sentences: Firespout burst from the damaged pipe without warning. 受損管線突然噴出火焰柱。
Firefighters cooled the wall beside the firespout. 消防員冷卻火舌旁的牆面。

meaning: 打火石；古時用來生火的黃鐵礦或燧石
sentences: Firestone struck steel and sent sparks into the dry tinder. 打火石敲擊鋼片，把火星送進乾燥引火物。
The guide carried a firestone in his small kit. 那名嚮導在小工具包裡帶著打火石。

meaning: 防火封堵材料；封住建築縫隙以阻止火勢蔓延的處理
sentences: Firestopping sealed the gaps around the pipes. 防火封堵材料封住了管線周圍的縫隙。
Workers checked the firestopping between each floor. 工人檢查每層樓之間的防火封堵。

meaning: 尾巴呈紅色或微紅色的鳥
sentences: A firetail perched on the highest branch. 一隻火尾鳥停在最高的樹枝上。
The small firetail showed a rusty red tail. 那隻小火尾鳥露出鐵鏽紅的尾巴。

meaning: 柳蘭；火災後常在荒地生長的多年生植物
sentences: Firetop appeared quickly on the burned hillside. 柳蘭很快出現在燒過的山坡上。
The purple firetop flowers covered the clearing. 紫色柳蘭花覆蓋了林間空地。

meaning: 火災陷阱；易燃或火災時難以逃生的場所
sentences: Firetrap had one narrow exit and many dry curtains. 那棟火災陷阱只有一個狹窄出口，還掛滿乾燥窗簾。
Inspectors closed the crowded firetrap before anyone was hurt. 檢查員在有人受傷前關閉了那個危險場所。

meaning: 消防區域主管；負責特定地區消防管制的官員
sentences: Firewarden inspected the camp before the holiday weekend. 消防區域主管在假日前週末檢查了營地。
The firewarden ordered a ban on open flames during the drought. 消防官在乾旱期間下令禁止明火。

meaning: 烈酒；酒精濃度高的蒸餾酒
sentences: Firewater warmed the travelers after the icy crossing. 烈酒讓旅人在冰冷渡河後暖和起來。
The host served a small glass of firewater with dinner. 主人晚餐時端上一小杯烈酒。

meaning: 柳蘭；火災後常在受擾土地上生長的植物
sentences: Fireweed covered the cleared ground with pink flowers. 柳蘭以粉紅花朵覆蓋清理過的土地。
Bees visited the fireweed throughout the warm afternoon. 蜜蜂整個溫暖午後都在柳蘭間採蜜。

meaning: 用於燃燒的木材，通常用於取暖。
sentences: After many days of hard work, we finally had enough firewood for the winter. 經過多日的辛苦，我們終於有了足夠過冬的柴火。
The term firewood refers to wood intended to be burned, typically for heat. 木柴一詞是指用於燃燒的木材，通常用於取暖。

meaning: 焰火
sentences: The sky was lit up by a spectacular firework display at midnight. 午夜時分，壯觀的煙火表演點亮了天空。
The children were very excited to see the colorful fireworks. 孩子們非常興奮能看到五彩繽紛的煙火。

meaning: 沒有煙火的；缺乏煙火般熱鬧效果的
sentences: Fireworkless celebrations can still feel warm and joyful. 沒有煙火的慶典仍然可以溫暖又愉快。
The quiet harbor held a fireworkless New Year gathering. 安靜的港口舉行了一場沒有煙火的新年聚會。

meaning: 像煙火的；繽紛、喧鬧或充滿爆發力的
sentences: Fireworky colors burst across the painter’s large canvas. 像煙火的色彩在畫家的大畫布上爆發。
Her fireworky speech filled the hall with energy. 她充滿爆發力的演說讓大廳充滿活力。

meaning: 蔓越莓蛾的幼蟲，會啃食葉片並使藤蔓呈現焦褐色。
sentences: Researchers found fireworm larvae on cranberry vines. 研究人員在蔓越莓藤上發現了這種蛾類幼蟲。
After feeding, fireworm damage left the leaves brown. 取食後，這種幼蟲造成的傷害使葉片變褐。

meaning: 透過加熱或火（尤其是黏土等）來生產陶器的過程。
sentences: After the pots have been glazed, they go back into the kiln for a second firing. 罐子上釉後，會被送回窯中進行第二次燒製。
The term firing refers to The process of applying heat or fire, especially to clay, etc., to produce pottery. 燒製一詞是指利用熱或火，特別是對黏土等進行加熱或火來生產陶器的過程。

meaning: 迅速行動： 加快；也：活潑或活潑。如何用 firk 造句
sentences: Older manuals use firk to mean to move quickly: hasten; also: to be lively or frisky. How to use firk in a sentence. 較舊的手冊使用 迅速行動： 加快 來表示快速移動：加快；加快；也：活潑或活潑。如何在句子中使用 迅速行動： 加快。
In practice, people firk when that action is required. 實際上，當需要採取行動時，人們就會採取行動。

meaning: 鞭打或猛擊的人（罕用）。
sentences: An old glossary calls a harsh striker a firker. 一本舊詞彙表把猛烈擊打者稱為鞭打者。
A village tale mentions a firker with a whip. 一則鄉村故事提到一名揮鞭者。

meaning: 容量約四分之一桶的小木桶。
sentences: Coopers stored ale in a firkin. 製桶工把啤酒裝進小木桶。
The inn received a firkin of butter. 那家旅店收到一小桶奶油。

meaning: 古代蘇格蘭的乾容量單位，大小因地區而異。
sentences: Scottish merchants measured grain by the firlot. 蘇格蘭商人用這種單位丈量穀物。
The deed promised one firlot of oats. 那份契約承諾提供一個單位的燕麥。

meaning: 公司
sentences: He works as a successful lawyer in a large international law firm. 他在一家大型國際律師事務所擔任成功的律師。
You need to have a firm belief in yourself to achieve your goals. 你需要對自己有堅定的信念才能實現目標。

meaning: 蒼穹；天空的廣闊穹頂。
sentences: Poets once pictured stars across the firmament. 詩人曾描寫群星遍布蒼穹。
Clouds darkened the firmament before dawn. 黎明前，雲層使天空變得陰暗。

meaning: 與蒼穹或天體有關的。
sentences: Celestial maps contain firmamental symbols. 天文圖上有關於蒼穹的符號。
Ancient poems use firmamental imagery. 古詩使用與天體有關的意象。

meaning: 伊斯蘭君主頒發的法令、許可或授予書。
sentences: A sultan signed a firman for the new market. 蘇丹簽署了一份新市場許可令。
The governor read the firman aloud. 總督大聲宣讀那份君主法令。

meaning: 堅定或穩固的狀態（罕用）。
sentences: Historical prose praised the firmance of the pact. 歷史散文讚揚那份協議的穩固性。
Her firmance kept the group calm. 她的堅定使團隊保持冷靜。

meaning: firm 的比較級；更堅固或更堅定的。
sentences: This rope feels firmer after drying. 這條繩子乾燥後摸起來更結實。
His firmer reply ended the argument. 他更堅定的回覆終止了爭論。

meaning: 意志堅定的；勇於堅持的。
sentences: A firmhearted nurse stayed during the storm. 一名意志堅定的護理師在暴風雨中留下。
The firmhearted child faced the difficult choice. 那個堅定的孩子面對艱難選擇。

meaning: 上喙骨在身體中線相接的（解剖學）。
sentences: An anatomical diagram shows a firmisternal frog. 一張解剖圖展示了上喙骨中線相接的青蛙。
Comparative anatomy records a firmisternal shoulder. 比較解剖學記錄了一種上喙骨相接的肩部構造。

meaning: 上喙骨在身體中線相接的；firmisternal 的異體。
sentences: Moss descriptions never use firmisternial for animal bones. 苔蘚描述不會用這個詞形容動物骨骼。
A zoological glossary lists firmisternial as a variant. 一本動物學詞彙表把它列為異體形式。

meaning: 上喙骨在身體中線相接的；描述此解剖特徵的。
sentences: Researchers labeled the specimen firmisternous. 研究人員把那個標本標記為上喙骨中線相接。
The firmisternous structure appears in the drawing. 圖中可見這種上喙骨相接的構造。

meaning: 以堅定或明確或強烈的方式。
sentences: She corrected him firmly but gently. 她堅定但溫和地糾正了他。
If someone acts firmly, they do so in a way that is in a firm or definite or strong manner. 如果某人行動堅定，他們就會以堅定、明確或強烈的方式這樣做。

meaning: 堅固、堅定或不易動搖的狀態。
sentences: The mattress has enough firmness for back support. 這張床墊夠硬，能支撐背部。
Her firmness helped settle the dispute. 她的堅定有助於平息爭端。

meaning: 由積雪壓實形成的粒狀冰雪，介於新雪與冰川冰之間。
sentences: Glaciologists measured firn above the glacier. 冰川學家測量了冰川上方的粒雪。
Warm air melted the upper firn. 暖空氣融化了上層粒雪。

meaning: 在建築表面加裝薄木條等材料，以找平、留出空間或加厚牆體。
sentences: Builders added firring before fitting the wall panels. 建築工人在安裝牆板前加裝薄木條找平。
Proper firring left room for insulation. 適當的墊條施工為隔熱材料留出了空間。

meaning: 由冷杉製成的；冷杉茂盛的。
sentences: Dense groves made the hillside firry. 茂密的冷杉林使山坡遍生冷杉。
The cabin has a firry scent. 那間小屋散發著冷杉的氣味。

meaning: 第一的
sentences: January is the first month of the year. 一月是一年中的第一個月。
First, you need to preheat the oven to 180 degrees. 首先，你需要將烤箱預熱到 180 度。

meaning: 急救
sentences: Everyone should learn basic first-aid skills. 每個人都應該學習基本的急救技能。
She carried a small first-aid kit in her car. 她在車裡帶了一個小急救箱。

meaning: 最先到達的人；先來者。
sentences: Our firstcomer unlocked the hall at sunrise. 最先到達的人在日出時打開了大廳。
Each firstcomer received a warm drink. 每位先到者都得到一杯熱飲。

meaning: 親身的；第一手的
sentences: We heard firsthand accounts from the travelers. 我們聽到了旅客的親身經歷。
She gained firsthand experience at the clinic. 她在診所獲得了第一手經驗。

meaning: 同類中的第一個；最早產生的事物或幼崽。
sentences: This calf was the farmer’s firstling. 這頭小牛是農夫最早出生的牲畜。
The device was a firstling of its design. 這台裝置是該設計的第一件成品。

meaning: 首先;首先；第一的。
sentences: If someone acts firstly, they do so in a way that is in the first place; before anything else; first. 如果某人先採取行動，那麼他們就會以首先的方式行事；首先；第一的。
The speaker responded firstly during the discussion. 討論中，發言人先做出回應。

meaning: 皮爾士哲學中的第一性，指事物未經關係或反應而呈現的質感與可能性。
sentences: Peirce’s account treats firstness as pure possibility. 皮爾士的理論把第一性視為純粹的可能性。
The redness of a rose illustrates firstness. 玫瑰的紅色可用來說明第一性。

meaning: 居首的地位或最先的身分（罕用）。
sentences: The chronicle celebrates the captain’s firstship. 那部編年史歌頌船長的首位地位。
His firstship gave him ceremonial honors. 他居首的身分使他獲得禮儀上的榮譽。

meaning: 伸入陸地的寬闊海灣，或大型河口。
sentences: A royal fleet entered the firth at noon. 一支王室艦隊中午駛入海灣。
The town lies beside a broad firth. 那座城鎮位於寬闊海灣旁。

meaning: 國庫；國家或君主掌管的財產。
sentences: The treasurer transferred the fine to the fisc. 財務官把罰款轉入國庫。
The decree protected property belonging to the fisc. 那道法令保護屬於國家的財產。

meaning: 財政的、會計的
sentences: The government announced several new fiscal measures to reduce the national debt. 政府公佈了幾項新的財政措施以減少國債。
The company's fiscal year ends on December 31st every year. 公司的會計年度於每年的 12 月 31 日結束。

meaning: 使某項活動納入財政或稅務管理。
sentences: Officials may fiscalify public spending during a crisis. 官員可能在危機期間把公共支出納入財政管理。
The reform would fiscalify informal trade. 這項改革會把非正式貿易納入稅務管理。

meaning: 重視政府財政、稅收與公共支出的政策或思想。
sentences: Some theorists link fiscalism with strong state revenue. 一些理論家把財政主義與強大的國家收入連結起來。
The debate contrasted fiscalism with monetary policy. 這場辯論比較了財政主義與貨幣政策。

meaning: 使活動納入稅務或政府財政管理的過程。
sentences: Tax administration accelerated fiscalization of online sales. 稅務管理加速了網路銷售的財政化。
This fiscalization can improve public revenue records. 這種財政化能改善公共收入紀錄。

meaning: 使某項活動受財政或稅務制度管理。
sentences: Governments fiscalize imports through customs duties. 政府透過關稅使進口活動納入財政管理。
The law will fiscalize several digital services. 這項法律將使數項數位服務接受稅務管理。

meaning: 在財政或稅務方面地。
sentences: The council acted fiscally during the shortage. 委員會在短缺期間採取了審慎的財政措施。
The plan is fiscally sustainable for a decade. 這項計畫在財政上能維持十年。

meaning: 一種綠色鹼式磷酸鋁礦物，化學式為 AlPO₄·Al(OH)₃·21½H₂O。
sentences: Mineralogists identified fischerite in the green crust. 礦物學家在綠色外殼中辨認出費雪石。
The collection contains a small fischerite fragment. 那批收藏中有一小塊費雪石。

meaning: 發出嘶嘶聲（方言或罕用）。
sentences: An old tale says that snakes fise at dusk. 一則古老故事說蛇會在黃昏時發出嘶嘶聲。
The angry cat began to fise. 生氣的貓開始發出嘶聲。

meaning: 一種黃色結晶黃酮化合物，存在於漆樹等植物的木材中。
sentences: Chemists isolate fisetin from certain plant wood. 化學家從某些植物木材中分離出非瑟酮。
The pigment fisetin gives the extract a yellow color. 這種色素使萃取物呈黃色。

meaning: 魚
sentences: My father likes to go fishing at the lake on weekends. 我父親喜歡在週末去湖邊釣魚。
Salmon is a very healthy kind of fish to eat. 鮭魚是一種非常健康的食用魚類。

meaning: 適合捕魚的；法律允許捕魚的。
sentences: Rural anglers found the restored lake fishable again. 鄉村釣客發現整修後的湖泊又適合捕魚了。
The river is fishable below the dam. 水壩下游的河段可以合法捕魚。

meaning: 繫在起錨滑車鉤上的小繩，用來協助掛上錨
sentences: A fishback helps sailors hook the anchor securely. 這條起錨小繩幫助水手穩妥地掛上錨。
Deckhands checked the fishback before raising the anchor. 甲板水手在起錨前檢查了這條小繩。

meaning: 富含魚類化石遺骸的沉積地層。
sentences: Fossil beds revealed a fishbed beneath the cliff. 化石層在懸崖下方顯示出一層魚類化石地層。
The fishbed preserves thousands of tiny bones. 這層魚類化石地層保存了數千根細小骨骼。

meaning: 魚毒果；魚藤（Anamirta cocculus）的果實，可用來毒魚
sentences: A fishberry contains compounds once used to stun fish. 魚毒果含有曾用來麻痺魚類的化合物。
Traders carried dried fishberry in sealed sacks. 商人把乾燥魚毒果裝在密封袋裡運送。

meaning: 固定鐵路魚尾板的螺栓
sentences: A fishbolt fastens the fishplate to a rail. 魚尾板螺栓把魚尾板固定在鐵軌上。
Rail workers replaced the rusted fishbolt beside the track. 鐵路工人在軌道旁更換生鏽的魚尾板螺栓。

meaning: 魚骨；形似魚骨的結構或圖形
sentences: A fishbone stuck in the fillet during dinner. 晚餐時，一根魚刺卡在魚片裡。
The branch pattern looked like a fishbone from above. 從上方看，那個分枝圖案像魚骨。

meaning: 吃魚的動物；食魚動物
sentences: A fisheater such as an otter hunts along the river. 水獺等食魚動物沿著河邊捕獵。
The eagle is an efficient fisheater with sharp talons. 老鷹是善用銳利爪子的高效食魚動物。

meaning: fish 的過去式與過去分詞：捕魚或釣到魚。
sentences: Local families fished along the river at dawn. 當地家庭在黎明時沿河捕魚。
The crew had fished these waters for years. 這支船隊已在這片水域捕魚多年。

meaning: 捕魚的人，尤其是為了謀生或為了運動而捕魚的人；從事釣魚消遣的人。
sentences: The term fisher refers to a person who catches fish, especially for a living or for sport; a person engaging in the pastime of fishing. 漁民一詞指的是捕魚的人，尤其是為了謀生或為了娛樂而捕魚的人；從事釣魚消遣的人。
The lesson introduced fisher as a useful term to understand. 本課介紹了費雪這個術語，這是一個需要理解的有用術語。

meaning: 捕魚用的船；漁船。
sentences: The fisherboat left the harbor before sunrise. 漁船在日出前離開港口。
A damaged fisherboat returned before the storm. 一艘受損漁船在暴風雨前返航。

meaning: 捕魚的男孩；小漁夫。
sentences: A fisherboy mended nets beside the pier. 一名小漁夫在碼頭旁修補漁網。
The fisherboy sold his catch at noon. 那名小漁夫中午把捕獲的魚賣掉。

meaning: 女漁夫；以捕魚為業的女性
sentences: A fisheress mended her net beside the harbor. 一名女漁夫在港口旁修補漁網。
The experienced fisheress knew the safest channel. 那位有經驗的女漁夫知道最安全的航道。

meaning: 以捕魚為生的人；漁民群體
sentences: Local fisherfolk depend on clean water and healthy stocks. 當地漁民仰賴乾淨的水域與健康的魚群。
Seasoned fisherfolk returned before the storm arrived. 經驗豐富的漁民在暴風雨來臨前返航。

meaning: 女漁童；從事捕魚的女孩
sentences: A fishergirl carried bait down to the pier. 一名女漁童把魚餌帶到碼頭。
The young fishergirl learned to tie strong knots. 那名年輕女漁童學會了打牢固的結。

meaning: 漁夫；捕魚的人
sentences: The fisherman repaired his net by the shore. 那名漁夫在岸邊修理漁網。
An old fisherman told us about the tide. 一位老漁夫告訴我們潮汐的情況。

meaning: 漁民；以捕魚為生的人們
sentences: Coastal fisherpeople shared weather warnings by radio. 沿海漁民透過無線電分享天氣警報。
Seasonal fisherpeople repaired their boats after winter. 季節性漁民在冬季過後修理船隻。

meaning: 女漁夫；以釣魚或捕魚為業餘或職業的女性
sentences: A fisherwoman cast her line beside the quiet lake. 一名女釣客在寧靜的湖邊拋出釣線。
The fisherwoman released the trout after weighing it. 那名女釣客量過鱒魚重量後把牠放回水中。

meaning: 漁業；漁場
sentences: The local fishery supports many families. 當地漁業養活了許多家庭。
Strict rules protect the coastal fishery. 嚴格的規定保護了沿海漁場。

meaning: 小魚；幼魚
sentences: A fishet darted beneath the shallow water. 一條小魚在淺水下快速游過。
The heron swallowed a fishet beside the reeds. 鷺鳥在蘆葦旁吞下一條小魚。

meaning: 魚眼鏡頭；能拍攝約一百八十度超廣角影像的鏡頭。
sentences: Photographers choose a fisheye for sweeping interiors. 攝影師選用魚眼鏡頭拍攝寬廣的室內景象。
The fisheye bends straight walls into curves. 魚眼鏡頭會把直牆拍成彎曲形狀。

meaning: 繫在吊艇架上的釣具
sentences: A fishfall hangs from a boat's davit. 一套吊艇架釣具懸掛在船上的吊艇架上。
Sailors secured the fishfall before lifting the catch. 水手在吊起漁獲前固定好吊艇架釣具。

meaning: 魚很多的；充滿魚的。
sentences: That cove is fishful after the spring rains. 春雨過後，那個海灣魚群豐富。
A fishful stream drew herons to the reeds. 一條魚多的溪流吸引了蒼鷺來到蘆葦旁。

meaning: 河流或海岸用來捕魚的水壩、堰或圍欄
sentences: A fishgarth trapped salmon as the tide receded. 潮水退去時，一座魚堰困住了鮭魚。
Villagers repaired the fishgarth with fresh wooden stakes. 村民用新的木樁修理魚堰。

meaning: 有兩個以上帶刺尖端的魚叉。
sentences: Harbor workers used a fishgig in shallow water. 港口工人在淺水中使用多刺魚叉。
The fishgig held a slippery eel securely. 那把魚叉牢牢叉住了一條滑溜的鰻魚。

meaning: 成為魚的狀態；魚類身分
sentences: The poem imagines fishhood as a life beneath the waves. 那首詩把魚類身分想像成波浪下的生活。
His story humorously celebrates fishhood and freedom. 他的故事幽默地歌頌魚類身分與自由。

meaning: 通常帶有倒刺、用來捕魚的鉤子；魚鉤
sentences: A fishhook caught on the edge of the wooden dock. 一枚魚鉤勾住了木碼頭邊緣。
She removed the fishhook from the bait carefully. 她小心地從魚餌上取下魚鉤。

meaning: 魚鉤；用來捕魚的帶倒刺鉤子
sentences: Several fishhooks lay inside the tackle box. 幾枚魚鉤放在釣具盒裡。
Anglers sharpened their fishhooks before leaving shore. 釣客在離岸前磨利魚鉤。

meaning: 存放、處理或販售魚貨的房屋。
sentences: The fishhouse smelled of salt and smoke. 那間魚貨屋充滿鹽和煙的氣味。
Boats unloaded cod beside the fishhouse. 船隻在魚貨屋旁卸下鱈魚。

meaning: 改為魚
sentences: Older manuals use fishify to mean to change to fish. 較舊的手冊使用 改為魚 來表示更改為 Fish。
In practice, people fishify when that action is required. 實際上，當需要採取行動時，人們就會捕魚。

meaning: 以一種可疑的方式。如何用 魚腥味造句
sentences: Writers use fishily to mean in a fishy manner. How to use fishily in a sentence. 作家們用「以一種可疑的方式。如何用 魚腥味造句」來表示「以一種可疑的方式」。如何在句子中使用魚腥味。
She acted fishily when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她就會表現得很狡猾。

meaning: 魚腥味；像魚的特質；可疑之處
sentences: A strong fishiness filled the kitchen after cooking. 烹煮後，廚房裡充滿濃重的魚腥味。
The strange fishiness of the offer made her hesitate. 那項提議的可疑之處讓她猶豫。

meaning: 捕魚的動作。
sentences: We had a good day's fishing at the weekend. 週末我們釣魚了一天。
The term fishing refers to The act of catching fish. 釣魚一詞是指捕魚的行為。

meaning: 以尋找魚類的方式；帶著釣魚的意圖（罕用）。
sentences: She scanned the tide fishingly for movement. 她帶著找魚的意圖搜尋潮水中的動靜。
He watched the reeds fishingly all morning. 他整個早上都帶著釣魚的心思觀察蘆葦。

meaning: 沒有魚的。
sentences: Streams without shade often become fishless. 缺乏遮蔭的溪流常會變得沒有魚。
The pond stayed fishless after the spill. 污染物洩漏後，那座池塘一直沒有魚。

meaning: 很小的魚
sentences: A tiny fishlet darted through the reeds. 一條小魚穿過蘆葦叢竄去。
The aquarium held one fishlet overnight. 那座水族箱讓一條小魚過了一夜。

meaning: 像魚的；具有魚的形態或特徵的。
sentences: Its fishlike tail moved under the ice. 它像魚一樣的尾巴在冰下擺動。
The robot has a fishlike body. 那台機器人有魚形身體。

meaning: 釣魚用的魚線
sentences: Mara replaced the fishline before noon. 瑪拉在中午前換好了魚線。
Under the pier, our fishline caught a perch. 在碼頭下，我們的魚線釣到了一條鱸魚。

meaning: 小魚；幼魚。
sentences: A fishling hid among the water plants. 一條小魚躲在水草之間。
The heron swallowed one fishling whole. 蒼鷺把一條小魚整條吞下。

meaning: 清理魚以備烹調的人
sentences: At dawn, the fishman cleaned the catch. 黎明時，魚工清理了捕獲的魚。
This fishman removes every bone carefully. 這名魚工仔細去除每根魚刺。

meaning: 魚販；販售魚和海鮮的人
sentences: The fishmonger weighed two fresh crabs. 魚販秤了兩隻新鮮螃蟹。
Near closing time, the fishmonger lowered prices. 接近打烊時，魚販降了價。

meaning: 魚嘴形的開口或接縫。
sentences: The fishmouth opening widened under pressure. 魚嘴形開口在壓力下變寬。
A fishmouth joint joined the two metal strips. 魚嘴形接縫把兩條金屬片接在一起。

meaning: 用來連接或加固對接接頭的鋼板。
sentences: Rail crews bolted a fishplate across the joint. 鐵路工人用螺栓把魚尾板固定在接頭兩側。
The cracked fishplate needed immediate replacement. 裂開的魚尾板需要立即更換。

meaning: 養魚的池塘
sentences: Our fishpond needs clean water today. 我們的魚池今天需要乾淨的水。
Several carp circled the fishpond slowly. 幾條鯉魚在魚池裡緩慢繞游。

meaning: 魚池；養魚或聚魚的水池
sentences: Children watched minnows in the fishpool. 孩子們看著魚池裡的小魚。
The farmer deepened the fishpool last spring. 農夫去年春天把魚池挖深了。

meaning: 沉入水中捕魚或捕捉其他水生動物的籃筐或容器
sentences: The crew lowered a fishpot beside the reef. 船員把一個捕魚籠放到礁石旁。
By sunset, that fishpot held three lobsters. 日落前，那個捕魚籠裡有三隻龍蝦。

meaning: 使用魚籠捕魚的人
sentences: The fishpotter checked each trap at low tide. 魚籠捕魚人趁退潮檢查每個陷阱。
A skilled fishpotter repairs damaged baskets quickly. 熟練的魚籠捕魚人很快就能修好損壞的籃子。

meaning: 固定在木樁上的捕魚網；魚堰
sentences: The fishpound guided mullet into a narrow channel. 魚堰把烏魚引進狹窄的水道。
Fishermen mended the fishpound after the storm. 暴風雨後，漁民修補了魚堰。

meaning: 魚的皮；魚皮
sentences: The cook dried fishskin for a crispy garnish. 廚師把魚皮曬乾，做成酥脆的配料。
This wallet is made from durable fishskin. 這個錢包是用耐用的魚皮製成的。

meaning: 將飛機尾部左右擺動以降低速度，尤其是在降落時。如何用魚尾造句
sentences: Older manuals use fishtail to mean to swing the tail of an airplane from side to side to reduce speed especially when landing. How to use fishtail in a sentence. 較舊的手冊使用魚尾意味著將飛機的尾部左右擺動以降低速度，特別是在著陸時。如何在句子中使用魚尾。
In practice, people fishtail when that action is required. 實際上，當需要採取這種行動時，人們會採取尾隨行動。

meaning: 讓魚繞過瀑布或水壩的通道；魚梯
sentences: Salmon used the fishway to pass the dam. 鮭魚利用魚梯越過水壩。
Workers cleared leaves from the fishway. 工人清除了魚道裡的落葉。

meaning: 墨西哥茶，一種可作藥用或調味的植物。
sentences: Mexican cooks add fishweed to bean dishes. 墨西哥廚師把墨西哥茶加入豆類料理。
The leaves of fishweed release a sharp herbal scent. 墨西哥茶的葉子散發濃烈草本香氣。

meaning: 攔截魚群的魚堰或捕魚柵
sentences: The fishweir trapped fish as the tide fell. 潮水退去時，魚堰攔住了魚群。
Villagers built a fishweir from stones and stakes. 村民用石頭和木樁築起魚堰。

meaning: 女魚販；也指粗魯吵鬧的女人
sentences: The fishwife sold mackerel beside the harbor. 女魚販在港口旁販售鯖魚。
In the old tale, a fishwife shouted at the thief. 在那則古老故事裡，一名女魚販對小偷大喊。

meaning: 女魚販；販售魚的女人
sentences: The fishwoman carried a basket of sardines. 女魚販提著一籃沙丁魚。
At the market, one fishwoman greeted every customer. 市場裡，一名女魚販向每位顧客問候。

meaning: 草莓衛矛，一種結鮮紅果實的灌木（植物學）。
sentences: The fishwood bears bright red fruit in autumn. 魚木在秋天結出鮮紅果實。
A fishwood shrub grew beside the path. 一株魚木灌木長在小徑旁。

meaning: 從事捕魚、加工或販售魚類的人
sentences: Every fishworker wore boots on the wet deck. 每名漁業工人都在濕甲板上穿著靴子。
The fishworker sorted the morning catch by size. 漁業工人依大小分揀早上的漁獲。

meaning: 魚類加工廠
sentences: The fishworks processed tuna near the harbor. 那座魚類加工廠在港口附近加工鮪魚。
Fresh deliveries reached the fishworks before sunrise. 新鮮貨物在日出前送達魚類加工廠。

meaning: 用作釣魚餌料的蚯蚓
sentences: Leo placed a fishworm on the small hook. 里歐把一條魚餌蚯蚓掛上小鉤。
The trout seized the fishworm near the bank. 鱒魚在河岸附近咬住了魚餌蚯蚓。

meaning: 屬於、來自或類似魚的。
sentences: What is that fishy odor? 那股魚腥味是什麼？
Something described as fishy is of, from, or similar to fish. 被描述為「腥味」的東西屬於魚、來自魚或與魚相似。

meaning: 處理或販售魚類的場地；魚場
sentences: Workers unloaded crates in the fishyard. 工人們在魚場卸下板條箱。
The fishyard smelled strongly of the morning catch. 魚場散發著早晨漁獲的濃重氣味。

meaning: 一種古老且少見的魚類名稱。
sentences: An antiquarian lexicon lists fisnoga as an old fish name. 一本古語詞典把它列為古老的魚名。
No modern catalog uses fisnoga often. 現代目錄很少使用這個魚名。

meaning: 裂開的；分裂成狹長裂片的。
sentences: A fissate leaf divides into narrow lobes. 一片裂葉分成狹長的裂片。
The fissate margin gives the plant a jagged edge. 這種裂葉的邊緣使植物呈現鋸齒狀。

meaning: 肋脈或肋部裂分的（植物學）。
sentences: A fissicostate leaf has divided ribs. 肋脈裂分的葉片具有分叉肋脈。
The fissicostate pattern is clear under magnification. 放大後可清楚看見肋部裂分的紋理。

meaning: 指或趾分裂、彼此分開的。
sentences: Zoologists described the bird as fissidactyl. 動物學家形容那隻鳥的趾分裂而分開。
A fissidactyl foot has separated digits. 分趾的足部具有彼此分開的趾。

meaning: 屬於裂葉蘚科或與其有關的；其葉片常分成兩列。
sentences: Mosses called fissidentaceous clasp the stem in two rows. 稱為裂葉蘚科的苔蘚以兩列葉片抱住莖部。
The fissidentaceous form is common in humid forests. 這種裂葉蘚科形態常見於潮濕森林。

meaning: 容易沿平面裂開的；可裂變的。
sentences: Nuclear fuel must contain fissile material. 核燃料必須含有可裂變材料。
The fissile shale split into thin sheets. 易裂的頁岩分成一片片薄層。

meaning: 容易裂開或發生裂變的性質。
sentences: The fissileness of the shale aids extraction. 頁岩易裂的性質有助於開採。
Engineers measured fissileness before cutting the stone. 工程師在切割石材前測量了它的易裂性。

meaning: 屬於裂舌類或與裂舌類有關的。
sentences: Zoological texts describe a fissilingual tongue. 動物學文獻描述裂舌類的舌頭。
The fissilingual trait separates this group from its relatives. 裂舌特徵使這個類群與近親有所區別。

meaning: 材料容易沿平面裂開的性質；可裂性。
sentences: Geologists use fissility to sort shale types. 地質學家利用可裂性來區分頁岩類型。
High fissility lets the rock form thin flakes. 高可裂性讓岩石形成薄片。

meaning: 分裂，裂變
sentences: Nuclear fission provides a significant amount of energy. 核分裂提供了大量的能量。
The process of cell fission is fundamental to life. 細胞分裂過程是生命的基礎。

meaning: 能發生核裂變的。
sentences: This fissionable uranium requires careful storage. 這種可裂變的鈾需要小心儲存。
The reactor uses a fissionable isotope. 這座反應爐使用可裂變同位素。

meaning: 手掌或足掌裂分至接近基部的（動物學）。
sentences: A fissipalmate foot has deeply separated toes. 掌趾深裂的足部有分得很開的趾。
The fissipalmate wing ends in distinct digits. 掌部裂分的翼端形成明顯指狀部分。

meaning: 手掌或足掌裂分成數個指、趾狀部分的狀態。
sentences: The fissipalmation of the foot aids climbing. 足部的掌趾裂分有助於攀爬。
Researchers recorded fissipalmation in the specimen. 研究人員記錄了那個標本的掌趾裂分。

meaning: 透過分裂成兩部分而繁殖或分開。
sentences: The process called fissiparation produces two daughter cells. 稱為裂殖的過程會產生兩個子細胞。
The culture increased through fissiparation. 這批培養物透過裂殖而增加。

meaning: 以分裂方式繁殖的現象或觀念。
sentences: Some organisms reproduce through fissiparism. 某些生物透過裂殖繁殖。
The text compares fissiparism with budding. 這篇文字比較裂殖與出芽生殖。

meaning: 生物以分裂成兩個個體的方式繁殖。
sentences: Certain microbes show the trait of fissiparity under stress. 某些微生物在壓力下會展現裂殖特性。
The process of fissiparity allows rapid population growth. 裂殖能讓族群快速增長。

meaning: 以分裂方式繁殖的；容易分裂成部分的。
sentences: Certain cells are fissiparous under ideal conditions. 某些細胞在理想條件下會以分裂方式繁殖。
A fissiparous colony divides into smaller groups. 會分裂的群體分成較小的群組。

meaning: 以分裂成部分的方式；透過裂殖地。
sentences: The cells multiplied fissiparously in warm water. 這些細胞在溫水中透過裂殖增生。
The colony spread fissiparously across the surface. 這個群體以分裂方式擴散到表面。

meaning: 以分裂方式繁殖或分裂的性質。
sentences: The fissiparousness of the organism aids survival. 這種生物的裂殖性有助於生存。
Scientists linked fissiparousness to rapid growth. 科學家把裂殖性與快速生長連結起來。

meaning: 腳趾從基部彼此分開的；裂趾的。
sentences: A fissiped paw has toes separated to the base. 裂趾的爪子在基部就分開。
The fissiped animal left five clear tracks. 那種裂趾動物留下五趾清晰的足跡。

meaning: 與裂趾動物或裂趾構造有關的。
sentences: Several animals show fissipedal limbs. 幾種動物具有裂趾構造的四肢。
The fissipedal pattern appears in several predators. 這種裂趾形態出現在數種掠食動物身上。

meaning: 腳趾從基部分開的；裂趾的。
sentences: Its fissipedate feet spread across the mud. 它的裂趾足在泥地上張開。
A fissipedate track shows separate toes. 裂趾足跡顯示趾頭彼此分開。

meaning: 裂趾的；與裂趾動物有關的。
sentences: The paw was fissipedial and left a narrow print. 那隻爪子是裂趾的，留下狹長腳印。
The fissipedial anatomy helps identify the mammal. 裂趾解剖構造有助於辨認這種哺乳動物。

meaning: 喙端裂開或具有分叉嘴端的（鳥類學）。
sentences: A fissirostral bird has a cleft bill. 喙端裂開的鳥具有分叉的嘴。
The fissirostral shape helps the bird grasp food. 這種裂喙形狀幫助鳥抓住食物。

meaning: 具有裂開喙端的；裂喙的。
sentences: A fissirostrate beak opens at the tip. 裂喙的喙在尖端張開。
The fissirostrate bird fed on soft fruit. 這隻裂喙鳥以柔軟水果為食。

meaning: 與裂變有關的；傾向於裂開或分裂的。
sentences: Such fissive forces split the mineral along its planes. 這種裂變力使礦物沿著平面裂開。
The fissive reaction releases nuclear energy. 裂變反應會釋放核能。

meaning: 屬於裂隙的；與裂縫有關的。
sentences: The pain was fissural and followed the injury. 疼痛來自裂隙部位，並在受傷後出現。
The scan showed fissural damage in the bone. 掃描顯示骨骼有裂隙損傷。

meaning: 形成裂縫或出現裂縫的狀態。
sentences: The wall showed fissuration after the quake. 牆面在地震後出現裂縫。
Repeated freezing caused fissuration in the wall. 反覆結冰使牆面出現裂縫。

meaning: 狹長而有一定深度的裂縫或裂口。
sentences: Rain widened a fissure in the cliff. 雨水擴大了懸崖上的裂縫。
The doctor examined a fissure in the skin. 醫生檢查了皮膚上的裂口。

meaning: 沒有裂縫的；表面完整的。
sentences: A fissureless surface resists water entry. 無裂縫的表面能防止水分滲入。
The mason selected a fissureless stone. 石匠挑選了一塊沒有裂縫的石頭。

meaning: 形狀像裂縫的。
sentences: Its fissuriform mark resembled a narrow crack. 它的裂縫狀標記像一道狹窄裂痕。
A fissuriform opening crossed the lacquer. 裂縫狀開口穿過了漆層。

meaning: 充滿裂縫的；裂縫很多的。
sentences: The rock was fissury and crumbled under pressure. 那塊岩石充滿裂縫，在壓力下碎裂。
The fissury pavement trapped rainwater. 裂縫很多的路面積住了雨水。

meaning: 拳頭
sentences: He hit the table with his fist in anger after hearing the news. 聽到消息後，他憤怒地用拳頭敲桌子。
Please keep your fists closed and stay focused during the match. 比賽期間請緊握拳頭並保持專注。

meaning: 手握成拳的；拳頭狀的。
sentences: He stood fisted beside the locked gate. 他握緊拳頭站在上鎖的門旁。
Her fisted hand shook with anger. 她握成拳頭的手因憤怒而顫抖。

meaning: 用拳頭打擊的人。
sentences: A fister challenged the champion in the ring. 一名拳擊手在擂台上挑戰冠軍。
The tale portrays the fister as stubborn. 那則故事把這名拳擊手描寫得很固執。

meaning: 一把的量；能握在拳頭中的少量。
sentences: She gathered a fistful of rice. 她抓起一把米。
A fistful of coins filled his palm. 一把硬幣填滿了他的手掌。

meaning: 拳擊界；拳擊運動的世界。
sentences: Fans call this world fistiana. 粉絲把這個世界稱為拳擊界。
His memoir describes life in fistiana. 他的回憶錄描述了拳擊界的生活。

meaning: 拳擊的；與拳頭搏鬥有關的。
sentences: The contests were fistic and drew large crowds. 這些拳擊比賽吸引了大批人群。
The novel contains a brief fistic struggle. 那部小說有一段短暫的拳鬥。

meaning: 拳頭的；與拳擊有關的。
sentences: The blow was fistical and broke the wooden board. 那記拳擊打斷了木板。
The fistical training strengthened his wrists. 拳擊訓練強化了他的手腕。

meaning: 拳鬥；用拳頭打架
sentences: The fisticuff ended before either fighter fell. 拳鬥在任何一名鬥士倒下前就結束了。
A brief fisticuff broke out near the gate. 大門附近爆發了一場短暫的拳鬥。

meaning: 用拳頭打架的人；拳鬥者
sentences: The fisticuffer trained every morning at the gym. 那名拳鬥者每天早上都在健身房訓練。
A former fisticuffer now teaches safe boxing. 一名前拳鬥者如今教授安全的拳擊技巧。

meaning: 拳鬥；以拳頭互毆的行為
