The term fixation refers to recording a creative work in a medium of expression for more than a transitory duration, thereby satisfying the "fixation" requirement for the purposes of copyright law. 術語「固定」是指在表達媒介中記錄創意作品一段時間以上，從而滿足版權法中的「固定」要求。

meaning: 固定劑；使染料、顏料或標本穩定的物質
sentences: The laboratory added fixative to preserve the tissue. 實驗室加入固定劑保存組織。
Hair spray can act as a fixative for a stage style. 髮膠可以作為舞臺造型的固定劑。

meaning: 固定肌；移動身體其他部分時穩定附著處的肌肉
sentences: The fixator held the shoulder steady during the lift. 固定肌在抬舉時穩定了肩膀。
A strong fixator helps the moving limb work smoothly. 強健的固定肌能讓活動中的肢體順暢運作。

meaning: 固定裝置；用來穩定物體的位置或部位的器具
sentences: The surgeon used a fixature to hold the bone still. 外科醫師用固定裝置讓骨頭保持不動。
A metal fixature kept the frame in exact alignment. 金屬固定器讓框架保持精確對齊。

meaning: 無法改變或改變。
sentences: I work fixed hours for a fixed salary. 我工作固定時間，拿固定薪水。
Every religion has its own fixed ideas. 每個宗教都有自己固定的觀念。

meaning: 以固定的方式。如何使用固定造句
sentences: Writers use fixedly to mean in a fixed manner. How to use fixedly in a sentence. 作家使用固定地來表示以固定的方式。如何在句子中使用固定。
She acted fixedly when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她就採取固定的行動。

meaning: 固定性；不變或穩定的狀態
sentences: The fixedness of the statue made it a useful landmark. 雕像的固定位置讓它成為有用的地標。
Her fixedness of purpose helped her finish the task. 她堅定不移的目標讓她完成了任務。

meaning: 修復的代理人名詞：修復的人或修復的人。
sentences: The term fixer refers to agent noun of fix: one who, or that which, fixes. 修復者一詞指的是修復的代理名詞：修復的人或修復的人。
The lesson introduced fixer as a useful term to understand. 本課程介紹了修復程序作為一個需要理解的有用術語。

meaning: 固定性；不易移動或改變的狀態
sentences: The fixidity of the dried resin made cutting difficult. 乾燥樹脂的固定性讓切割變得困難。
Researchers measured the fixidity of the mineral ore. 研究人員測量了礦石的穩定固定性。

meaning: 修理或固定的行為；修理工作
sentences: Fixing the loose hinge took only ten minutes. 修理鬆動的鉸鏈只花了十分鐘。
The fixing of the sign prevented it from falling. 固定招牌防止它掉落。

meaning: 固定或穩定的狀態；不變性
sentences: The fixity of the rule surprised the new workers. 規則的不變性讓新工人感到驚訝。
A firm fixity kept the bridge joint secure. 穩固的固定性讓橋接處保持安全。

meaning: 配備、作為或在固定裝置中。
sentences: The device is available in both handheld and fixtured models. 該設備有手持式和固定式兩種型號。
To fixture means to furnish with, as, or in a fixture. 固定裝置的意思是用、作為或在固定裝置中提供。

meaning: 沒有固定裝置的；不含永久配件的
sentences: The fixtureless room can be arranged for many uses. 沒有固定裝置的房間可以安排成多種用途。
A fixtureless display was easy to move after the fair. 沒有永久配件的展示在展覽後很容易移動。

meaning: 固定位置；穩定狀態；牢固性
sentences: The old oak kept its fixure through many storms. 那棵老橡樹歷經多場暴風雨仍穩固不移。
The statue’s fixure made it impossible to shift by hand. 雕像固定得很牢，徒手無法移動。

meaning: 一種含鉛、銀、銻、硫的灰色硫化物礦物
sentences: The geologist identified fizelyite in the dark ore. 地質學家在深色礦石中辨認出這種礦物。
Fizelyite has a metallic lead-gray appearance. 這種礦物呈金屬鉛灰色外觀。

meaning: 愛調情的女孩或女人
sentences: The play introduces a fizgig who charms every guest. 這齣戲介紹了一位迷倒每名客人的調情女子。
That lively fizgig teased the musicians from the doorway. 那名活潑的調情女子在門口逗弄樂手。

meaning: 快速噴出氣泡流。
sentences: I poured a cola and waited for the fizz to settle down before topping off the glass. 我倒了一杯可樂，等嘶嘶聲平息後才把杯子倒掉。
The term fizz refers to An emission of a rapid stream of bubbles. 術語“嘶嘶”是指快速噴出的氣泡流。

meaning: 板球中的快速球
sentences: The bowler surprised the batter with a fizzer. 投球手用一記快速球讓擊球手措手不及。
A sharp fizzer broke past the batter’s bat. 一記凌厲的快速球穿過了擊球手的球棒。

meaning: 嘶嘶聲；逐漸無力或失敗
sentences: The fuse ended with a soft fizzle. 引信以輕微的嘶嘶聲結束。
The grand plan became a fizzle after funding vanished. 資金消失後，宏大計畫變成了虎頭蛇尾的失敗。

meaning: 有氣泡的；起泡的
sentences: The fizzy drink tickled her nose. 這杯起泡飲料讓她的鼻子發癢。
He poured fizzy water over the fruit. 他把有氣泡的水倒在水果上。

meaning: 四分之一；四等分之一的量
sentences: The merchant measured a fjarding of grain. 商人量出四分之一份穀物。
One fjarding filled a small wooden vessel. 四分之一份裝滿了一個小木容器。

meaning: 斯堪地那維亞的荒蕪岩石高原
sentences: The hikers crossed a barren fjeld under gray skies. 登山客在灰色天空下穿越荒蕪高原。
Snow covered the fjeld above the tree line. 積雪覆蓋了林木線以上的高原。

meaning: 四分之一；古老的四分之一容量單位
sentences: The trader sold a fjerding of butter. 商人賣出四分之一桶奶油。
A fjerding once measured part of a barrel’s contents. 四分之一容量單位過去用來量桶中部分內容物。

meaning: 使震驚得目瞪口呆
sentences: The sudden announcement flabbergasted everyone. 突如其來的宣布讓所有人目瞪口呆。
The final price may flabbergast even careful buyers. 最後價格可能讓即使謹慎的買家也目瞪口呆。

meaning: 目瞪口呆；極度震驚的狀態
sentences: Flabbergastation silenced the room after the verdict. 判決宣布後，極度震驚讓房間一片寂靜。
Her face showed pure flabbergastation at the news. 她的臉因那則消息而露出純粹的震驚。

meaning: 鬆軟地
sentences: Writers use flabbily to mean in a flabby manner. 作家使用 鬆軟地 來表示以一種不穩定的方式。
She acted flabbily when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她表現得軟弱無力。

meaning: 鬆弛；缺乏彈性或結實度的狀態
sentences: The flabbiness of the old cushion made it uncomfortable. 舊坐墊的鬆弛讓人坐得不舒服。
Regular exercise can reduce muscle flabbiness. 規律運動可以減少肌肉鬆弛。

meaning: 鬆弛的；缺乏彈性或力量的
sentences: The flabby dough spread across the tray. 鬆軟的麵團在烤盤上攤開。
His flabby grip could not hold the heavy bag. 他無力的握力抓不住沉重袋子。

meaning: 振毛；苔蘚蟲用來產生水流的鞭狀構造
sentences: The flabellarium moved water across the tiny colony. 振毛讓水流穿過微小的群體。
A zoologist viewed the flabellarium under a microscope. 動物學家在顯微鏡下觀察振毛。

meaning: 呈扇形的；（生物學）部件扁平並向一側延長的
sentences: The leaf's edge is flabellate and finely divided. 葉緣呈扇形，並且細分成許多小片。
A flabellate antenna spreads like a small fan. 扇形觸角像小扇子一樣展開。

meaning: 用扇子或類似器具扇涼的行為
sentences: During surgery, flabellation kept the bandaged limb cool. 手術時，扇涼使包紮的肢體保持涼爽。
Gentle flabellation eased the heat around the injured arm. 輕柔的扇風減輕了受傷手臂周圍的熱感。

meaning: 葉片呈扇形或似扇形的
sentences: A palm can be flabellifoliate when its leaves spread in broad fans. 棕櫚的葉片向外展成寬扇形時，便可稱為扇葉狀。
The flabellifoliate leaves opened fully in the sun. 扇葉狀的葉片在陽光下完全展開。

meaning: 扇形的；形狀像扇子的
sentences: This coral has a flabelliform outline. 這株珊瑚的輪廓呈扇形。
A flabelliform fin helped the fish turn sharply. 扇形的鰭幫助魚快速轉向。

meaning: （葉片）葉脈從基部呈扇狀放射的
sentences: Several leaves look flabellinerved near the pond. 池塘邊有幾片葉子的葉脈從基部呈扇狀放射。
The flabellinerved leaf shows straight veins from one base. 這片扇脈葉的直葉脈都從同一個基部伸出。

meaning: 宗教或宮廷儀式使用的大型扇子
sentences: A silver flabellum moved beside the altar. 一把銀色儀式扇在祭壇旁移動。
Two attendants carried the flabellum during worship. 兩名侍從在禮拜時抬著儀式扇。

meaning: 教會儀式用的扇子
sentences: The priest carried a flabrum during the procession. 牧師在遊行時拿著一把儀式扇。
A silver flabrum hung in the old chapel. 一把銀製儀式扇掛在古老的小教堂裡。

meaning: 柔軟無力的；缺乏挺度或彈性的
sentences: After the long heat, the lettuce leaves became flaccid. 長時間受熱後，萵苣葉變得柔軟無力。
The flaccid rope could not hold the heavy load. 那條鬆軟的繩子無法承受重物。

meaning: 柔軟無力、鬆弛或缺乏彈性的狀態
sentences: The patient's flaccidity made standing difficult. 病人的肌肉鬆弛，使站立變得困難。
Prolonged storage caused flaccidity in the rubber seal. 長期存放使橡膠密封圈失去彈性。

meaning: 不堅固或僵硬；另外：缺乏正常或年輕時的堅定性。如何用 鬆弛造句
sentences: Writers use flaccidly to mean not firm or stiff; also: lacking normal or youthful firmness. How to use flaccid in a sentence. 作家們用「fflacyly」來表示「不堅定」或「僵硬」；另外：缺乏正常或年輕時的堅定性。如何在句子中使用鬆弛。
She acted flaccidly when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她表現得軟弱無力。

meaning: 柔軟無力、鬆弛或缺乏挺度的狀態
sentences: Muscle flaccidness slowed the runner's recovery. 肌肉鬆弛拖慢了跑者的復原。
The fabric's flaccidness made the curtain hang unevenly. 布料太軟，使窗簾垂掛不均。

meaning: 蠶和其他毛毛蟲的致命疾病，會造成食慾不振、遲鈍、腹瀉與身體軟弱
sentences: Silkworms with flacherie lose their appetite. 患有軟化病的蠶會失去食慾。
Severe flacherie makes caterpillars weak and limp. 嚴重的軟化病會使毛毛蟲虛弱無力。

meaning: 公關人員；宣傳代理人
sentences: The campaign hired a flack to answer journalists' questions. 競選團隊聘請公關人員回答記者提問。
A skilled flack promoted the actor's new film. 一名熟練的宣傳代理人替演員宣傳新片。

meaning: 擔任公關或替人宣傳
sentences: She flacked for the band during its first tour. 她在樂團首次巡演期間替樂團做公關。
He flacked for the charity at several public events. 他在幾場公開活動中替慈善機構宣傳。

meaning: 振翅、飄動或心悸
sentences: A moth's wing began to flacker beside the lamp. 一隻蛾的翅膀開始在燈旁振動。
Her heart seemed to flacker after the sudden fright. 突然受驚後，她的心似乎一陣悸動。

meaning: 小型桶狀瓶或酒壺
sentences: The tavern kept a flacket of cider on the shelf. 酒館在架上放著一個裝蘋果酒的桶狀瓶。
A wooden flacket held the traveller's drink. 一個木製小酒壺裝著旅人的飲料。

meaning: 屬於或曾屬於大風子科植物的
sentences: This shrub is flacourtiaceous and grows in warm forests. 這種灌木屬於大風子科，生長在溫暖的森林裡。
The flacourtiaceous fruit develops beneath a thorny branch. 這種大風子科植物的果實在多刺枝條下方發育。

meaning: 拍動、飄動；拍翅或飄動的一下
sentences: Wind made the pennant flaff above the harbor. 風吹得小旗在港口上方飄動。
The duck began to flaff its wings on the water. 那隻鴨子開始在水面上拍動翅膀。

meaning: 反覆拍動或飄動；發出拍動聲
sentences: Clouds flaffer across the ridge before the storm. 暴風雨前，雲層掠過山脊。
The loose cloth continued to flaffer in the wind. 鬆垂的布料持續在風中飄動。

meaning: 旗幟
sentences: The national flag was waving proudly in the strong morning breeze. 國旗在強勁的晨風中自豪地飄揚。
White flags are often used as a universal symbol of peace or surrender. 白旗常被用作和平或投降的通用象徵。

meaning: 航行比賽中作為標誌的船；旗艦
sentences: The flagboat marked the turning point in the sailing race. 標誌船標出了帆船賽的轉彎點。
The admiral's flagboat led the fleet into the bay. 海軍上將的旗艦帶領艦隊駛入海灣。

meaning: 以鞭打自己作為公開懺悔的人
sentences: A flagellant walked barefoot through the town in penance. 一名鞭笞者為了懺悔赤腳走過城鎮。
The historian described a flagellant's public ritual. 歷史學家描述了一名鞭笞者的公開儀式。

meaning: 以鞭打自己作為宗教懺悔的做法
sentences: Medieval flagellantism involved public acts of self-punishment. 中世紀的鞭笞主義包含公開自我懲罰的行為。
The lecture examined flagellantism in religious history. 這場講座探討宗教史中的鞭笞主義。

meaning: 鞭毛的；與鞭毛有關的
sentences: The cell has flagellar motion in fresh water. 這個細胞在淡水中靠鞭毛運動。
A flagellar filament propels the tiny organism forward. 鞭毛絲推動微小生物向前移動。

meaning: 屬於鞭毛科植物的
sentences: This grass is flagellariaceous and climbs with a tendril. 這種草屬於鞭毛科，會用卷鬚攀爬。
The flagellariaceous plant bears small flowers in a panicle. 這種鞭毛科植物在圓錐花序中開出小花。

meaning: 具鞭毛的；鞭毛蟲的
sentences: The organism is flagellate and swims with one long thread. 這種生物具鞭毛，靠一條長絲游動。
A flagellate cell changed direction near the drop's edge. 一個鞭毛細胞在液滴邊緣附近改變了方向。

meaning: 具有鞭毛的
sentences: The algae are flagellated by two short structures. 這些藻類具有兩條短鞭毛。
A flagellated sperm cell moved toward the egg. 一個具鞭毛的精子細胞朝卵細胞移動。

meaning: 鞭打或鞭笞的行為；鞭笞儀式
sentences: The ritual involved flagellation as an act of penance. 這項儀式把鞭笞作為懺悔行為。
The painting depicts flagellation beside a stone pillar. 這幅畫描繪在石柱旁進行鞭笞。

meaning: 與鞭打或鞭笞有關的
sentences: A flagellative ritual took place before the procession. 遊行前舉行了一項鞭笞儀式。
The novel contains a flagellative scene from a monastery. 這部小說描寫修道院中的鞭笞場景。

meaning: 鞭打者；施行鞭笞的人
sentences: The flagellator raised the whip during the ceremony. 鞭打者在儀式中舉起鞭子。
A flagellator led the penitents through the gate. 一名鞭打者帶領懺悔者穿過大門。

meaning: 與鞭打或鞭笞有關的
sentences: Its flagellatory imagery centers on ritual punishment. 它的鞭笞意象以儀式性懲罰為核心。
The flagellatory text describes a painful vow. 這段鞭笞相關文字描述了一個痛苦的誓願。

meaning: 帶有鞭毛的；具有鞭毛構造的
sentences: A flagelliferous cell swims through the warm pond. 帶有鞭毛的細胞在溫暖的池塘中游動。
The flagelliferous spore moves by a flexible appendage. 具鞭毛的孢子靠柔軟附屬物移動。

meaning: 細長、柔軟並呈鞭狀的
sentences: The tail is flagelliform and tapers to a fine point. 這條尾巴細長柔軟，末端逐漸變細。
A flagelliform branch trailed behind the climbing plant. 一根鞭狀枝條拖在攀爬植物後方。

meaning: 奉行鞭笞修行的人；鞭笞者
sentences: A flagellist joined the penitential procession at dawn. 一名鞭笞修行者在黎明加入懺悔遊行。
The historian identified the figure as a flagellist. 歷史學家認出那個人物是鞭笞修行者。

meaning: 由鞭毛原生動物引起的感染或疾病
sentences: Untreated flagellosis can cause severe intestinal illness. 未治療的鞭毛蟲病可能造成嚴重腸道疾病。
The veterinarian tested the fish for flagellosis. 獸醫檢查魚是否感染鞭毛蟲病。

meaning: 具有鞭狀附屬物的鞭毛孢子或游動孢子
sentences: Each flagellula carries a slender appendage for swimming. 每個鞭毛孢子都帶有用來游動的細長附屬物。
A flagellula left the alga and moved through the water. 一個鞭毛孢子離開藻類，在水中移動。

meaning: 許多原生生物或細胞的細長鞭狀附屬物
sentences: The protozoan's flagellum drives it through the droplet. 這種原生生物的鞭毛推動它穿過液滴。
A sperm uses its flagellum to travel toward the egg. 精子利用鞭毛朝卵細胞前進。

meaning: 類似高音豎笛的小型哨嘴長笛
sentences: She learned flageolet from an old music instructor. 她向一位老音樂指導者學會吹小型哨嘴笛。
The flageolet gave the folk tune a clear, high sound. 小型哨嘴笛讓民謠呈現清亮高音。

meaning: 計程車行程開始時收取的固定費；電話的基本費
sentences: The taxi's flagfall appeared before the meter began counting. 計程車的起跳費在計程表開始計算前就顯示了。
The phone plan adds a small flagfall to every call. 這項電話方案每通電話都加收少量基本費。

meaning: 野生鳶尾；也指揮旗示意的人
sentences: A flagger directed traffic around the roadwork. 一名交通指揮員引導車輛繞過道路施工處。
Beside the pond, a flagger showed its yellow flowers. 池塘旁，一株野生鳶尾開著黃色花朵。

meaning: 過度展示旗幟的行為或風氣
sentences: The parade's flaggery filled every balcony with bright banners. 遊行中的旗幟炫示讓每個陽台都掛滿鮮豔旗幟。
Critics called the campaign's flaggery distracting and excessive. 批評者認為這場競選的旗幟炫示既分散注意力又過度。

meaning: 疲弱地下垂地；無精打采地
sentences: He spoke flaggily after walking all afternoon. 他走了一下午後，說話顯得有氣無力。
The wilted branch hung flaggily over the path. 枯萎的枝條無力地垂在小路上方。

meaning: 疲倦、鬆弛或下垂的狀態
sentences: Her flagginess showed after the sleepless night. 她熬夜後顯露出疲弱的狀態。
The flagginess of the leaves signaled a lack of water. 葉片的下垂顯示水分不足。

meaning: 逐漸變弱、變慢或失去效力的
sentences: Flagging demand forced the shop to lower prices. 需求逐漸疲弱，迫使商店降價。
The runner revived his flagging energy with a drink. 跑者喝了飲料，恢復逐漸衰退的體力。

meaning: 慵懒的，虚弱的。如何在句子中使用标记
sentences: Writers use flaggingly to mean languid, weak. How to use flagging in a sentence. 作家用慵懒的，虚弱的。如何在句子中使用标记来表示无力、无力。如何在句子中使用标记。
She acted flaggingly when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她表現得軟弱無力。

meaning: 逐漸疲倦、衰弱或失去活力的
sentences: The patient's mood seemed flaggish by late afternoon. 病人的情緒到了下午晚些時候似乎逐漸低落。
A flaggish economy needs careful support. 衰弱的經濟需要謹慎的支援。

meaning: 柔弱下垂的；或多生菖蒲等水生旗葉植物的
sentences: The flaggy reeds bent beneath the rain. 柔弱下垂的蘆葦在雨下彎曲。
A flaggy marsh supports many tall iris plants. 長滿菖蒲類植物的沼地養育許多高大的鳶尾。

meaning: 反覆強求；苦苦請求
sentences: Voters flagitate for a clear answer from the mayor. 選民苦苦要求市長給出明確答覆。
She continued to flagitate for another chance. 她持續苦苦請求再給一次機會。

meaning: 反覆強求或苦苦請求的行為
sentences: Their flagitation delayed the final decision. 他們反覆強求，延後了最後決定。
The letter was an earnest flagitation for mercy. 那封信是懇切求情的文字。

meaning: 極其邪惡的；犯下令人髮指罪行的
sentences: The flagitious ruler ordered the massacre of villagers. 那名邪惡的統治者下令屠殺村民。
The court condemned the flagitious act as cruel and deliberate. 法院譴責這項令人髮指的行為既殘酷又蓄意。

meaning: 以凶狠的方式：惡毒地，邪惡地
sentences: Writers use flagitiously to mean in a flagitious manner: viciously, wickedly. 作家們用flagitious 來表示以一種惡毒的方式：惡毒地、邪惡地。
She acted flagitiously when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她就會採取凶狠的行動。

meaning: 極端邪惡、腐敗或暴行的性質
sentences: His flagitiousness shocked even his former allies. 他的極端邪惡連昔日盟友都感到震驚。
The novel portrays the flagitiousness of unchecked power. 這部小說描寫不受約束的權力如何導向極端邪惡。

meaning: 禾本科植物莖頂下方的最後一片葉
sentences: The flagleaf emerged just below the wheat ear. 劍葉在小麥穗下方長了出來。
Disease on the flagleaf can reduce the grain harvest. 劍葉染病可能降低穀物收成。

meaning: 沒有旗幟的；不懸掛旗幟的
sentences: A flagless mast stood above the quiet harbor. 一根沒有旗幟的桅杆矗立在寧靜港口上方。
The flagless boat entered the bay before dawn. 那艘未掛旗的船在黎明前駛入海灣。

meaning: 小旗；小旗幟
sentences: A flaglet fluttered from the child's bicycle. 一面小旗從孩子的腳踏車上飄動。
The guide tied a blue flaglet to the trail marker. 導遊把一面藍色小旗綁在步道標誌上。

meaning: 像旗幟的；呈旗形的
sentences: This badge is flaglike in shape and color. 這枚徽章的形狀和顏色都像旗幟。
A flaglike leaf waved above the wetland. 一片旗形葉在濕地上方搖曳。

meaning: 製作旗幟的人或商家
sentences: The flagmaker stitched a national banner by hand. 旗幟製作者手工縫製了一面國旗。
A local flagmaker repaired the torn pennant. 當地旗幟製作者修好了撕裂的三角旗。

meaning: 製作旗幟的工作或技藝
sentences: Flagmaking requires careful cutting and strong seams. 製旗需要仔細裁剪和牢固的接縫。
Her family has practiced flagmaking for three generations. 她的家族從事製旗已有三代。

meaning: 用旗幟發出訊號的人；鐵路或道路的信號員
sentences: The flagman waved drivers around the blocked lane. 信號員揮旗示意駕駛繞過封閉車道。
A railway flagman stopped the train before the bridge. 鐵路信號員在橋前讓火車停下。

meaning: 通常有把手、壺嘴和蓋子的大型液體容器
sentences: A silver flagon stood beside the banquet table. 一個銀製大酒壺放在宴會桌旁。
The host poured cider from a heavy flagon. 主人從厚重的大酒壺倒出蘋果酒。

meaning: 小酒壺；小型液體容器
sentences: She filled a flagonet with spiced wine. 她把香料酒裝進小酒壺。
The pilgrim carried a clay flagonet at his belt. 朝聖者把一個陶製小酒壺掛在腰間。

meaning: 沒有酒壺的；引申為沒有酒類飲品的
sentences: The flagonless camp served only water at dinner. 沒有酒的營地晚餐只供應水。
Their flagonless feast still felt warm and festive. 沒有酒的宴席仍然溫馨而有節慶氣氛。

meaning: 用來懸掛旗幟的高柱
sentences: The school raised a new flagpole near the gate. 學校在大門附近豎起一根新旗桿。
Rainwater ran down the metal flagpole. 雨水沿著金屬旗桿流下。

meaning: 明目張膽或公然違法的程度
sentences: The flagrance of the theft shocked the whole neighborhood. 這起偷竊公然到令人震驚，整個街區都感到錯愕。
Officials noted the flagrance of the safety violation. 官員指出這項安全違規公然而明顯。

meaning: 明目張膽或公然違法的性質
sentences: The flagrancy of the fraud led to a quick arrest. 詐騙行為明目張膽，很快便導致逮捕。
She apologized for the flagrancy of her dishonest excuse. 她為自己公然不誠實的藉口道歉。

meaning: 明顯而嚴重冒犯正當規範的；公然的
sentences: The referee penalized the player's flagrant foul. 裁判判罰了球員明顯而嚴重的犯規。
It was a flagrant breach of the safety rules. 那是公然嚴重違反安全規則的行為。

meaning: 公然地：臭名昭著地
sentences: Writers use flagrantly to mean in a flagrant manner: notoriously. 作家們用「公然地：臭名昭著地」來表示以一種明目張膽的方式：「臭名昭著」。
She acted flagrantly when the situation demanded it. 當情勢需要時，她就會明目張膽地行事。

meaning: 明顯、嚴重且公然違規的性質
sentences: The flagrantness of the breach prompted an investigation. 違規行為的公然嚴重性引發了調查。
Everyone noticed the flagrantness of the unfair decision. 所有人都注意到那項不公平決定的明顯嚴重性。

meaning: 甜旗植物的根
sentences: The herbalist dried flagroot for a traditional remedy. 草藥師把甜旗根曬乾，準備製作傳統藥方。
A wetland plant spreads thick flagroot beneath the soil. 一種濕地植物在土壤下長出粗厚的甜旗根。

meaning: 旗艦，首要產品
sentences: The new model is the company's flagship product. 這款新機型是公司的旗艦產品。
The flagship store is located on Fifth Avenue. 旗艦店位於第五大道。

meaning: 懸掛旗幟的桿或柱
sentences: The sailor raised the banner on the flagstaff. 水手把旗幟升上旗桿。
A wooden flagstaff marked the entrance to the fort. 一根木製旗桿標示出堡壘入口。

meaning: 高爾夫球洞旁標示球洞位置的旗桿
sentences: The golfer aimed beside the flagstick on the green. 高爾夫球員瞄準果嶺上的旗桿旁邊。
Wind bent the flagstick during the final putt. 最後一次推桿時，風使旗桿彎了一下。

meaning: 可劈成平板、用於鋪路的石材；鋪路石
sentences: Workers laid each flagstone along the garden path. 工人沿著花園小徑鋪設每塊鋪路石。
A loose flagstone rocked beneath my foot. 一塊鬆動的鋪路石在我腳下搖晃。

meaning: 生長在菖蒲或莎草間的蟲或幼蟲
sentences: A flagworm hid among the sedges. 一隻莎草蟲躲在莎草間。
The carp snapped at a flagworm near the reeds. 鯉魚在蘆葦旁咬住了一隻莎草蟲。

meaning: 手持脫粒工具，由木柄和可自由擺動的短棍組成
sentences: The farmer used a flail to thresh the wheat. 農夫用連枷替小麥脫粒。
An old flail hung above the barn door. 一把古老的連枷掛在穀倉門上方。

meaning: 像連枷的；動作像連枷般揮動的
sentences: The puppet made a flaillike swing with its wooden arm. 木偶用木臂做出像連枷般的揮動。
A flaillike tool struck the grain in a steady rhythm. 一件連枷狀工具以穩定節奏敲打穀物。

meaning: 天賦；獨特而吸引人的風格
sentences: Mia has a flair for bright interior design. 米雅很有使用亮色設計的天分。
His flair for comedy made everyone laugh. 他的喜劇天賦讓大家都笑了。

meaning: 古代愛爾蘭持有免租土地的酋長或貴族
sentences: The flaith welcomed guests into his stone hall. 那位愛爾蘭貴族在石廳迎接賓客。
A flaith held rent-free land under the old system. 古代制度下，一名愛爾蘭酋長持有免租土地。

meaning: 愛爾蘭酋長或貴族的身分與地位
sentences: His flaithship gave him authority over several villages. 他的愛爾蘭貴族身分使他能管理數個村莊。
The treaty recognized her flaithship and inherited lands. 條約承認她的酋長地位與世襲土地。

meaning: 一種檸檬黃色結核狀的水合銻酸鐵礦物
sentences: Behind glass, a lemon-yellow flajolotite nodule rested. 玻璃後放著一塊檸檬黃色的水合銻酸鐵礦物結核。
A geologist identified flajolotite in the claylike deposit. 地質學家在黏土狀礦床中辨認出這種礦物。

meaning: 高射砲；高射砲彈火力；猛烈批評
sentences: The pilots flew low to avoid enemy flak. 飛行員低空飛行以躲避敵方高射砲火。
The minister faced heavy flak after the decision. 部長在那項決定後遭到猛烈批評。

meaning: 製作石器時剝落的石片、碎屑或薄片堆積
sentences: Archaeologists found flakage beside the ancient toolmaking site. 考古學家在古代製石器遺址旁發現剝落的石片碎屑。
The flakage revealed how the sharp edge was shaped. 這些剝片顯示尖銳邊緣是如何成形的。

meaning: 薄片、剝落
sentences: Soft white flakes of snow began to fall gently from the dark sky. 潔白的雪片開始從漆黑的天空中緩緩飄落。
The old paint has begun to flake off the wooden bench in the garden. 木凳上的舊漆已經開始剝落了。

meaning: 沒有薄片的；不易剝落的
sentences: The new paint dried to a smooth, flakeless coat. 新油漆乾後形成平滑、不易剝落的塗層。
A flakeless surface is easier to clean. 不會剝落的表面比較容易清潔。

meaning: 小薄片；小雪片
sentences: A flakelet of snow landed on her glove. 一小片雪花落在她的手套上。
Each flakelet melted before reaching the ground. 每片小雪花落地前都融化了。

meaning: 剝片工具；會剝落的物體
sentences: The stone flaker shaped a sharp edge from the core. 石器剝片工具把石核削成銳利邊緣。
A paint flaker left chips across the old wall. 剝漆工具在老牆上留下四處碎片。

meaning: 以片狀的方式
sentences: Writers use flakily to mean in a flaky manner. 作家們用 以片狀的方式 來表示以不穩定的方式。
She acted flakily when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她就會表現得輕率。

meaning: 容易碎裂成薄片或從表面剝落的性質
sentences: The flakiness of the dry pastry pleased the baker. 酥皮乾爽易碎成片，讓烘焙師很滿意。
Moisturizer reduced the flakiness of her skin. 保濕霜減少了她皮膚的脫屑。

meaning: 易碎成薄片的，古怪的
sentences: The pastry was light and flaky. 這塊油酥點心又輕又脆。
He is a bit flaky and often forgets his appointments. 他有點古怪且不靠譜，經常忘記約會。

meaning: 兩擊鼓聲，第一擊是極快的裝飾音
sentences: The drummer opened the march with a crisp flam. 鼓手用清脆的雙擊裝飾音開始進行曲。
A flam gives the snare pattern extra force. 雙擊裝飾音讓小鼓節奏更有力。

meaning: 火焰升騰的；燃燒的
sentences: The flamant torch lit the dark passage. 燃燒的火炬照亮了黑暗通道。
A flamant plume rose above the furnace. 一縷火焰從熔爐上方升起。

meaning: 在食物上塗抹醬汁或油脂
sentences: The cook used butter to flamb the roasting bird. 廚師用奶油替烤鳥塗抹油脂。
She began to flamb the vegetables with garlic oil. 她開始用蒜香油替蔬菜塗上油脂。

meaning: 燃燒的火炬；泛指火炬
sentences: A flambeau guided the bearers through the night. 一支燃燒的火炬引導搬運者穿過夜色。
The festival began when the first flambeau was raised. 第一支火炬升起時，節慶便開始了。

meaning: 燃燒火炬的複數：多支燃燒的火炬
sentences: The flambeaux illuminated the courtyard after sunset. 多支燃燒的火炬在日落後照亮庭院。
Bearers carried flambeaux along the hill road. 火炬手沿著山路 抬著多支火炬。

meaning: 具有波浪形或火焰形劍刃的長劍
sentences: Inside the gallery, a flamberg showed its rippling blade. 展廳裡一把波浪劍展示著起伏的劍刃。
A flamberg was designed for powerful two-handed blows. 波浪劍是為強力的雙手劈砍而設計的。

meaning: 華麗、炫耀或引人注目的特質
sentences: Her flamboyance made the stage costume unforgettable. 她的華麗風格讓舞台服裝令人難忘。
The dancer performed with flamboyance and confidence. 舞者以華麗自信的姿態演出。

meaning: 華麗、炫耀或引人注目的特質
sentences: The painter's flamboyancy filled the room with bright colors. 畫家的華麗風格讓房間充滿鮮豔色彩。
He tempered his flamboyancy for the quiet ceremony. 他在安靜的儀式中收斂了自己的炫耀風格。

meaning: 行為、外表或風格華麗而引人注目的；炫耀的
sentences: The singer wore a flamboyant jacket covered in sequins. 歌手穿著一件滿是亮片、華麗醒目的外套。
His flamboyant gesture made the audience laugh. 他華麗誇張的手勢讓觀眾笑了起來。

meaning: 華麗張揚的風格或特質。
sentences: This style expresses flamboyantism through bold ornament. 這種風格透過大膽的裝飾展現華麗張揚。
A lavish costume reflects flamboyantism in its bright details. 華麗的服裝以鮮明細節呈現張揚風格。

meaning: 使變得華麗張揚。
sentences: A vivid design can flamboyantize a plain doorway. 鮮豔的設計能讓樸素的門口變得華麗張揚。
With bright paint, artists flamboyantize dull furniture. 藝術家用鮮亮的油漆把單調家具變得華麗。

meaning: 以华丽的方式：以华丽的方式
sentences: Writers use flamboyantly to mean in a flamboyant manner: with flamboyance. 作家們用 flaboyantly 來表示以一種華麗的方式：華麗地。
She acted flamboyantly when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她就會表現得很浮誇。

meaning: 鳳凰木；開紅花的熱帶觀賞樹。
sentences: In tropical gardens, the flamboyer glows with scarlet flowers. 在熱帶花園裡，鳳凰木開滿鮮紅的花。
Near the courtyard, one flamboyer cast cool shade. 庭院旁的一棵鳳凰木投下清涼的樹蔭。

meaning: 火焰
sentences: The small candle flame flickered in the strong evening breeze. 微弱的燭火在強勁的晚風中閃爍。
Massive flames were rising from the burning office building. 燃燒的辦公大樓冒出了巨大的火焰。

meaning: 帶有火焰的；著火的。
sentences: The flamed torch lit the narrow path. 那支燃燒的火炬照亮了狹窄小路。
Along the ridge, flamed banners snapped in the wind. 山脊上帶火焰圖案的旗幟在風中啪啦作響。

meaning: 火炬花，花序呈火焰狀的植物。
sentences: Bright flameflower blooms rose above the garden bed. 鮮豔的火炬花從花圃中探出來。
Beside the path, a flameflower attracted several bees. 小路旁的一株火炬花吸引了幾隻蜜蜂。

meaning: 沒有火焰或不產生火焰的。
sentences: The flameless heater warmed the room safely. 無焰暖氣機安全地讓房間暖和起來。
For the ceremony, we chose flameless candles. 典禮上我們選用了無焰蠟燭。

meaning: 小火焰；微弱的火苗。
sentences: A tiny flamelet danced above the wick. 一小簇火苗在燭芯上跳動。
Each flamelet faded when the wind grew stronger. 風變大時，每個小火焰都逐漸熄滅。

meaning: 像火焰的；呈火焰形狀的。
sentences: The flamelike leaves curled toward the sky. 那些火焰狀葉片朝天空捲曲。
Red streaks gave the stone a flamelike pattern. 紅色紋路讓石頭呈現火焰般的圖案。

meaning: 古羅馬侍奉特定神祇的祭司。
sentences: The flamen guarded the temple's sacred fire. 那名古羅馬祭司守護神殿的聖火。
During the rite, a flamen carried a small offering. 儀式中，一名祭司拿著小型祭品。

meaning: 佛朗明哥舞；源自西班牙的音樂與舞蹈。
sentences: The dancer performed flamenco with sharp footwork. 舞者以俐落的腳步表演佛朗明哥舞。
Guitar rhythms filled the room during the flamenco. 佛朗明哥音樂響起時，吉他節奏充滿整個房間。

meaning: 古羅馬祭司的職位或身分。
sentences: He accepted the flamenship after a solemn ceremony. 他在莊嚴的儀式後接受了祭司職位。
The flamenship carried duties tied to one deity. 這項祭司職務肩負侍奉特定神祇的責任。

meaning: 耐火焰、不易因接觸火焰而損壞或燃燒的。
sentences: The flameproof gloves protected her hands near the kiln. 耐火手套保護她在窯爐旁的雙手。
They installed a flameproof cover over the burner. 他們在燃燒器上裝了耐火罩。

meaning: 燃燒或噴出火焰的物體。
sentences: A flamer sent a brief tongue of fire across the ditch. 一個噴火裝置將短暫的火舌送過壕溝。
The old flamer needed fuel before it could work. 老式噴火器需要燃料才能運作。

meaning: 小白菊，一種菊科草本植物。
sentences: The flamfew grew well in the cool hillside soil. 小白菊在涼爽的山坡土壤中生長良好。
She planted flamfew beside the kitchen window. 她在廚房窗邊種了小白菊。

meaning: 火焰色的；帶橙紅色調的。
sentences: The flamineous scarf brightened her dark coat. 那條火焰色圍巾讓她的深色外套亮了起來。
A flamineous glow spread across the evening clouds. 火焰般的光彩遍布傍晚的雲層。

meaning: 燃燒中的；帶有明顯火焰的。
sentences: The flaming logs warmed everyone by the hearth. 燃燒的木柴讓壁爐旁的每個人都感到溫暖。
Bright coals kept flaming beneath the campsite grill. 營火烤架下的炭火持續燃燒。

meaning: 顏色、亮度或波浪狀輪廓類似或暗示火焰。如何用火焰造句
sentences: Writers use flamingly to mean resembling or suggesting a flame in color, brilliance, or wavy outline. How to use flaming in a sentence. 作家們用「顏色、亮度或波浪狀輪廓類似或暗示火焰。如何用火焰造句」來表示類似或暗示顏色、亮度或波浪輪廓的火焰。如何在句子中使用火焰。
She acted flamingly when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她就會表現得很激烈。

meaning: 火烈鳥，腿長、頸長且羽色多為粉紅的涉水鳥。
sentences: A flamingo folded its long neck beneath one wing. 一隻火烈鳥把長頸收在一側翅膀下。
At sunrise, the flamingo group waded through shallow water. 日出時，火烈鳥群涉過淺水。

meaning: 古羅馬特定神祇祭司的妻子。
sentences: The flaminica joined the sacred procession. 那位祭司的妻子加入了神聖的遊行。
A flaminica wore a distinctive veil at the rite. 祭司的妻子在儀式上戴著獨特的面紗。

meaning: 與古羅馬祭司或其職務有關的。
sentences: The flaminical robe bore a simple religious emblem. 那件祭司用長袍繡著簡單的宗教徽記。
An inscription records a flaminical duty. 一段銘文記錄了一項祭司職責。

meaning: 物質支持燃燒的能力；可燃性。
sentences: Moisture can reduce the flammability of dry grass. 水分能降低乾草的可燃性。
The label warns about the flammability of the solvent. 標籤警告這種溶劑容易燃燒。

meaning: 易燃的
sentences: Keep flammable liquids away from the stove. 請把易燃液體放在遠離爐子的地方。
This label warns that the spray is flammable. 這個標籤警告這種噴霧容易燃燒。

meaning: 火焰色的；呈紅橙色的。
sentences: The flammeous sunset colored the lake orange. 火焰色的夕陽把湖面染成橙色。
Her flammeous shawl stood out against the snow. 她的火焰色披肩在雪地上格外醒目。

meaning: 產生火焰或因火焰而明亮的。
sentences: The flammiferous torch burned through the night. 那支燃焰火炬燃燒了一整夜。
A flammiferous beacon guided boats toward the harbor. 發出火焰亮光的燈塔引導船隻駛向港口。

meaning: 具有火焰形斑紋的，常指鳥類羽毛。
sentences: The flammulated feathers showed narrow orange marks. 那些帶火焰斑紋的羽毛呈現細窄橙色線條。
A flammulated wing flashed when the bird turned. 鳥兒轉身時，火焰紋翅膀閃現亮色。

meaning: 鳥類羽毛上的火焰形斑紋
sentences: Fine flammulation covered the bird's brown wings. 細緻的火焰形斑紋覆蓋著那隻鳥的棕色翅膀。
The feather's flammulation looked like tiny flames. 那根羽毛的火焰形斑紋看起來像小火焰。

meaning: 小火焰，尤指神像或宗教圖像中的火焰。
sentences: A painted flammule rose beside the deity's hand. 神像手旁畫著一簇小火焰。
The artist added one flammule to the sacred emblem. 藝術家在神聖徽記上添了一簇小火焰。

meaning: 由火焰構成的；熾熱燃燒的。
sentences: The flamy plume climbed above the furnace. 火焰般的煙柱升到熔爐上方。
A flamy light spilled through the doorway. 熾熱的火光從門口流瀉進來。

meaning: 餡餅，果餡餅
sentences: She made a delicious strawberry flan for dessert. 她做了一道美味的草莓餡餅作為甜點。
I'd like a slice of vegetable flan, please. 我想要一片蔬菜餡餅。

meaning: 保護大腿或腰側的盔甲片。
sentences: The knight fastened a flancard over his thigh. 騎士把護腿甲片固定在大腿上。
A steel flancard covered the warrior's exposed side. 鋼製側甲遮住了戰士裸露的腰側。

meaning: 紋章中從左右兩側向內彎入的弧形圖案之一。
sentences: The shield displayed a silver flanch on each side. 盾牌兩側各有一道銀色內彎弧帶。
One flanch curved inward around the central emblem. 一道弧形紋章圖案向內環繞中央徽記。

meaning: 具有紋章弧帶的。
sentences: The flanched shield carried a blue central symbol. 那面帶弧帶紋章的盾牌中央有藍色符號。
A flanched design balanced the arms on both sides. 兩側都有弧帶的設計讓徽章保持平衡。

meaning: 擊劍中以束劍後刺向對手手臂下方的招式。
sentences: The fencer finished the exchange with a flanconade. 擊劍者以一記刺向腋下的招式結束交鋒。
Her flanconade slipped beneath the opponent's guard. 她的擊劍刺招從對手防守下方穿入。

meaning: 17 世紀女性佩戴的一種頭巾或圍裙式服飾。
sentences: The costume display included a lace flandan. 服裝展示中有一件蕾絲女用頭巾。
She tied the flandan beneath her chin for the historical dance. 她為歷史舞蹈把女用頭巾繫在下巴下。

meaning: 笨拙而邋遢的人。
sentences: The village children called the clumsy giant a flandowser. 村裡的孩子把那個笨拙的巨人叫作邋遢鬼。
Nobody trusted the flandowser to carry the fragile vase. 沒有人敢讓那個笨手笨腳的人搬運易碎花瓶。

meaning: 箭；箭矢。
sentences: The archer drew a flane from the leather quiver. 弓箭手從皮革箭袋抽出一支箭。
A polished flane lay beside the wooden bow. 一支磨亮的箭放在木弓旁。

meaning: 用來增加強度、導向或連接物件的凸緣或邊緣。
sentences: The pipe flange sealed the joint against leaks. 管子的凸緣密封接頭，防止漏水。
A broad flange kept the wheel aligned on its axle. 寬大的凸緣讓輪子保持在軸心上。

meaning: 缺少法蘭
sentences: The specimen looked flangeless under the bright lab light. 在明亮的實驗室燈光下，該標本看起來沒有凸緣。
An unusually flangeless figure stood at the center of the design. 設計的中心是一個不尋常的無凸緣人物。

meaning: 製造或修理凸緣的人或工具。
sentences: The flanger shaped a smooth rim for the metal pipe. 凸緣工替金屬管塑出平滑邊緣。
A skilled flanger repaired the damaged wheel flange. 熟練的凸緣工修好了受損的輪緣。

meaning: 鐵軌上容納車輪凸緣的通道。
sentences: Leaves clogged the flangeway beside the rail. 落葉堵住了鐵軌旁的輪緣通道。
The wheel flange moved freely through the flangeway. 車輪凸緣在通道中順暢移動。

meaning: 位於褲子褲腳處的兩個口袋中的一個。
sentences: I took the quarter I found and hid in my right flank. 我拿起找到的那枚硬幣，藏在我的右派。
The term flank refers to either of the two pockets located on the seat of a pair of pants. 術語「側翼」是指位於褲子褲座上的兩個口袋中的任何一個。

meaning: 保護大腿或腰側的盔甲片。
sentences: The guard buckled a flankard over his hip. 衛兵把側甲扣在臀部上方。
A leather flankard shielded the rider's outer thigh. 皮製側甲保護騎手的大腿外側。

meaning: 位於兩側的；有某物在側旁的。
sentences: The flanked road led between two stone walls. 兩側有石牆的道路通往前方。
A flanked doorway stood beneath the old arch. 兩旁有柱子的大門位在古老拱門下。

meaning: 位於隊形外側、負責接球的美式足球員。
sentences: The flanker sprinted wide before the ball was thrown. 那名外側接球員在傳球前向外衝刺。
A quick flanker caught the pass near the sideline. 敏捷的外側接球員在邊線附近接到傳球。

meaning: 位於側面或從側面包圍的。
sentences: The flanking towers protected the city gate. 側面的塔樓守護著城門。
A flanking movement forced the opposing army to retreat. 從側面包抄的行動迫使敵軍撤退。

meaning: 在側面、沿著側面或從側面地。
sentences: The hikers moved flankwise along the narrow ledge. 登山者沿著狹窄岩架的側面前進。
The horse turned flankwise to avoid the fallen branch. 馬側身轉動以避開倒下的樹枝。

meaning: 具有鬆散而粗糙質地的。
sentences: The flanky fabric tore easily at the seam. 那種鬆散粗糙的布料在接縫處很容易裂開。
A flanky rope felt rough against his palms. 粗糙鬆散的繩子磨得他的手掌不舒服。

meaning: 法蘭絨；也指用柔和話語掩飾真相的空話。
sentences: The winter shirt was made of warm flannel. 那件冬季襯衫是用溫暖的法蘭絨製成的。
His polished speech was mere flannel designed to avoid blame. 他那番圓滑說詞只是為了逃避責任的空話。

meaning: 氈毛木屬灌木，原產加州與墨西哥。
sentences: The flannelbush showed yellow flowers in early spring. 氈毛木在早春開出黃色花朵。
Dry hillsides provide a home for the flannelbush. 乾燥山坡是氈毛木的生長地。

meaning: 穿著法蘭絨的；覆有法蘭絨的。
sentences: The flanneled child stayed warm beside the window. 穿著法蘭絨衣服的孩子在窗邊保持溫暖。
A flanneled jacket softened the sharp winter wind. 法蘭絨外套減弱了刺骨的冬風。

meaning: 輕薄的棉質法蘭絨。
sentences: The baby blanket used soft flannelette. 嬰兒毯使用柔軟的棉質法蘭絨。
She chose flannelette for the lining of her pajamas. 她選用棉質法蘭絨作為睡衣內襯。

meaning: 毛蕊花，葉面帶有柔軟絨毛的植物。
sentences: The tall flannelflower rose above the dry grass. 高大的毛蕊花高出乾草叢。
A flannelflower kept its yellow spikes after the rain. 一株毛蕊花在雨後仍保有黃色花穗。

meaning: 毛蕊花，葉片覆有柔軟絨毛的植物。
sentences: The flannelleaf formed a gray-green rosette near the wall. 毛蕊花在牆邊形成灰綠色葉叢。
Rain beaded on each broad flannelleaf. 雨珠停留在每片寬大的毛蕊花葉上。

meaning: 模糊而低沉的，彷彿隔著厚布聽見的。
sentences: The distant radio sounded flannelly through the thick wall. 遠處收音機的聲音穿過厚牆後變得模糊低沉。
She spoke flannelly, so every word seemed muffled. 她說話含糊低沉，每個字聽來都像被悶住。

meaning: 說話圓滑含糊、愛講空話的人。
sentences: The flannelmouth promised change without offering a plan. 那個空口說白話的人承諾改變，卻沒有提出計畫。
Everyone recognized the salesman as a charming flannelmouth. 大家都看出那名推銷員是個迷人的空話大王。

meaning: 說話狡猾圓滑或討好人的。
sentences: The flannelmouthed politician dodged every direct question. 那名說話圓滑的政治人物避開了每個直接問題。
His flannelmouthed apology sounded carefully rehearsed. 他那番討好的道歉聽起來像是事先背好的。

meaning: 法蘭絨衣物；法蘭絨布料。
sentences: Clean flannels hung beside the winter coats. 乾淨的法蘭絨衣物掛在冬季外套旁。
The shop folded its finest flannels on the wooden shelf. 店家把最好的法蘭絨布料摺放在木架上。

meaning: 紋章中類似弧帶但較窄的圖案。
sentences: The crest placed a narrow flanque beside the shield's center. 徽章在盾牌中央旁放置一道窄弧帶。
Each flanque curved inward without touching the emblem. 每道窄弧帶向內彎曲但沒有碰到徽記。

meaning: 拍動、拍擊；可活動的片狀部分。
sentences: The bird's flap stirred dust from the dry ground. 鳥兒拍動翅膀，揚起乾地上的灰塵。
A loose flap covered the pocket opening. 一片鬆脫的布片蓋住了口袋開口。

meaning: 煎餅。
sentences: The cook served one warm flapcake with honey. 廚師端上一張淋著蜂蜜的熱煎餅。
A blueberry flapcake disappeared before breakfast ended. 早餐還沒結束，藍莓煎餅就被吃光了。

meaning: 毛地黃，一種開鐘形花的植物。
sentences: The purple flapdock bloomed beside the cottage wall. 紫色毛地黃在小屋牆邊開花。
A single flapdock rose above the meadow grass. 一株毛地黃高出草地。

meaning: 胡說八道；毫無意義的話。
sentences: The advertisement was full of flapdoodle about instant success. 那則廣告充滿了能立即成功的胡說八道。
She rejected the rumor as empty flapdoodle. 她認為那則謠言只是空洞的胡扯。

meaning: 金魚草；也可指舊時對德國人的貶稱
sentences: A pink flapdragon bloomed beside the gate. 一株粉紅色金魚草在門旁盛開。
The gardener watered each flapdragon before noon. 園丁在中午前替每株金魚草澆水。

meaning: 煎餅；有時指燕麥製成的甜點。
sentences: The diner served a golden flapjack with fresh berries. 小餐館端上金黃煎餅和新鮮莓果。
He packed an oat flapjack for the long journey. 他為長途旅程帶了一塊燕麥甜餅。

meaning: 嘴巴大張的；下顎鬆垂的。
sentences: The flapmouthed puppet made the children laugh. 那個嘴巴大張的木偶逗得孩子們大笑。
A flapmouthed fish gulped air at the water's edge. 一條嘴巴大張的魚在水邊吞吸空氣。

meaning: 用來拍動或擊打的物件；拍板。
sentences: The rubber flapper stopped the valve from leaking. 橡膠拍片阻止閥門漏水。
A wooden flapper struck the drum in a steady rhythm. 木製拍板以穩定節奏敲擊鼓面。

meaning: 摩登女郎群體及其流行風尚。
sentences: The era celebrated flapperdom through short skirts and dancing. 那個時代透過短裙與舞蹈展現摩登女郎文化。
The magazine captured the energy of flapperdom. 那本雜誌捕捉了摩登女郎風尚的活力。

meaning: 摩登女郎的身分或生活方式。
sentences: Her bold haircut marked her entry into flapperhood. 她大膽的髮型象徵她成為摩登女郎。
Many young women embraced flapperhood as a new public image. 許多年輕女性接受摩登女郎身分，展現全新的公眾形象。

meaning: 像摩登女郎的；時髦而略帶輕浮的。
sentences: The flapperish dress had a loose waist and bright beads. 那件摩登女郎風洋裝腰身寬鬆，配有鮮亮珠飾。
Her flapperish dance delighted the lively crowd. 她那摩登俏皮的舞姿讓熱鬧人群十分開心。

meaning: 摩登女郎式的作風或價值觀。
sentences: The movement called flapperism favored freedom and modern clothes. 這股被稱為摩登女郎風潮的運動重視自由與現代服裝。
The novel portrays flapperism as a challenge to old manners. 小說把摩登女郎作風描寫成對舊禮俗的挑戰。

meaning: 閃耀，爆發
sentences: The match flared brightly for a moment and then went out. 火柴燦爛地閃了一下，然後就熄滅了。
Tensions flared between the two groups during the meeting. 兩派之間的緊張局勢在會議期間爆發了。

meaning: 火焰逆著正常氣流從熔爐等處回竄或噴出的現象。
sentences: The furnace produced a dangerous flareback after the vent closed. 通風口關閉後，熔爐發生危險的火焰回竄。
A sudden flareback sent heat through the open hatch. 突然的火焰回竄讓熱氣穿過敞開的艙口。

meaning: 開放式車斗兩側增加容量的斜向延伸板。
sentences: The farmer raised the flareboard to carry more hay. 農夫升起車斗側板以裝載更多乾草。
A cracked flareboard left the wagon unable to hold grain. 破裂的擴容側板讓馬車無法裝滿穀物。

meaning: 不產生耀斑或突然外擴亮光的。
sentences: The flareless lamp gave a steady glow in the tent. 無耀斑燈在帳篷裡發出穩定光線。
A flareless signal stayed visible without dazzling drivers. 無耀斑信號保持清晰，卻不會讓駕駛人目眩。

meaning: 明亮或不穩定地燃燒；向外張開的。
sentences: The flames kept flaring whenever the wind reached the fire. 風一吹到火堆，明亮搖曳的火焰就升高。
The flaring skirt spread wide as she spun. 她旋轉時，向外張開的裙襬大幅展開。

meaning: 燃燒或好像明亮地或不穩定地燃燒。如何用 flaming 造句
sentences: Writers use flaringly to mean flaming or as if flaming brightly or unsteadily. How to use flaring in a sentence. 作家們用 flalarly 來表示燃燒或好像明亮地或不穩定地燃燒。如何在句子中使用閃耀。
She acted flaringly when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她就會表現得很耀眼。

meaning: 艷麗明亮而花哨的。
sentences: The flary jacket drew attention on the quiet street. 那件花哨亮眼的外套在安靜街道上很引人注目。
His flary poster used gold ink and oversized letters. 他的華麗海報使用金色墨水和超大字體。

meaning: 片岩中由變質剪切形成的透鏡狀、常具條紋的顆粒構造。
sentences: The geologist identified a flaser within the mica-rich rock. 地質學家在富含雲母的岩石中辨認出一個透鏡狀構造。
A thin flaser marked the zone of intense deformation. 一條細薄的透鏡狀構造標示出強烈變形帶。

meaning: 閃光
sentences: A sudden flash of lightning lit up the dark and stormy sky. 突然的一道閃電點亮了黑暗暴風雨的天空。
Please don't use the camera flash inside the art gallery. 在美術館內請勿使用相機閃光燈。

meaning: 突出於水壩頂部、用來提高蓄水深度的木板。
sentences: The crew added a flashboard to raise the pond level. 工人加裝一塊擋水板來提高池塘水位。
Heavy rain pressed against the temporary flashboard. 大雨沖擊著臨時擋水板。

meaning: 閃爍或發出閃光的裝置或物體。
sentences: The bicycle flasher warned cars of the rider's position. 腳踏車閃光燈提醒汽車注意騎士的位置。
A small flasher blinked above the emergency exit. 緊急出口上方的小型閃光裝置不停閃爍。

meaning: 小閃光；短促的亮光。
sentences: A flashet appeared when the wire touched the metal. 電線碰到金屬時閃出一小道亮光。
One flashet revealed the bird hiding in the reeds. 一瞬閃光照出了藏在蘆葦中的鳥。

meaning: 以華麗的方式或風格。如何用華麗造句
sentences: Writers use flashily to mean in a flashy manner or style. How to use flashily in a sentence. 作家使用 以華麗的方式或風格。如何用華麗造句 來表示華麗的方式或風格。如何在句子中使用以華麗的方式或風格。如何用華麗造句。
She acted flashily when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她就會表現得輕率。

meaning: 華而不實、炫耀外表的特質。
sentences: The car's flashiness mattered more to him than comfort. 那輛車的炫耀外表對他來說比舒適更重要。
Despite its flashiness, the watch kept poor time. 那支手錶雖然外表浮華，走時卻不準。

meaning: 光源的閃爍，例如燈泡或電腦的遊標。
sentences: The incessant flashing of the neon sign kept the neighborhood awake. 不斷閃爍的霓虹燈讓鄰居保持清醒。
The term flashing refers to The blinking of a light source, such as a light bulb or computer 's cursor. 術語「閃爍」是指光源的閃爍，例如燈泡或電腦的遊標。

meaning: 以閃爍的方式或風格：閃閃發光
sentences: Writers use flashingly to mean in a flashing manner or style: sparklingly. 作家們用 以閃爍的方式或風格：閃閃發光 來表示以一種閃爍的方式或風格：閃閃發光。
She acted flashingly when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她就會表現得神采飛揚。

meaning: 手電筒
sentences: I used a flashlight to find my way through the dark forest. 我用手電筒在漆黑的森林中找路。
Don't forget to pack a flashlight and spare batteries for the trip. 別忘了為旅行準備手電筒和備用電池。

meaning: 像閃光般短暫、迅速或明亮的。
sentences: A flashlike movement crossed the doorway. 一道閃電般的動作掠過門口。
Her flashlike smile vanished almost at once. 她那閃現般的笑容幾乎立刻消失。

meaning: 炫耀地；以華而不實的方式。
sentences: He dressed flashly for the crowded evening party. 他為熱鬧的晚宴穿得十分炫耀。
The shop was decorated flashly with mirrored signs. 店面用鏡面招牌裝飾得華而不實。

meaning: 炫耀或浮華的氣派。
sentences: The flashness of the stage lights distracted the audience. 舞台燈光的炫目浮華分散了觀眾注意力。
Her outfit had flashness but little practical comfort. 她的服裝很浮華，實際穿著卻不舒適。

meaning: 電流穿過空氣或結構間隙而產生的異常放電。
sentences: A flashover jumped between the damaged wires. 異常放電在受損電線之間跳躍。
The breaker opened quickly to prevent a flashover. 斷路器迅速跳脫，以防止異常放電。

meaning: 燧發槍上放置火藥底火的小盤。
sentences: The musketeer brushed ash from the flashpan. 火槍手拂去燧發槍底火盤上的灰燼。
A spark leaped from the flint into the flashpan. 火星從燧石跳進底火盤。

meaning: 能防止閃光或閃燃造成損害的。
sentences: The flashproof case protected the camera during the blast. 抗閃光外盒在爆炸時保護了相機。
Workers wore flashproof clothing near the electrical gear. 工人在電氣設備旁穿著抗閃燃衣物。

meaning: 用來測試閃光燈或閃光裝置的儀器。
sentences: The photographer checked the flash with a flashtester. 攝影師用閃光測試器檢查閃光燈。
A portable flashtester found the faulty connection quickly. 可攜式閃光測試器很快找出了故障接點。

meaning: 艷麗；視覺上令人印象深刻、引人注目或有吸引力。
sentences: The dancers wore flashy costumes featuring shiny sequins in many vibrant colors. 舞者穿著華麗的服裝，上面飾有許多鮮豔色彩的閃亮亮片。
Something described as flashy is showy; visually impressive, attention-getting, or appealing. 形容華而不實的東西是炫耀的；視覺上令人印象深刻、引人注目或有吸引力。

meaning: 用於謹慎攜帶少量烈性酒精飲料的容器；一個口袋燒瓶。
sentences: The term flask refers to a container used to discreetly carry a small amount of a hard alcoholic beverage; a pocket flask. 燒瓶一詞是指用於謹慎攜帶少量烈性酒精飲料的容器；一個袖珍燒瓶。
The lesson introduced flask as a useful term to understand. 本課程介紹了燒瓶這個易於理解的有用術語。

sentences: The flag's small flasker moved in the evening breeze. 旗幟上的小飾片在晚風中撲動。
A mechanical flasker kept the thin strip in motion. 機械撲動器讓細帶持續擺動。

meaning: 長而淺的籃子。
sentences: She carried fresh bread in a wide flasket. 她用寬大的長籃裝著新鮮麵包。

sentences: The chemist poured the clear liquid into a flasklet. 化學家把透明液體倒進小燒瓶。
A sealed flasklet fit neatly inside the travel case. 密封的小瓶正好放進旅行盒。

meaning: 紋章中類似凸緣但較窄的弧形圖案。
sentences: The heraldic shield bore a narrow flasque on either side. 那面紋章盾牌兩側各有一道窄弧帶。
A gold flasque framed the central red emblem. 金色窄弧帶框住中央的紅色徽記。

meaning: 平坦的
sentences: They live in a beautiful modern flat in the city center. 他們住在市中心的一間漂亮現代公寓裡。
The earth was once believed to be flat by many ancient civilizations. 地球曾被許多古代文明認為是平的。

meaning: 平底、方頭且適合在淺水中運送大件貨物的船。
sentences: The flatboat carried timber down the shallow river. 平底船載著木材順淺河而下。
A broad flatboat waited beside the muddy bank. 一艘寬大的平底船停在泥濘河岸旁。

meaning: 平底船或具有平坦底部的物體。
sentences: The flatbottom crossed the marsh without running aground. 那艘平底船穿過沼澤而沒有擱淺。
A sturdy flatbottom carried crates through the shallow channel. 堅固的平底船載著木箱通過淺水道。

meaning: 帽冠低而平的平頂帽
sentences: The baker wore a wool flatcap in winter. 麵包師冬天戴著一頂羊毛平頂帽。
Her gray flatcap kept rain from her eyes. 她的灰色平頂帽替她遮住雨水。

meaning: 平坦的狀態或特質（罕用語）。

meaning: 扁平的；已被壓平的。

meaning: 身體扁平、兩眼通常位於同一側的魚，例如鰈魚或鰨魚。
sentences: The fisherman returned the flatfish to the sea. 漁夫把那條比目魚放回海裡。
A flatfish can hide against the sandy bottom. 比目魚能伏在沙底，隱藏自己的身形。

meaning: 扁平足；（俚語）警察。
sentences: The doctor examined her flatfoot after the hike. 健行後，醫生檢查她的扁平足。

meaning: 平頂帽；帽冠平坦的帽子。

meaning: 北美部分原住民族的成員；也指頭部扁平的魚或動物。
sentences: The historical record mentions a Flathead community. 這份歷史記錄提到一個北美原住民族社群。
Anglers often recognize the flathead by its broad head. 釣客常以寬大的頭部辨認平頭魚。

meaning: 用兩片加熱平板夾拉頭髮的直髮夾。
sentences: She used a flatiron before the evening concert. 她在晚間音樂會前使用直髮夾。
Unplug the flatiron when your hair is dry. 頭髮弄乾後，請拔掉直髮夾的插頭。

meaning: 主要由平坦土地構成的地區，常用複數 flatlands。
sentences: The railway crosses miles of flatland. 鐵路穿越數英里的平坦地區。
Wind farms now cover parts of the flatlands. 風力發電場如今覆蓋部分平原。

meaning: 小型公寓，通常只有一間主要房間。
sentences: The student rented a bright flatlet downtown. 那名學生在市中心租了一間明亮的小公寓。

meaning: 側面或邊緣平坦的。
sentences: The flatling stone made a stable doorstop. 那塊側面平坦的石頭成了穩固的門擋。
A flatling piece of wood lay under the box. 一塊邊緣平坦的木頭墊在箱子下面。

meaning: 以明確的方式；以一種完全確定的方式。
sentences: It was an accusation that he flatly denied. 對於這項指控，他斷然否認。
The team responded flatly to the change. 團隊對這項變化反應平淡。

meaning: 平底船船工（罕用語）。
sentences: The flatman guided the barge through shallow water. 平底船船工引導駁船穿過淺水區。
A skilled flatman could read the river currents. 熟練的平底船船工能判讀河流的水流。

meaning: 平坦的狀態或程度；缺乏起伏的特質。
sentences: The flatness of the road made cycling easy. 道路的平坦讓騎自行車變得容易。
Painters broke the wall's flatness with soft shadows. 畫家用柔和陰影打破牆面的平坦感。

meaning: 鼻子扁平的人或動物（罕用語）。
sentences: The guide identified the flatnose by its short snout. 導覽員以短而扁的吻部辨認那種動物。
The nickname flatnose appears in the old sailor's tale. 那則老水手故事中出現了「扁鼻子」這個綽號。

sentences: The metalworker ran the strip through a flattener. 金工師傅把金屬條送入壓平機。

sentences: The Earth is a sphere that has flattenings at the poles. 地球是一個兩極平坦的球體。

meaning: 奉承

meaning: 容易受到奉承而高興或動心的。
sentences: The flatterable guest smiled at every compliment. 那位容易受奉承的客人聽到每句稱讚都會微笑。

meaning: 平頂帽（罕用語）。
sentences: The costume maker stitched a flattercap for the actor. 服裝師為演員縫製了一頂平頂帽。
A feather was tucked into the child's flattercap. 一根羽毛插在孩子的平頂帽上。

meaning: 一種水生睡蓮類植物（罕用語）。
sentences: The pond margin held a yellow flatterdock. 池塘邊長著一株黃色睡蓮類植物。
Researchers recorded flatterdock in the marsh survey. 研究人員在沼澤調查中記錄了這種植物。

meaning: 奉承他人的人。
sentences: The flatterer praised the mayor's every decision. 那名奉承者稱讚市長做出的每個決定。
She distrusted the flatterer who wanted a favor. 她不信任那個想求她幫忙的奉承者。

meaning: 令人好看的；討人喜歡或稱讚人的。
sentences: The blue jacket is flattering on you. 這件藍色外套穿在你身上很好看。
The review gave a flattering picture of the service. 那篇評論對這項服務有很高的評價。

meaning: 以阿諛奉承為標誌。如何用阿諛奉承造句
sentences: Writers use flatteringly to mean marked by flattery. How to use flattering in a sentence. 作家們用奉承來表示帶有奉承的意思。如何用諂媚造句。

meaning: 討人喜歡或使人顯得好看的特質。
sentences: The flatteringness of the portrait pleased its subject. 那幅肖像畫討喜的特質讓本人很滿意。
Lighting can add flatteringness to a simple photograph. 燈光能為簡單的照片增添討喜感。

meaning: 奉承，阿諛
sentences: She was immune to his constant flattery. 她對他的不斷奉承無動於衷。
Flattery will get you nowhere! 奉承是行不通的！

meaning: 扁平的東西（罕用語）。
sentences: The child picked a smooth flattie from the beach. 孩子從海灘撿起一塊光滑的扁平石頭。
A small flattie covered the loose screw hole. 一片小扁片蓋住了鬆動的螺絲孔。

meaning: 平躺或攤平在地上的。
sentences: The flatting mat protected the camper from damp ground. 那張平躺用墊子保護露營者不受濕地影響。
A flatting figure appeared in the mural's foreground. 壁畫前景中有一個平躺的人影。

meaning: 有些平坦的；略扁的。
sentences: The flattish loaf still tasted fresh. 那條略扁的麵包吃起來仍然新鮮。
A flattish roof sheds little rainwater. 略平的屋頂排走的雨水不多。

meaning: 上表面平坦的物體；平頂髮型。

His new flattop haircut needs little styling. 他新剪的平頂髮型不太需要整理。

meaning: 腸胃產生或排出過多氣體的狀態；脹氣。

meaning: 腸胃脹氣的狀態（較少用）。

The leaflet lists flatulency as a possible side effect. 說明單把腸胃脹氣列為可能的副作用。

meaning: 容易產生腸胃氣的；（文章或言談）浮誇冗長的。
sentences: The doctor called the meal flatulent for some patients. 醫生說這餐對某些病人容易造成脹氣。

meaning: 以脹氣的方式：以脹氣的方式

meaning: 脹氣或言談浮誇冗長的狀態。

meaning: 腸胃道中的氣體，尤其是排出的氣體。

meaning: 用餐和上菜用的刀、叉、湯匙等餐具。

Please place the used flatware in the tray. 請把用過的餐具放進托盤。

meaning: 平放地；使平面朝向某個方向地（罕用語）。

meaning: 平放地；以平面貼著表面地。

meaning: 貓耳菊，一種開黃色花的菊科植物。

Sheets and towels make up most of the flatwork. 床單和毛巾構成大部分的機洗衣物。

meaning: 扁形動物；身體通常扁平的蠕蟲

Some flatworm species live inside other animals. 有些扁形蟲物種生活在其他動物體內。

meaning: 薄片，尤其指雪花（方言或罕用語）。

Each flaught melted before reaching the ground. 每片雪花在落地前都融化了。

meaning: 遊行，炫耀。

meaning: 炫耀者；喜歡賣弄的人。

Everyone noticed the flaunter's glittering costume. 每個人都注意到那名炫耀者閃亮的服裝。

meaning: 炫耀地；賣弄地。
sentences: She flauntily waved the prize before the cameras. 她在鏡頭前炫耀地揮舞獎品。
The peacock walked flauntily across the path. 孔雀炫耀地走過小路。

meaning: 炫耀或賣弄的特質。
sentences: The car's flauntiness attracted unwanted attention. 那輛車的炫耀感引來不必要的注意。

meaning: 展示或強迫公眾注意自己。如何在句子中使用炫耀。 Flaunt 與 Flout：使用指南 Flaunt 的同義詞討論
sentences: Older manuals use flaunting to mean to display or obtrude oneself to public notice. How to use flaunt in a sentence. Flaunt vs. Flout: Usage Guide Synonym Discussion of Flaunt. 較舊的手冊使用炫耀來表示展示或妨礙公眾注意自己。如何在句子中使用炫耀。 Flaunt 與 Flout：使用指南 Flaunt 的同義詞討論。

meaning: 以炫耀的方式
sentences: Writers use flauntingly to mean in a flaunting manner. 作家用炫耀來表示以炫耀的方式。

meaning: 炫耀的；以賣弄為特徵的。
sentences: Her flaunty jewelry caught every eye. 她炫耀式的珠寶吸引了所有人的目光。
The restaurant's flaunty entrance felt excessive. 那家餐廳炫目的入口讓人覺得過頭。

meaning: 小型長笛；音樂中的短笛。
sentences: The soloist played a bright flautino above the strings. 獨奏者在弦樂上方吹奏明亮的小長笛。
An early score calls for flautino in the final movement. 一份早期樂譜要求終樂章使用小長笛。

meaning: 長笛演奏家。
sentences: The flautist rehearsed the difficult passage slowly. 長笛演奏家慢慢練習那段困難樂句。
A young flautist won the regional competition. 一名年輕的長笛演奏家贏得區域比賽。

meaning: 一種黃烷類化合物（化學，罕用語）。
sentences: The chemist noted flavanilin in the reaction record. 化學家在反應記錄中註明了這種黃烷類化合物。
A reference table lists flavanilin among related compounds. 參考表把這種黃烷類化合物列在相關化合物中。

meaning: 一種黃烷苯胺類化合物（化學，罕用語）。
sentences: The analyst compared flavaniline with the control material. 分析師把這種黃烷苯胺類化合物與對照材料比較。
The label identifies flavaniline as a laboratory reagent. 標籤把這種黃烷苯胺類化合物標示為實驗室試劑。

meaning: 一種與蒽醌相關的黃色還原染料，分子式為 C28H12N2O2。
sentences: The dye chart lists flavanthrene with its formula. 染料表列出這種黃色還原染料及其分子式。
A textile test used flavanthrene on a cotton swatch. 紡織測試在一小片棉布上使用了這種黃色染料。

meaning: 一種與蒽醌相關的黃色還原染料，分子式為 C28H12N2O2。
sentences: The chemist stored flavanthrone in a dark bottle. 化學家把這種黃色還原染料存放在深色瓶中。
The process converts the pigment into flavanthrone. 這項製程會把顏料轉化為這種黃色還原染料。

meaning: 柑橘果皮最外層的有色部分。
sentences: The orange's flavedo released a fresh scent. 柳橙外皮的有色層散發清新香氣。
Thinly grate the flavedo without touching the white pith. 薄薄刨下有色外皮，不要碰到白色內膜。

meaning: 植物綠色部位因葉綠素減少而變黃或變白的現象。
sentences: The leaves showed flavescence after the infection spread. 感染擴散後，葉片出現黃化現象。
Researchers measured flavescence across the orchard. 研究人員測量整座果園的黃化程度。

meaning: 呈淡黃色的；正在變黃的。
sentences: The flavescent leaves signaled a nutrient problem. 淡黃的葉片顯示可能有營養問題。
A flavescent tint appeared along the old paper. 泛黃的色調出現在舊紙張邊緣。

meaning: 黃色的；帶黃色的（罕用語）。
sentences: The study describes a flavic pigment in the material. 研究描述材料中有一種黃色顏料。
A flavic tint covered the mineral surface. 黃色調覆蓋了礦物表面。

meaning: 呈黃色的；正在變黃的（罕用語）。
sentences: The flavicant tissue changed color in storage. 那些正在變黃的組織在保存期間改變了顏色。
A flavicant patch spread across the leaf. 一片泛黃區域沿著葉片擴大。

meaning: 黃色的；淡黃色的。
sentences: The flavid powder stained the glass yellow. 那種黃色粉末把玻璃染成黃色。
A flavid flower stood out among the white blooms. 一朵淡黃色的花在白花之間格外醒目。

meaning: 一類黃色水溶性含氮色素，包含核黃素，常作為黃素蛋白的輔酶。
sentences: The assay measured flavin in the enzyme extract. 這項分析測量酵素萃取物中的黃素。
Riboflavin is a familiar member of the flavin group. 核黃素是黃素類中常見的一員。

meaning: 具有防腐作用的一類黃色吖啶染料，例如吖啶黃。
sentences: The archive labels the bottle as flavine dye. 檔案把這瓶物質標示為黃吖啶染料。
Older medical texts mention flavine as an antiseptic. 較早的醫學文獻提到黃吖啶染料可作防腐劑。

meaning: 表示黃色或黃色素的字首。
sentences: In flavoprotein, flavo refers to a yellow pigment. 在黃素蛋白一詞中，這個字首表示黃色素。
The prefix flavo appears in several pigment names. 這個表示黃色的字首出現在幾個色素名稱中。

meaning: 一種無色結晶芳香酮，也是許多黃色植物色素的母體化合物。
sentences: The chemist purified flavone from the plant extract. 化學家從植物萃取物中純化出黃酮。
Researchers studied flavone as a dye precursor. 研究人員研究黃酮，將它作為染料前驅物。

meaning: 含有黃素的蛋白質，常參與生物體內的氧化還原反應。
sentences: The enzyme is a flavoprotein that transfers electrons. 這種酵素是能傳遞電子的黃素蛋白。
The lab tested flavoprotein activity under low oxygen. 實驗室在低氧條件下測試黃素蛋白的活性。

meaning: 一種黃色結晶化合物，化學名為 1,2,6-三羥基蒽醌。
sentences: The chemist identified flavopurpurin in the yellow crystals. 化學家在黃色晶體中辨認出這種化合物。
A dye study prepared flavopurpurin in a small batch. 染料研究以小批量製備了這種黃色晶體化合物。

meaning: 味道
sentences: I love the refreshing flavor of fresh strawberries and cream. 我喜愛新鮮草莓與鮮奶油的清爽風味。
The chef used various spices to enhance the flavor of the dish. 廚師使用各種香料來增進菜餚的風味。

meaning: 加入某種風味的；美式拼法，英式通常寫作 flavoured。
sentences: The children chose strawberry-flavored milk. 孩子們選了草莓口味的牛奶。
This lightly flavored tea needs no sugar. 這種淡淡調味的茶不需要加糖。

meaning: 調味者；用來添加風味的物質或成分。
sentences: The flavorer gave the sauce a smoky taste. 這種調味成分讓醬汁帶有煙燻味。
A natural flavorer replaced the artificial additive. 天然調味劑取代了人工添加物。

meaning: 風味濃郁而令人愉悅的；美味的。
sentences: The flavorful soup warmed us on the cold night. 那碗美味的湯在寒夜裡溫暖了我們。
Fresh herbs make a flavorful filling. 新鮮香草能做出風味濃郁的餡料。

meaning: 用來增加食物或飲料風味的調味料或成分。
sentences: Vanilla flavoring went into the cake batter. 香草調味料加進了蛋糕麵糊。
Read the label to check the flavoring source. 閱讀標籤以確認調味成分的來源。

meaning: 缺乏味道：平淡、單調。如何用無味造句
sentences: The specimen looked flavorless under the bright lab light. 在明亮的實驗室燈光下，標本看起來毫無味道。
An unusually flavorless figure stood at the center of the design. 一個異常平淡的人物站在設計的中心。

meaning: 味道鮮美的；風味佳的。
sentences: The flavorous stew drew everyone to the kitchen. 那鍋美味燉菜吸引大家走進廚房。
A flavorous sauce rescued the plain vegetables. 一份風味佳的醬汁救了平淡的蔬菜。

meaning: 風味豐富且通常令人愉悅的；可口的。
sentences: The chef served a flavorsome lentil soup. 主廚端上一碗風味豐富的扁豆湯。
Roasting brings out a flavorsome aroma. 烘烤能帶出令人愉悅的香氣。

meaning: 風味濃郁的，尤其用來形容茶。
sentences: This flavory tea pairs well with lemon. 這種風味濃郁的茶很適合搭配檸檬。
The farmer brewed a flavory black tea. 農夫泡了一壺味道濃郁的紅茶。

meaning: 英國標準風味拼寫。
sentences: The flavour of this apple pie is delicious. 這個蘋果派的味道很好吃。
Flavour was added to the pudding. 布丁中添加了風味。

meaning: 缺陷、瑕疵
sentences: The technician discovered a minor flaw in the new software's code. 技術員在新軟體的代碼中發現了一個微小的缺陷（瑕疵）。
There was a small flaw in the diamond, making it less valuable. 這顆鑽石有一個小瑕疵，使其價值降低了。

meaning: 有 缺陷 或 缺陷 。
sentences: Flawed diamonds are generally not used in jewellery. 有缺陷 的鑽石通常不用於珠寶。 有缺陷的鑽石一般不用於珠寶。 有缺陷的鑽石通常不用於珠寶。
His design for a perpetual motion machine is flawed because water does not flow uphill. 他的 永動機 的設計是 有缺陷的 ，因為水不會向上流。 他的永動機設計是有缺陷的，因為水不會向上流。 他的永動機的設計是有缺陷的，因為水不會向上流。

meaning: 花朵有瑕疵的植物（罕用語）。
sentences: The gardener removed a flawflower from the display. 園丁從展示區移除了一株花朵有瑕疵的植物。
A flawflower can still attract pollinating insects. 花朵有瑕疵的植物仍可能吸引授粉昆蟲。

meaning: 充滿缺陷的；有瑕疵的。
sentences: The inspector rejected the flawful batch of tiles. 檢查員拒收那批有瑕疵的磁磚。
A flawful design may fail under heavy use. 有缺陷的設計在重度使用下可能失效。

meaning: 沒有缺陷或瑕疵的；完美無瑕的。
sentences: The dancer delivered a flawless performance. 那名舞者呈現了完美無瑕的演出。
Her flawless pronunciation impressed the panel. 她完美的發音讓評審印象深刻。

meaning: 沒有缺陷或不完美：完美。如何用完美造句
sentences: Writers use flawlessly to mean having no flaw or imperfection: perfect. How to use flawless in a sentence. 作家用「完美」來表示沒有缺陷或不完美：完美。如何在句子中使用完美無瑕。
She acted flawlessly when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她表現得完美無缺。

meaning: 沒有缺陷或瑕疵的狀態；完美無瑕。
sentences: The jeweler admired the diamond's flawlessness. 珠寶商讚賞那顆鑽石的完美無瑕。
Practice helped the pianist approach flawlessness. 練習幫助鋼琴家逐漸接近完美。

meaning: 馬尼拉草，一種常用於草坪的暖地型草。
sentences: The gardener planted flawn along the walkway. 園丁沿著走道種下馬尼拉草。
Flawn grows well in the island's warm climate. 馬尼拉草在島上的溫暖氣候中生長良好。

meaning: 充滿瑕疵的，例如布滿裂痕的。
sentences: The flawy glaze made the pottery unusable. 布滿瑕疵的釉面讓那件陶器無法使用。
A flawy glass blurred the center of every image. 有瑕疵的玻璃讓每張影像中央都模糊。

meaning: Linum usitatissimum 的纖維，用於製造亞麻及相關紡織品。
sentences: The term flax refers to the fibers of Linum usitatissimum, grown to make linen and related textiles. 亞麻一詞是指用於製造亞麻及相關紡織品的亞麻纖維。
The lesson introduced flax as a useful term to understand. 本課程介紹了亞麻這個易於理解的有用術語。

meaning: 以亞麻纖維製成的板材（罕用語）。
sentences: The builder cut flaxboard for the cabinet door. 建築工人裁切亞麻纖維板來做櫃門。
Lightweight flaxboard lined the temporary shelter. 輕量的亞麻纖維板鋪在臨時避難所的內側。

meaning: 紐西蘭亞麻屬的灌木狀植物。
sentences: A flaxbush stood beside the coastal path. 一株紐西蘭亞麻灌木立在海岸小路旁。
The gardener divided the mature flaxbush in spring. 園丁在春天分株那株成熟的紐西蘭亞麻。

meaning: 亞麻菟絲子，一種寄生在亞麻上的菟絲子。
sentences: Farmers removed flaxdrop from the young crop. 農夫把亞麻菟絲子從幼苗中清除。
The survey found flaxdrop twining around flax stems. 調查發現亞麻菟絲子纏繞著亞麻莖。

meaning: 由亞麻製成的；呈淡黃亞麻色的。
sentences: She wore a flaxen shirt on the hot day. 她在炎熱的一天穿著亞麻製的襯衫。
The child had soft flaxen hair. 那個孩子有一頭柔軟的淡金色頭髮。

meaning: 類似亞麻的；像亞麻纖維或亞麻色的。
sentences: The flaxlike fibers were tough and pale. 那些像亞麻的纖維堅韌而淡色。
A flaxlike texture appeared in the woven fabric. 編織布料呈現類似亞麻的質感。

meaning: 約翰・弗拉克斯曼（1755—1826），英國雕塑家。
sentences: Flaxman designed illustrations for ancient poems. 弗拉克斯曼為古代詩作設計插圖。
The gallery displays a study by Flaxman. 美術館展示一幅弗拉克斯曼的習作。

meaning: 亞麻的種子，常用作食物、油料或膳食補充品。
sentences: She sprinkled flaxseed over her morning yogurt. 她把亞麻籽撒在早餐優格上。
The mill presses flaxseed for cooking oil. 榨油廠把亞麻籽壓榨成食用油。

meaning: 尾部或穗狀部分像亞麻纖維的植物（罕用語）。
sentences: The researcher noted a flaxtail near the wet meadow. 研究人員在濕草地附近記錄了一種尾穗像亞麻的植物。
A flaxtail bent gently in the evening wind. 那種植物的穗尾在晚風中輕輕彎動。

meaning: 柳穿魚屬植物，即蟾蜍亞麻。
sentences: Flaxweed grew among the stones beside the trail. 蟾蜍亞麻長在步道旁的石頭之間。
The gardener recognized flaxweed by its narrow leaves. 園丁從狹長葉片認出蟾蜍亞麻。

meaning: 金髮女子（罕用語）。
sentences: The ballad tells of a flaxwench by the river. 那首民謠講述河邊一名金髮女子的故事。
An artist sketched the flaxwench in the village square. 一名藝術家在村莊廣場描繪那位金髮女子。

meaning: 替人處理亞麻、製作亞麻纖維的婦女。
sentences: By sunset, the flaxwife had spun a basket of linen thread. 天黑前，這位亞麻工婦已紡好一籃亞麻線。
In the village, a flaxwife taught children how to prepare flax. 在村裡，一位亞麻工婦教孩子們處理亞麻。

meaning: 從事亞麻加工或紡織工作的婦女。
sentences: Near the river, the flaxwoman washed bundles of flax. 河邊那位亞麻女工正在清洗一捆捆亞麻。
At market, a flaxwoman sold finely spun linen yarn. 市集上，一位亞麻女工販售精細紡成的亞麻紗。

meaning: 亞麻屬植物的統稱，尤其指亞麻科的草本植物。
sentences: Along the dry slope, flaxwort opened small blue flowers. 乾燥坡地上，亞麻屬植物開出小藍花。
Gardeners grew flaxwort for its delicate blooms and useful seeds. 園丁種植亞麻屬植物，欣賞它細緻的花朵和實用的種子。

meaning: 像亞麻的，尤其指質地或顏色像亞麻的。
sentences: Her flaxy hair looked pale in the morning light. 她的亞麻色頭髮在晨光中顯得淡白。
This flaxy cloth feels dry and slightly rough. 這塊像亞麻的布摸起來乾爽而略粗。

meaning: 剝去皮或表皮；剝削得很徹底。
sentences: The hunter had to flay the hide before tanning it. 獵人得先剝下獸皮，才能進行鞣製。
High fees can flay a family already short of money. 高昂費用可能把一個缺錢的家庭榨得一乾二淨。

meaning: 剝皮的人或工具。
sentences: The butcher used a sharp flayer to remove the hide. 屠夫用鋒利的剝皮刀去除獸皮。
A skilled flayer left the hide smooth and unbroken. 熟練的剝皮工讓獸皮保持平整而完整。

meaning: 吝嗇鬼；極其不願花錢的人。
sentences: Everyone knew the flayflint would not tip the waiter. 大家都知道那個吝嗇鬼不會給服務生小費。
That old flayflint counted every coin before paying. 那個老吝嗇鬼付款前把每枚硬幣都數了一遍。

meaning: 跳蚤
sentences: The little dog had fleas and needed to be treated by a vet fast. 小狗身上有跳蚤，需要儘快由獸醫治療。
We visited a local flea market to buy some unique ancient artifacts. 我們逛了當地的跳蚤市場，買了一些獨特的古代文物。

meaning: 各種菊科植物的名稱，古人曾相信它能驅除跳蚤。
sentences: After the rain, fleabane brightened the edge of the path. 雨後，菊科驅蚤草讓小路邊明亮起來。
Bees visited the fleabane flowers all afternoon. 整個下午都有蜜蜂造訪驅蚤草的花。

meaning: 跳蚤叮咬；跳蚤咬出的紅點，也可指微小的不便。
sentences: One fleabite left a small red mark on his ankle. 一個跳蚤叮咬在他腳踝留下小紅點。
Compared with the flood, the repair cost was a fleabite. 和洪水相比，修理費只是小小的不便。

meaning: 款冬，一種大型菊科植物。
sentences: Beside the stream, fleadock spread its broad leaves. 溪流旁，款冬展開寬大的葉子。
The gardener moved fleadock to a cooler, damp corner. 園丁把款冬移到較涼且潮濕的角落。

meaning: 放血用的小刀；也指鋸齒呈等腰三角形的形狀。
sentences: The farmer kept a fleam for treating sick livestock. 農夫留著一把放血刀，用來處理生病的牲畜。
Each fleam tooth formed a neat triangular point. 每個三角鋸齒都形成整齊的三角尖端。

meaning: 車前草的種子，吸水膨脹後可作溫和的瀉劑；也指某些會脫落的蟲癭。
sentences: The herbalist measured fleaseed into a glass of water. 草藥師把車前子量入一杯水中。
When soaked, fleaseed becomes soft and gel-like. 泡水後，車前子會變得柔軟並呈凝膠狀。

meaning: 黃色床草；也指一種藍捲花植物。
sentences: In the meadow, fleaweed carried tiny yellow blossoms. 草地上，黃色床草開著細小的黃花。
A local name called the blue-flowered plant fleaweed. 當地人也把那種藍花植物稱為驅蚤草。

meaning: 一種帶有驅蚤傳統名稱的木本植物。
sentences: The herbal chest held a dried sprig of fleawood. 草藥箱裡放著一小枝乾燥的驅蚤木。
Smoke from fleawood was once used around stored cloth. 過去人們曾在存放布料的地方使用驅蚤木的煙。

meaning: 車前草屬的幾種舊世界植物，種子有時用作溫和瀉劑。
sentences: The gardener grew fleawort for its useful seeds. 園丁種植車前草，取用它有益的種子。
Moisture makes fleawort seeds swell into a gel. 水分會讓車前草種子膨脹成凝膠。

meaning: 英語姓氏，常見於人名中。
sentences: The surname Fleay appeared on the old family sign. 那個英語姓氏出現在古老的家族牌匾上。
A biography listed Fleay among the family names. 一本傳記把這個姓氏列在家族姓名中。

meaning: 含淚的；悲傷哀痛的。
sentences: Her flebile voice made the farewell especially sad. 她含淚的聲音讓告別更加哀傷。
The poem ends in a flebile mood of grief. 那首詩在含淚的哀傷情緒中結束。

meaning: 尖塔，尤其是教堂中殿與耳堂交會處上方的細長尖頂。

sentences: Floatability keeps the sealed container above water. 漂浮能力讓密封容器保持在水面上。
The engineer tested floatability in a deep tank. 工程師在深水槽中測試漂浮能力。

meaning: 能漂浮的
sentences: Floatable materials help build the rescue raft. 能漂浮的材料有助於建造救生筏。
The marked case proved floatable after the storm. 那個標記箱子在暴風雨後證明能漂浮。

meaning: 漂浮物；漂浮貨物
sentences: Floatage is an old spelling found in maritime writing. 漂浮物是海事文獻中的舊稱。
The harbor collected driftwood as floatage after the tide. 潮水退去後，港口收集了漂流木。

meaning: 漂浮的動作、過程或狀態
sentences: Floatation kept the injured swimmer above the surface. 漂浮狀態讓受傷的泳者保持在水面上。
The device uses floatation to remain upright. 這個裝置靠浮力保持直立。

meaning: 浮選的；與漂浮分離有關的
sentences: Floatative chemicals separate light particles from ore. 浮選用化學品能把輕質顆粒和礦石分開。
The plant adjusted its floatative mixture carefully. 工廠仔細調整了浮選混合液。

meaning: 水車或槳輪上的徑向葉板
sentences: Floatboard caught the current and turned the wheel. 水車葉板承受水流並帶動輪子。
A broken floatboard slowed the old water mill. 破裂的葉板使老水車轉慢了。

meaning: 漂浮的人或物；漂浮物
sentences: Floater drifted toward the quiet shore. 漂浮物慢慢漂向平靜的岸邊。
The nurse removed a small floater from the eye. 護士從眼睛裡取出一小點漂浮物。

meaning: 輕盈漂浮的感覺或特性
sentences: Floatiness gave the fabric a soft, airy feel. 輕盈感讓布料摸起來柔軟通透。
The dancer’s floatiness made each step seem weightless. 舞者的輕盈讓每一步都像沒有重量。

meaning: 漂浮的；浮動的
sentences: Floating leaves gathered beside the wooden dock. 漂浮的葉子聚在木碼頭旁。
The floating lanterns marked the festival route. 漂浮的燈籠標示了節慶路線。

meaning: 漂浮般地；輕盈不定地
sentences: Floatingly, the balloon rose above the rooftops. 氣球輕盈地升到屋頂上方。
The scarf drifted floatingly across the open window. 圍巾漂浮般地飄過敞開的窗戶。

meaning: 漂浮的；與漂浮有關的
sentences: Floative particles rose during the separation process. 浮選顆粒在分離過程中上升。
The floative layer formed above the heavier liquid. 漂浮層形成在較重的液體上方。

meaning: 沒有浮子：缺乏浮力
sentences: The specimen looked floatless under the bright lab light. 在明亮的實驗室燈光下，該標本看起來沒有漂浮物。
An unusually floatless figure stood at the center of the design. 一個異常不漂浮的人物站在設計的中心。

meaning: 製作花車或漂浮裝置的人
sentences: Floatmaker shaped the parade platform overnight. 花車製作者連夜搭好了遊行平台。
The skilled floatmaker balanced flowers around the frame. 熟練的花車製作者在框架周圍均勻配置花朵。

meaning: 在水上或漂浮物上工作的人
sentences: Floatman guided the raft through the narrow channel. 水上工人引導木筏穿過狹窄水道。
An experienced floatman checked the river cables. 有經驗的水上工人檢查了河上的纜繩。

meaning: 浮筒式水上飛機
sentences: Floatplane lifted from the calm northern lake. 浮筒式水上飛機從平靜的北方湖面起飛。
The pilot landed the floatplane beside the pier. 飛行員把水上飛機降落在碼頭旁。

meaning: 用旋轉砂磨台磨平石材的工人
sentences: Floatsman smoothed marble on the rotating table. 磨石工在旋轉台上磨平大理石。
The floatsman shaped a slab for the courthouse steps. 磨石工為法院階梯修整一塊石板。

meaning: 結核中的輕質多孔蛋白石
sentences: Floatstone feels unusually light for a stone. 這種蛋白石比一般石頭輕得異常。
The geologist identified floatstone inside the nodule. 地質學家在結核內辨認出這種多孔蛋白石。

meaning: 容易漂浮的；輕盈的
sentences: Floaty fabric lifted with every small breeze. 輕盈的布料隨每一陣微風飄起。
The floaty toy stayed on the pool’s surface. 輕浮玩具留在游泳池水面上。

meaning: 行動笨拙或漫無目的
sentences: Older manuals use flob to mean to be clumsy or aimless in moving. 較舊的手冊使用 行動笨拙或漫無目的 來表示移動時笨拙或漫無目的。
In practice, people flob when that action is required. 實際上，當需要採取這種行動時，人們會表現得手足無措。

meaning: 鬆軟而厚實的；懶散的
sentences: Flobby cushions sank beneath the sleepy dog. 鬆軟厚實的坐墊在睡狗身下凹陷。
His flobby coat made the child look rounder. 他蓬鬆的外套讓孩子看起來更圓。

meaning: 絮狀團塊
sentences: Floc gathered at the bottom of the settling tank. 絮狀團塊沉積在沉澱槽底部。
The filter removed each floc from the water. 過濾器把每個絮團都從水中除去。

meaning: 無意識地撫弄或摸索小物的動作
sentences: Floccillation kept her fingers busy during the wait. 等待時，無意識摸索讓她的手指有事可做。
His nervous floccillation stopped when the music began. 音樂開始後，他緊張摸索的動作便停止了。

meaning: 輕視；認為毫無價值
sentences: Floccipend empty praise when honest advice matters. 需要誠實建議時，不要輕視空洞的讚美。
She would not floccipend the apprentice’s careful work. 她不會把學徒仔細的工作視為毫無價值。

meaning: 覆有柔軟羊毛狀毛簇的；絮狀的
sentences: Floccose leaves looked pale beneath the morning dew. 絮狀葉片在晨露下顯得蒼白。
The floccose seed head broke apart in the wind. 絮狀種子頭在風中散開。

meaning: 具有或覆蓋著一簇柔軟的羊毛狀毛髮，通常是落葉的——尤其用於植物
sentences: Writers use floccosely to mean having or covered with tufts of soft woolly hairs that are often deciduous —used especially of plants. 作家們用「絮狀」來表示擁有或覆蓋著一簇柔軟的羊毛，這些毛髮通常是落葉的——尤其用於植物。
She acted floccosely when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她就會表現得很果斷。

meaning: 能形成絮凝物的；可絮凝的
sentences: Flocculable particles settled after gentle stirring. 可絮凝的顆粒在輕輕攪拌後沉降。
The water contained flocculable clay and silt. 水中含有可絮凝的黏土和淤泥。

meaning: 促使懸浮物形成絮凝團的試劑
sentences: Flocculant helped the muddy water clear quickly. 絮凝劑幫助混濁的水迅速變清。
The plant added flocculant before filtration. 處理廠在過濾前加入絮凝劑。

meaning: 絮狀小團塊的；與絮狀物有關的
sentences: Floccular deposits formed inside the narrow tube. 絮狀沉積物形成在細管內。
The microscope revealed floccular material in the specimen. 顯微鏡在標本中顯示出絮狀物質。

meaning: 形成絮凝團；使懸浮物凝聚
sentences: Flocculate the cloudy liquid before removing the solids. 先讓混濁液體絮凝，再移除固體。
Fine particles flocculate when the solution is mixed gently. 細小顆粒在溶液輕輕混合時會絮凝。

meaning: 形成絮凝團的過程
sentences: Flocculation removed fine clay from the drinking water. 絮凝過程移除了飲用水中的細黏土。
The operator monitored flocculation inside the settling basin. 操作員監測沉澱池中的絮凝過程。

meaning: 促成絮凝的裝置
sentences: Flocculator mixed the wastewater at a steady speed. 絮凝裝置以穩定速度攪拌廢水。
A compact flocculator fit beside the treatment tank. 小型絮凝裝置剛好放在處理槽旁。

meaning: 絮狀小團塊
sentences: Floccule drifted slowly through the clear solution. 絮狀小團塊在澄清溶液中慢慢漂移。
The filter trapped every visible floccule. 濾網截住了每個看得見的絮團。

meaning: 絮狀或鬆散聚集的狀態
sentences: Flocculence increased as the clay particles joined. 黏土顆粒聚合後，絮狀程度增加。
The liquid’s flocculence signaled incomplete mixing. 液體的絮狀程度顯示混合尚未完成。

meaning: 絮狀或鬆散聚集的狀態
sentences: Flocculency made the suspension look cloudy and soft. 絮狀程度讓懸浮液看起來混濁柔軟。
Researchers measured flocculency after adding salt. 研究人員在加鹽後測量絮狀程度。

meaning: 像羊毛般蓬鬆鬆散的；絮狀的
sentences: Flocculent fibers formed a loose white layer. 絮狀纖維形成鬆散的白色層。
The flocculent cloud broke apart under gentle pressure. 蓬鬆絮狀的雲在輕壓下散開。

meaning: 以蓬鬆絮狀的方式
sentences: Flocculently, the fibers spread across the wet surface. 纖維蓬鬆地散布在潮濕表面。
The residue settled flocculently inside the dish. 殘留物以絮狀方式沉積在碟子裡。

meaning: 帶有小絮狀毛簇的；略呈絮狀的
sentences: Flocculose stems carried tiny woolly tufts. 絮狀莖上長著細小的羊毛狀毛簇。
The flocculose coating protected the young leaves. 絮狀覆層保護了幼葉。

meaning: 鬆散聚集的小團塊
sentences: Flocculus formed when the fine powder met water. 細粉遇水後形成絮狀小團塊。
A single flocculus floated near the glass wall. 一個絮團漂浮在玻璃壁附近。

meaning: 植物上的羊毛狀毛簇；菌絲團
sentences: Floccus covered the stem with a soft white tuft. 羊毛狀毛簇覆蓋了莖。
The fungus produced a dense floccus after rain. 這種真菌雨後形成密集的菌絲團。

meaning: 群
sentences: A large flock of wild geese was flying south for the winter. 一大群大雁正向南飛去度冬。
The shepherd spent the whole afternoon tending his flock of sheep. 牧羊人花了一整下午照看他的羊群。

meaning: 成群活動的動物；成群者
sentences: Flocker birds gathered above the marsh at dusk. 成群的鳥在黃昏聚集到沼澤上空。
Each flocker followed the group toward warmer fields. 每隻成群動物都跟著隊伍往溫暖的田野去。

meaning: 植絨裝飾；絨毛圖案
sentences: Flocking gave the wallpaper a soft raised pattern. 植絨讓壁紙有柔軟凸起的圖案。
The red flocking stood out against the dark paper. 紅色絨毛圖案在深色紙面上很醒目。

meaning: 沒有羊群的；不成群的
sentences: Flockless hills looked strangely quiet at sunset. 沒有羊群的山坡在夕陽下顯得異常安靜。
The flockless pasture needed a new use. 沒有羊群的牧場需要尋找新的用途。

meaning: 像羊群的；成團聚集的
sentences: Flocklike clouds gathered over the open field. 像羊群的雲聚集在開闊田野上方。
The flocklike pattern moved across the screen. 成群般的圖案在螢幕上移動。

meaning: 牧羊人；照料羊群的人
sentences: Flockman led the sheep toward the lower pasture. 牧羊人把羊帶往較低的牧場。
The village hired a flockman before winter began. 村子在冬天開始前雇了一名牧羊人。

meaning: 羊群的主人或監督者
sentences: Flockmaster counted every sheep before the storm. 羊群監督者在暴風雨前數清每隻羊。
The flockmaster repaired the gate at dawn. 羊群主人在黎明時修好了柵門。

meaning: 羊群的主人
sentences: Flockowner sold wool at the autumn market. 羊群主人在秋季市集販售羊毛。
The flockowner marked each lamb with care. 羊群主人細心標記每隻小羊。

meaning: 成群地；以羊群的方式
sentences: Flockwise, the sheep crossed the narrow bridge. 羊群一樣地，綿羊走過狹窄的橋。
The birds moved flockwise above the marsh. 鳥兒成群地飛過沼澤。

meaning: 像羊群的；充滿羊群的
sentences: Flocky clouds filled the blue evening sky. 像羊群的雲填滿藍色的傍晚天空。
The flocky meadow echoed with soft bleats. 充滿羊群的草地迴盪著輕柔咩聲。

meaning: 絮狀繭；由絨毛包成的繭狀物
sentences: Flocoon protected the insect through the cold season. 絮狀繭保護昆蟲度過寒冷季節。
The pale flocoon hung beneath a broad leaf. 淡色絮繭掛在寬大的葉子下。

meaning: 水池；水坑
sentences: Flodge formed where the broken drain met the road. 破裂的排水管在路上形成水坑。
Children jumped over the muddy flodge. 孩子們跳過泥濘的水坑。

meaning: 水面上大片的浮冰
sentences: Floe drifted slowly beyond the research vessel. 浮冰在極地海域的船隻旁緩緩漂過。
A seal rested on a broad floe. 一隻海豹躺在大片浮冰上。

meaning: 像冰山的丘狀浮冰團
sentences: Floeberg rose above the flat field of sea ice. 丘狀浮冰團高高隆起於平坦的海冰之上。
The ship changed course around the dangerous floeberg. 船隻繞過危險的丘狀浮冰團改變航向。

meaning: 大片浮冰的複數形式
sentences: Floes drifted past the vessel in the polar sea. 大片浮冰在極地海域的船隻旁漂過。
Seals rested on separate floes near the coast. 海豹躺在海岸附近分散的浮冰上。

meaning: 像浮冰的；覆有浮冰的
sentences: Floey waters surrounded the remote northern island. 像浮冰的水域包圍了偏遠的北方島嶼。
The floey bay stayed closed to small boats. 覆有浮冰的海灣讓小船無法通行。

meaning: 用或好像用棒子或鞭子敲打。如何使用鞭打造句
sentences: Older manuals use flog to mean to beat with or as if with a rod or whip. How to use flog in a sentence. 較舊的手冊使用“用或好像用棒子或鞭子敲打。如何使用鞭打造句”來表示用棍子或鞭子毆打或好像用棍子或鞭子毆打。如何在句子中使用鞭打。
In practice, people flog when that action is required. 實際上，當需要採取行動時，人們會進行鞭打。

meaning: 值得鞭打的；該受嚴厲懲罰的
sentences: Floggable offenses once received harsh physical punishment. 過去，值得鞭打的罪行會受到肉體懲罰。
The old law labeled theft floggable. 舊法把偷竊列為應受鞭刑的罪行。

meaning: 鞭打的人；鞭打工具
sentences: Flogger stood beside the antique punishment display. 鞭打工具放在古代刑罰展品旁。
The rider carried a leather flogger for the stubborn mule. 騎手帶著皮鞭對付那頭固執的騾子。

meaning: 透過毆打或鞭打進行懲罰。
sentences: What lawbreakers like that need is a good flogging. Do that and watch the crime rate plummet. 像這樣的不法之徒所需要的就是一頓狠狠的鞭打。這樣做，就會看到犯罪率直線下降。
The term flogging refers to Infliction of punishment by dealing blows or whipping. 鞭打一詞是指透過毆打或鞭打來施加懲罰。

meaning: 以鞭打方式；猛烈地
sentences: Floggingly, the waves struck the exposed pier. 海浪猛烈地拍打暴露在外的碼頭。
The old tale describes the wind floggingly against the sails. 古老故事描述強風猛烈地吹打船帆。

meaning: 負責鞭打的人；鞭刑執行者
sentences: Flogmaster carried out the sentence under the old code. 鞭刑執行者依照舊法執行判決。
The history book describes a flogmaster at the prison. 歷史書描述監獄裡的一名鞭刑執行者。

meaning: 鞭打者；施以鞭刑的人
sentences: Flogster appeared in the dramatic historical scene. 鞭打者出現在戲劇性的歷史場景中。
The novel portrays the flogster as a feared official. 小說把鞭打者描寫成令人畏懼的官員。

meaning: 產自冰島的沸石礦物，呈細長無色或黃綠色晶體
sentences: Flokite forms slender pale crystals in Icelandic rock. 這種礦物在冰島岩石中形成細長的淡色晶體。
The collector placed flokite beside other zeolite minerals. 收藏家把它放在其他沸石礦物旁。

meaning: 製作鉛版模子的多層紙張
sentences: Flong preserved the raised type for making a printing matrix. 多層紙張保留凸起字樣，以製作印刷模子。
The printer pressed flong against the arranged letters. 印刷工把紙模壓在排好的鉛字上。

meaning: 洪水
sentences: The heavy rain caused severe flooding in the low-lying areas. 大雨導致低窪地區嚴重淹水。
The news of the discovery managed to flood the entire media. 發現的消息竟然充斥（淹沒）了整個媒體。

meaning: 能被洪水淹沒的；容易受洪水影響的
sentences: Floodable fields need drainage before heavy summer rain. 容易淹水的田地在夏季大雨前需要排水。
The floodable road closes whenever the river rises. 容易淹水的道路在河水上漲時會封閉。

meaning: 淹沒的狀態；洪水氾濫
sentences: Floodage covered the lower fields after the storm. 暴風雨後，淹水覆蓋了低窪農田。
Residents measured floodage along the riverbank. 居民沿著河岸測量淹水範圍。

meaning: 防洪插板；擋水板
sentences: Floodboard blocked the doorway before the river rose. 河水上漲前，擋水板封住了門口。
Workers fitted each floodboard into its metal slot. 工人把每塊防洪板裝進金屬槽。

meaning: 讓海水流入船艙的旋塞
sentences: Floodcock could admit seawater into the ship’s powder room. 這個旋塞能讓海水流入船上的火藥庫。
The sailor inspected the floodcock before departure. 水手在出航前檢查了進水旋塞。

meaning: 充滿過多事物而不堪負荷的
sentences: Flooded inboxes made urgent messages hard to find. 塞滿訊息的收件匣讓急件很難找到。
The market was flooded with cheap imported goods. 市場充斥著廉價進口商品。

meaning: 造成洪水或淹水的人或事物
sentences: Flooder pumps pushed water through the damaged canal. 抽水機把水推過受損的運河。
The broken valve became the main flooder overnight. 故障閥門整晚成了主要的淹水源。

meaning: 關閉、引入或釋放水流的閘門
sentences: Floodgate opened when the reservoir reached its limit. 水庫到達上限時，水閘便打開。
The keeper lowered the floodgate before the storm. 管理員在暴風雨前放下水閘。

meaning: 水體上升溢出並淹沒土地的情況
sentences: Flooding closed three roads after the overnight rain. 隔夜大雨造成淹水，三條道路因此封閉。
Coastal flooding damaged several wooden houses. 沿海淹水損壞了幾棟木屋。

meaning: 沒有洪水的；不受洪水侵襲的
sentences: Floodless seasons allowed farmers to repair the banks. 沒有洪水的季節讓農夫能修整堤岸。
The floodless valley attracted new vegetable growers. 不受洪水侵襲的山谷吸引了新的菜農。

meaning: 小股洪水；小範圍的淹水
sentences: Floodlet ran across the path after the brief storm. 短暫暴風雨後，小股洪水流過小徑。
A sandbag stopped the floodlet at the doorway. 沙袋擋住了門口的小股淹水。

meaning: 以寬光束提供照明的燈；泛光燈
sentences: Floodlight brightened the stadium after sunset. 日落後，泛光燈照亮了體育場。
One floodlight shone over the rescue site. 一盞泛光燈照向救援現場。

meaning: 用寬光束照明；泛光照明
sentences: Floodlighting kept the outdoor court usable at night. 泛光照明讓戶外球場晚上也能使用。
The theater installed floodlighting around its entrance. 劇院在入口周圍裝設了寬束照明。

meaning: 對花卉的過度迷戀
sentences: Florimania filled her house with every kind of orchid. 對花卉的過度迷戀讓她把家裡塞滿各種蘭花。
Florimania inspired an enormous private garden. 花卉迷戀促成了一座巨大的私人花園。

meaning: 沉迷花卉的人
sentences: Florimanist collected unusual orchids from many regions. 沉迷花卉的人從許多地區收藏蘭花。
Florimanist spent weekends designing new flower beds. 花卉迷戀者利用週末設計新的花圃。

meaning: 佛羅倫斯起源的古金幣；弗羅林
sentences: Florin was accepted by merchants across medieval Europe. 弗羅林曾被中世紀歐洲各地的商人接受。
Florin bears a design associated with Florence. 弗羅林帶有與佛羅倫斯相關的圖案。

meaning: 能產生花而非果實的
sentences: Floriparous shoots produced extra blossoms after pruning. 能產生花朵的枝條修剪後長出更多花。
Floriparous growth reduced the plant’s fruit yield. 產花型生長降低了植物的結果量。

meaning: 木本曼陀羅屬的熱帶灌木或小喬木
sentences: Floripondio produced large white trumpet-shaped flowers. 木本曼陀羅開出大型白色喇叭形花朵。
Floripondio seeds are poisonous if eaten. 木本曼陀羅的種子食用後有毒。

meaning: 觀察花朵的儀器
sentences: Floriscope enlarged the details of a tiny flower. 花卉觀察儀放大了小花的細節。
Floriscope helped the gardener compare pollen structures. 花卉觀察儀幫助園丁比較花粉結構。

meaning: 花店店員；花藝師
sentences: Florist arranged lilies for the wedding. 花藝師為婚禮排列百合花。
Florist wrapped the bouquet in recycled paper. 花店店員用再生紙包好花束。

meaning: 植物區系的；與植物種類分布有關的
sentences: Floristic surveys listed every plant on the island. 植物區系調查列出了島上的每種植物。
Floristic patterns changed with the altitude. 植物種類分布會隨海拔改變。

meaning: 屬於或涉及花卉、植物區系或植物和植物類群的生物地理學研究
sentences: Writers use floristically to mean of or relating to flowers, a flora, or the biogeographic study of plants and plant groups. 作者使用 屬於或涉及花卉、植物區系或植物和植物類群的生物地理學研究 來表示或與花、植物區系或植物和植物類群的生物地理學研究相關。
She acted floristically when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她就會採取花式行動。

meaning: 植物區系學；研究植物種類分布的學科
sentences: Floristics compares plant communities across regions. 植物區系學比較不同地區的植物群落。
Floristics helped map the valley’s native species. 植物區系學幫助繪製山谷原生物種的分布圖。

meaning: 花藝；插花的技藝
sentences: Floristry combines color, shape, and seasonal flowers. 花藝結合色彩、形狀與當季花卉。
Floristry lessons taught her to balance a bouquet. 花藝課教她讓花束保持平衡。

meaning: 吸食花蜜的；以花蜜為食的鳥類
sentences: Florisugent birds hovered beside the red flowers. 吸食花蜜的鳥在紅花旁振翅懸停。
Florisugent feeding helps carry pollen between blossoms. 以花蜜為食的鳥會幫助花朵傳播花粉。

meaning: 以花為食的
sentences: Florivorous insects damaged the young buds. 以花為食的昆蟲損害了新生花苞。
Florivorous beetles gathered on the petals. 以花為食的甲蟲聚集在花瓣上。

meaning: 花卉裝飾圖案
sentences: Floroon appeared above the carved doorway. 花卉裝飾圖案出現在雕刻門口上方。
Floroon gave the old cabinet a delicate finish. 花卉圖案讓老櫃子呈現細緻的收尾。

meaning: 以花卉象徵解讀性格或命運的方法
sentences: Floroscope matched her personality with a flower. 花卉占測以一種花代表她的性格。
Floroscope uses flower symbols instead of star signs. 花卉占測使用花朵符號，而不是星座。

meaning: 小型植物區系；小植物群
sentences: Florula recorded the plants of the small island. 小型植物區系記錄了小島上的植物。
Florula included several mosses and tiny ferns. 這份小植物群記錄包含幾種苔蘚與小蕨類。

meaning: 開花的；如花的
sentences: Florulent shrubs brightened the roadside. 開花的灌木讓路旁明亮起來。

meaning: 飾有百合花圖案的；花飾的
sentences: Flory borders decorated the royal shield. 百合花圖案的邊飾裝飾著王室盾徽。
Flory motifs appeared on the medieval banner. 花飾圖案出現在中世紀旗幟上。

meaning: 絮狀的；呈小團絮狀的
sentences: Floscular clusters formed in the clear solution. 透明溶液中形成了絮狀小團。
Floscular material settled at the bottom of the jar. 絮狀物沉降在罐子底部。

meaning: 花冠輪蟲類的動物
sentences: Floscularian attached itself to the water plant. 花冠輪蟲附著在水生植物上。
Floscularian females form a tube-like home. 花冠輪蟲雌體會形成管狀居所。

meaning: 小花；花序中的小花
sentences: Floscule opened at the center of the flower head. 花序中央的小花綻放了。

meaning: 由小花組成的
sentences: Flosculose heads covered the meadow in summer. 由小花組成的花序在夏天覆滿草地。

meaning: 由小花組成的；小花密集的

Flosculous blooms formed a round cluster. 小花密集的花朵形成圓形花簇。

meaning: 泥濘的水窪；軟泥
sentences: Flosh collected in the hollow after the storm. 暴雨後，凹地積起了泥濘水窪。
Flosh made the cart wheels sink into the ground. 軟泥讓推車的輪子陷進地面。

meaning: 牙線；絲線
sentences: Floss removed food caught between her teeth. 牙線清除了卡在她齒間的食物。

meaning: 使用牙線的人；牙線工具
sentences: Flosser reached the back teeth with ease. 牙線工具能輕鬆清潔後排牙齒。
Flosser reminded him to clean between every tooth. 使用牙線的人提醒他要清潔每個齒縫。

meaning: 藿香屬植物；藿香花
sentences: Flossflower produced blue blooms beside the path. 藿香花在小徑旁開出藍色花朵。
Flossflower attracts butterflies in warm weather. 藿香屬植物在溫暖天氣會吸引蝴蝶。

meaning: 變成絲狀或牙線狀的過程
sentences: Flossification made the material easier to separate into strands. 變成絲狀後，這種材料更容易分成細股。

meaning: 刺繡用的柔軟絲線或絲光棉線
sentences: Flossing gave the embroidered leaves a soft sheen. 刺繡用絲線讓葉片呈現柔和光澤。

meaning: 像牙線的；柔軟絲狀的
sentences: Flossy fibers clung to the seed. 柔軟絲狀的纖維黏在種子上。

meaning: 漂浮物；浮動的一團

meaning: 西班牙船隊
sentences: Flota sailed west with supplies for the colony. 西班牙船隊載著物資向西航行。
Flota guarded the trade route for several months. 西班牙船隊守護貿易航線數月。

meaning: 漂浮物；漂浮狀態
sentences: Flotage covered the pond after the flood. 洪水過後，漂浮物覆蓋了池塘。
Flotage kept the light marker visible on the water. 漂浮狀態讓輕質標記留在水面上。

meaning: 漂浮的；浮動的
sentences: Flotant leaves gathered along the stream. 漂浮的葉子聚集在溪流邊。
Flotant debris moved with the tide. 漂浮的碎屑隨潮汐移動。

meaning: 漂浮或漂浮的狀態。

sentences: Flotative methods separated the ore from the waste. 浮選方法把礦石與廢料分離。
Flotative treatment removed the fine particles. 浮選處理移除了細小顆粒。

meaning: 小型艦隊；小船隊
sentences: Flotilla crossed the bay before sunrise. 小型艦隊在日出前穿越海灣。
Flotilla of rescue boats reached the island quickly. 救援小船隊迅速抵達島嶼。

meaning: 由多個選區共同選出的議員或選區的
sentences: Flotorial representation joined several districts together. 聯合選區代表制把數個選區聯合在一起。

meaning: 漂浮的失事船舶殘骸；漂流物
sentences: Flotsam washed onto the beach after the wreck. 船難後，漂流殘骸被沖上沙灘。
Flotsam marked the path of the damaged boat. 漂流物標示出受損船隻的航跡。

meaning: 荷葉邊；突然大幅度地動作

sentences: Flouncey sleeves made the dress look playful. 多荷葉邊的袖子讓洋裝看起來活潑。
Flouncey curtains crowded the small window. 過分裝飾的窗簾擠滿了小窗。

meaning: 荷葉邊裝飾；荷葉邊布料
sentences: Flouncing gave the costume a dramatic outline. 荷葉邊裝飾讓服裝輪廓更有戲劇感。
Flouncing was sewn around the pillow cover. 荷葉邊布料被縫在枕套周圍。

meaning: 比目魚
sentences: Flounder rested on the sandy seabed. 比目魚伏在沙質海床上。
Flounder changed color to match the bottom. 比目魚變換體色來融入海底。

meaning: 苦苦掙扎的；進展不順的
sentences: Floundering swimmers were pulled toward the shore. 苦苦掙扎的游泳者被拉向岸邊。
Floundering negotiations needed a fresh proposal. 進展不順的談判需要新的提案。

meaning: 掙扎地
sentences: Writers use flounderingly to mean in a floundering manner. 作家們用掙扎的方式來表示掙扎的方式。
She acted flounderingly when the situation demanded it. 當情勢需要時，她就會舉棋不定。

meaning: 麵粉
sentences: The baker used high-quality organic flour to make the bread. 烘焙師使用高品質的有機麵粉製作麵包。
She added some fresh whole wheat flour to the pancake batter. 她在鬆餅糊中加入了一些新鮮的全麥麵粉。

meaning: 繁榮、茂盛
sentences: Small businesses can flourish if they provide high-quality products. 如果提供高品質的產品，小企業就能繁榮發展（興旺）。

meaning: 能蓬勃發展的；能繁榮的
sentences: Flourishable crops need rich soil and steady water. 能蓬勃生長的作物需要肥沃土壤與穩定水分。

meaning: 蓬勃發展的人或事物
sentences: Flourisher turned the neglected garden into a haven. 善於讓事物蓬勃發展的人把荒置花園變成了樂園。
Flourisher plants thrive beside the sunny wall. 生長旺盛的植物在向陽牆邊茂盛生長。

meaning: 繁榮；蓬勃發展
sentences: Flourishing brought new shops to the village. 繁榮為村莊帶來了新商店。
Flourishing followed years of careful investment. 多年的謹慎投資後迎來了蓬勃發展。

meaning: 以旺盛和健康的成長為標誌：非常活躍和成功。如何用繁榮造句
sentences: Writers use flourishingly to mean marked by vigorous and healthy growth: very active and successful. How to use flourishing in a sentence. 作家們用蓬勃發展來表示充滿活力和健康的成長：非常活躍和成功。如何在句子中使用繁榮。
