meaning: 繁榮；興盛
sentences: Flourishment of the port created many jobs. 港口的繁榮創造了許多工作。
Flourishment depends on stable trade and good roads. 興盛有賴穩定貿易與良好道路。

meaning: 華麗炫目的；過度裝飾的
sentences: Flourishy lettering covered the wedding card. 華麗炫目的字體覆蓋了婚禮卡片。
Flourishy details distracted from the simple design. 過度裝飾的細節分散了人們對簡潔設計的注意。

meaning: 像麵粉的；粉末狀的
sentences: Flourlike dust settled on the workbench. 像麵粉的粉塵落在工作臺上。
Flourlike particles mixed easily with water. 粉末狀顆粒很容易與水混合。

meaning: 覆有麵粉的；粉狀的
sentences: Floury hands left marks on the cupboard. 沾滿麵粉的手在櫥櫃上留下痕跡。
Floury dough covered the wooden board. 覆有麵粉的麵團放在木板上。

meaning: 少量；一小撮
sentences: Flouse of sugar sweetened the bitter drink. 一小撮糖讓苦飲料變甜。
Flouse of dust remained in the empty bowl. 空碗裡只剩少量灰塵。

meaning: 公然蔑視；藐視
sentences: Flout the safety rules and the machine may injure someone. 公然蔑視安全規則，機器可能會傷人。
Flout local customs and you may offend your hosts. 藐視當地習俗可能會冒犯主人。

meaning: 蔑視規則的人
sentences: Flouter ignored the warning signs at the crossing. 蔑視規則的人無視路口的警告標誌。
Flouter was fined for breaking the display barrier. 違規者因破壞展示隔離欄而被罰款。

meaning: 輕蔑地對待：蔑視。如何在句子中使用 flout。你可知道？ Flaunt 與 Flout：使用指南 Flout 的同義字討論
sentences: Older manuals use flouting to mean to treat with contemptuous disregard: scorn. How to use flout in a sentence. Did you know? Flaunt vs. Flout: Usage Guide Synonym Discussion of Flout. 較舊的手冊使用“蔑視”來表示輕蔑地對待：蔑視。如何在句子中使用 flout。你可知道？ Flaunt 與 Flout：使用指南 Flout 的同義詞討論。
In practice, people flouting when that action is required. 實際上，當需要採取這種行動時，人們就會蔑視。

meaning: 以嘲笑或輕蔑的方式：輕蔑地
sentences: Writers use floutingly to mean in a mocking or contemptuous manner: with flouts. 作家們使用 以嘲笑或輕蔑的方式：輕蔑地 來表示以嘲笑或輕蔑的方式：用 flouting。
She acted floutingly when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她就會做出蔑視的舉動。

meaning: 流動
sentences: The river flows through the heart of the ancient city. 河流貫穿了這座古城的中心。

meaning: 能流動的；可泵送的

meaning: 水流或氾濫的範圍；積水

meaning: 花
sentences: The garden is full of beautiful colorful flowers in spring. 春天時花園裡開滿了美麗繽紛的花朵。

meaning: 插花
sentences: She practices flower arranging every Saturday. 她每週六練習插花。
Flower arranging made the room feel fresh. 插花讓房間感覺更清新。

meaning: 花坛
sentences: Grandma planted roses in the flower bed. 奶奶在花壇裡種玫瑰。

meaning: 花圃
sentences: She bought seedlings from the flower nursery. 她從花圃買了幼苗。
The flower nursery opens early in spring. 那座花圃春天很早就開門。

meaning: 開花的過程或狀態
sentences: Flowerage began with the first warm days. 開花在最初幾個暖和日子開始。
Flowerage covered the orchard in white. 花期讓果園覆上一片白色。

meaning: 有花卉圖案的；飾有花朵的
sentences: Flowered curtains framed the sunny window. 花卉圖案的窗簾襯托著陽光充足的窗戶。

meaning: 在特定時節開花的植物

meaning: 充滿花朵的；花繁盛的

Flowerful vines climbed the stone wall. 花朵繁盛的藤蔓爬上石牆。

meaning: 華麗地

meaning: 語言或風格過分華麗的特性
sentences: Floweriness made the speech sound less practical. 過分華麗的語言讓演講聽起來不切實際。

meaning: 開花；繁盛發展

meaning: 花卉專家；花藝師
sentences: Flowerist chose stems that would last through the ceremony. 花藝師挑選了能撐過典禮的花莖。

meaning: 沒有花的
sentences: Flowerless plants can still have attractive leaves. 沒有花的植物仍可能擁有美麗葉片。

meaning: 沒有花的狀態

Flowerlessness made the bare branches look severe. 沒有花讓光禿枝條看起來很冷峻。

meaning: 小花
sentences: Flowerlet appeared at the edge of the cluster. 小花出現在花簇邊緣。
Flowerlet attracted a tiny flying insect. 小花吸引了一隻小飛蟲。

meaning: 像花的；具有花朵特徵的
sentences: Flowerlike shapes decorated the ceramic bowl. 像花的形狀裝飾著陶碗。
Flowerlike colors made the fabric feel graceful. 花朵般的色彩讓布料顯得優雅。

meaning: 以漿果和昆蟲為食的短尾小型雀形鳥
sentences: A flowerpecker tasted berries on the branch. 一隻啄花鳥啄食枝上的莓果。

meaning: 回花盆
sentences: He put the basil in a small flowerpot. 他把羅勒種在小花盆裡。

meaning: 花，花模
sentences: She put fresh flowers on the table. 她把新鮮的花放在桌上。
The flowers smelled sweet after the rain. 雨後的花聞起來很香。

meaning: 花卉裝飾作品；花形工藝
sentences: Flowerwork covered the ceiling of the old hall. 花卉裝飾作品覆蓋著老大廳的天花板。
Flowerwork was carved into the wooden screen. 花形工藝被雕刻在木屏風上。

meaning: 花的；華麗多辭的
sentences: Flowery curtains softened the plain bedroom. 花卉窗簾讓樸素臥室顯得柔和。
Flowery language made the short message seem grand. 華麗多辭的語言讓簡短訊息顯得誇張。

meaning: 流動的；流暢的
sentences: Flowing water covered the smooth stones. 流動的水覆過光滑的石頭。

meaning: 以便流動或看似流動。如何用流暢造句
sentences: Writers use flowingly to mean so as to flow or seem to flow. How to use flowingly in a sentence. 作家使用“流暢”來表示“流暢”或“似乎流暢”。如何在句子中使用流暢。
She acted flowingly when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她表現得十分流暢。

meaning: 流動或連貫的特性
sentences: Flowingness made the dance look effortless. 流動感讓舞蹈看起來毫不費力。
Flowingness improved the rhythm of her speech. 連貫性改善了她說話的節奏。

meaning: 維持流量穩定的裝置
sentences: Flowmanostat kept the liquid moving at a steady rate. 流量穩壓器讓液體保持穩定流速。
Flowmanostat protected the pump from sudden changes. 流量穩壓器保護幫浦免受突然變化影響。

meaning: 測量流體流量的儀器；流量計
sentences: Flowmeter showed that water was moving too quickly. 流量計顯示水流速度過快。
Flowmeter readings helped adjust the pipe valve. 流量計讀數幫助人員調整管閥。

meaning: fly 的過去分詞；已飛行的
sentences: They have flown to Osaka for the weekend. 他們搭飛機到大阪度週末。
He had flown alone before his twentieth birthday. 他在二十歲前就曾獨自搭機飛行。

meaning: 流走的水；地表徑流
sentences: Flowoff carried soil into the roadside drain. 地表徑流把土壤帶進路旁排水溝。
Flowoff increased after the hillside was cleared. 山坡被清除植被後，徑流增加了。

meaning: 流感
sentences: Several students were absent from class today because of the flu. 今天有幾位學生因為流感而缺席。
You should get a flu vaccination every year to protect your health. 你應該每年接種流感疫苗以保護健康。

meaning: 流威病毒
sentences: The flu virus spread quickly through the school. 流感病毒很快在學校裡傳開。
Doctors watched for changes in the flu virus. 醫生觀察流感病毒的變化。

meaning: 氟矽酸鹽；用於石材防水的溶液
sentences: Fluate sealed the porous stone against rain. 氟矽酸鹽溶液封閉了多孔石材，使其防雨。
Fluate treatment reduced water absorption in the concrete. 氟矽酸鹽處理降低了混凝土的吸水率。

meaning: 從古塔膠和巴拉塔樹膠提取的無定形黃色樹脂
sentences: Fluavil formed a yellow film as the extract dried. 這種樹脂萃取物乾燥時形成黃色薄膜。
Fluavil was separated from the plant gum. 研究人員從植物樹膠中分離出這種黃色樹脂。

meaning: 把事情搞砸；笨拙地做錯
sentences: Flub the opening line and the audience may lose focus. 開場白說錯，觀眾可能會失去注意力。
Flub a simple pass and the other team may score. 簡單傳球失誤，對方可能就會得分。

meaning: 胡說八道；空話
sentences: Flubdub filled the speech without offering a plan. 空話充斥演講，卻沒有提出計畫。
Flubdub cannot replace clear evidence. 胡說八道不能取代清楚證據。

meaning: 胡說八道的言論或行為
sentences: Flubdubbery distracted the audience from the real issue. 胡說八道的言論讓觀眾偏離真正問題。
Flubdubbery filled the meeting with empty promises. 空洞承諾讓會議充滿了胡言亂語。

meaning: 一種氟化物礦物
sentences: Flucan formed pale grains in the ore. 這種氟化物礦物在礦石中形成淡色顆粒。
Flucan was stored separately from moisture-sensitive stones. 這種礦物被和怕潮的石材分開保存。

meaning: 產生波動或起伏的
sentences: Fluctiferous currents rocked the small boat. 起伏的水流搖晃著小船。
Fluctiferous pressure caused the gauge needle to swing. 波動的壓力使儀表指針擺動。

meaning: 帶有波動或起伏的
sentences: Fluctigerous waves crossed the shallow bay. 起伏的波浪穿過淺海灣。
Fluctigerous motion disturbed the floating marker. 波動的運動擾動了漂浮標記。

meaning: 發出波動或顫動聲的
sentences: Fluctisonant reeds hummed beside the moving water. 發出顫動聲的蘆葦在流水旁嗡鳴。
Fluctisonant pipes changed pitch with the pressure. 會發出波動聲的管子隨壓力改變音高。

meaning: 聲音隨波動而變化的
sentences: Fluctisonous tones rose and fell in the chamber. 聲音隨波動變化的音調在室內起伏。
Fluctisonous vibrations made the metal sing. 變化不定的振動讓金屬發出聲音。

meaning: 容易波動的性質
sentences: Fluctuability makes the price difficult to predict. 容易波動的性質讓價格難以預測。
Fluctuability increased when demand changed suddenly. 需求突然改變時，波動性便提高。

meaning: 容易波動的；可變動的
sentences: Fluctuable prices require careful budgeting. 容易波動的價格需要仔細編列預算。
Fluctuable water levels worried the farmers. 不穩定的水位讓農民擔心。

meaning: 波浪式移動的；起伏的
sentences: Fluctuant currents pushed the raft toward the bank. 起伏的水流把木筏推向河岸。
Fluctuant light shimmered across the ceiling. 波動的光線在天花板上閃爍。

meaning: 優柔寡斷；動搖。
sentences: I fluctuated between wishing he was back home and wishing I'd never met him. 我在希望他回家和希望我從未見過他之間搖擺不定。
People often fluctuate when the situation calls for it. 當情況需要時，人們常常會波動。

meaning: 波動；不規則的升降變化
sentences: A sudden fluctuation changed the room temperature. 突然的波動改變了室內溫度。
Small price fluctuations are normal in this market. 這個市場的小幅價格波動很正常。

meaning: 波動或起伏的狀態
sentences: Fluctuosity in the signal caused brief distortions. 訊號的波動造成短暫失真。
Fluctuosity of the wind made the kite hard to control. 風的起伏讓風箏難以控制。

meaning: 波動的；起伏不定的
sentences: Fluctuous waves delayed the ferry. 起伏不定的波浪讓渡輪延誤。
Fluctuous demand changed the store’s ordering plan. 波動的需求改變了商店的訂貨計畫。

meaning: 煙道；排煙管
sentences: Flue carried smoke safely out of the stove. 煙道把煙安全排出爐子。
Flue needed cleaning before the winter season. 冬季前需要清理排煙管。

meaning: 有煙道的；設有排煙管的
sentences: Flued stoves warmed the rooms without filling them with smoke. 有煙道的爐子溫暖房間而不讓煙霧充滿室內。
Flued furnaces require regular inspection. 設有排煙管的熔爐需要定期檢查。

meaning: 沒有煙道的；將燃燒副產物排入周圍空氣的
sentences: Flueless heaters need good ventilation. 無煙道暖爐需要良好通風。
Flueless appliances release combustion gases indoors. 沒有煙道的設備會把燃燒氣體排到室內。

meaning: 藥用婆婆納的一種；兩種婆婆納之一
sentences: Fluellen grew beside the damp stone wall. 婆婆納的一種生長在潮濕石牆旁。
Fluellen has small blue flowers in spring. 這種婆婆納在春天開出小藍花。

meaning: 氟鋁石；含水氟化鋁礦物
sentences: Fluellite appeared as colorless crystals in the rock. 氟鋁石以無色晶體形式出現在岩石中。
Fluellite is a hydrated aluminum fluoride mineral. 氟鋁石是一種含水氟化鋁礦物。

meaning: 清理鍋爐煙道的工人
sentences: Flueman cleaned the boiler flue before the inspection. 鍋爐煙道清潔工在檢查前清理了煙道。
Flueman removed soot from the narrow passage. 煙道清潔工清除了狹窄通道中的煤煙。

meaning: 流利、流暢
sentences: She achieved high fluency in English after living in London for several years. 在倫敦住了幾年後，她的英語達到了很高的流利度。
The program aims to improve students' fluency and confidence in speaking. 該計畫旨在提高學生說話的流利度（流暢度）和信心。

meaning: 流暢
sentences: She speaks English so well that people think she is a fluent speaker. 她英語說得非常好，人們以為她是流利（流暢）的母語者。
The course aims to help students become fluent in a foreign language. 該課程旨在幫助學生成為外語流利者。

meaning: 流利地；順暢地
sentences: She explained the issue fluently in English. 她用流利的英語說明了問題。
Fluently written paragraphs are easy to follow. 寫得流暢的段落很容易理解。

meaning: 流利或順暢的程度
sentences: Fluentness improved after months of conversation practice. 數月的會話練習後，流利度提高了。
Fluentness helped him speak without long pauses. 流利程度讓他說話時不再長時間停頓。

meaning: 花；花卉圖案
sentences: Fluer appeared as a small motif on the silver cup. 花卉圖案以小巧形式出現在銀杯上。
Fluer was stitched along the edge of the cloth. 花朵圖案沿著布料邊緣縫製。

meaning: 管風琴的煙道音栓
sentences: Fluework produced a clear tone in the pipe organ. 管風琴煙道音栓在風琴中產生清晰音色。
Fluework filled the chapel with gentle music. 煙道音栓讓小教堂充滿柔和樂聲。

meaning: 像煙道的；充滿煙垢的
sentences: Fluey air filled the room after the chimney backdrafted. 煙囪回流後，房間充滿煙垢味的空氣。
Fluey walls needed cleaning before repainting. 像煙道般沾滿煙垢的牆面重新上漆前需要清潔。

meaning: 任何無關緊要或膚淺的事情。
sentences: That article was basically a bunch of fluff. It didn't say anything substantive. 那篇文章基本上是一堆廢話。並沒有說什麼實質的事情。
The term fluff refers to anything inconsequential or superficial. 「絨毛」一詞指的是任何無關緊要或膚淺的事情。

meaning: 使物品蓬鬆的人或工具
sentences: Fluffer restored the pillow’s shape before bedtime. 蓬鬆整理工具在睡前恢復了枕頭形狀。
Fluffer lifted the filling inside the winter coat. 蓬鬆整理工具讓冬衣內的填充物蓬起來。

meaning: 以蓬鬆的方式
sentences: Writers use fluffily to mean in a fluffy manner. 作家們用 fluffly 來表示以一種蓬鬆的方式。
She acted fluffily when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她就會表現得輕率。

meaning: 蓬鬆柔軟的狀態
sentences: Fluffiness made the fresh towels feel luxurious. 蓬鬆感讓新毛巾摸起來很舒適。
Fluffiness decreased after the blanket was compressed. 毯子受壓後，蓬鬆度降低了。

meaning: 光；柔軟的;通風的。
sentences: I like my scrambled eggs to be light and fluffy in texture. 我喜歡我的炒蛋質地輕盈蓬鬆。
Something described as fluffy is light; soft; airy. 形容蓬鬆的東西是輕的；柔軟的;通風。

meaning: 富格爾曼的變體；帶頭示範的人
sentences: Flugelman led the march by setting its pace. 帶頭示範的人以自己的步調引領隊伍。
Flugelman demonstrated the movement before the group followed. 富格爾曼先示範動作，再由隊伍跟上。

meaning: 可流動的；液態的
sentences: Fluible material spread through the narrow channel. 可流動的材料穿過狹窄通道。
Fluible wax filled the mold before cooling. 液態蠟冷卻前填滿了模具。

meaning: 液體、不定的
sentences: The doctor advised the patient to drink plenty of fluids to stay hydrated. 醫生建議病人多喝液體（流體）以保持水分。
The political situation in the region remains fluid and unpredictable. 該地區的政治局勢仍然不穩定（不定的）且難以預測。

meaning: 以乙酸液體萃取的藥物浸出物
sentences: Fluidacetextract dissolved quickly in the measured solvent. 乙酸液體萃取物很快溶解在量取的溶劑中。
Fluidacetextract was prepared from dried plant material. 乙酸液體萃取物由乾燥植物材料製成。

meaning: 流體的；與流動運動有關的
sentences: Fluidal bands showed how the molten rock moved. 流體狀帶紋顯示熔融岩石的流動方式。
Fluidal motion shaped the layers inside the tube. 流動運動塑造了管內的層次。

meaning: 具有易於移動和改變其相對位置而無需分離質量並且易於屈服於壓力的顆粒：能夠流動。如何用流體造句
sentences: Writers use fluidally to mean having particles that easily move and change their relative position without a separation of the mass and that easily yield to pressure: capable of flowing. How to use fluid in a sentence. 作者使用“流體”一詞來表示顆粒可以輕鬆移動並改變其相對位置，而無需分離質量，並且易於屈服於壓力：能夠流動。如何在句子中使用流體。
She acted fluidally when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她表現得十分流暢。

meaning: 每毫升含一克乾藥成分的植物醇製萃取物
sentences: Fluidextract was measured carefully before dilution. 植物醇製萃取物在稀釋前被仔細量取。
Fluidextract contains concentrated active plant compounds. 植物醇製萃取物含有濃縮的植物活性成分。

meaning: 以甘油和水萃取植物藥物製成的濃縮液劑
sentences: Fluidglycerate preserved the plant extract in a concentrated form. 甘油萃取液以濃縮形式保存植物藥物。
Fluidglycerate was mixed with water before administration. 甘油萃取液在使用前與水混合。

meaning: 能在壓力下流動的
sentences: Fluidible paste moved through the narrow tube under pressure. 能在壓力下流動的糊狀物穿過狹窄管子。
Fluidible material filled every corner of the mold. 這種可受壓流動的材料填滿模具每個角落。

meaning: 流體控制的；以流體壓力或流量運作的
sentences: A fluidic circuit directs air through narrow channels. 流體控制電路會讓空氣通過狹窄通道。
This fluidic valve opens when the pressure rises. 這個流體閥會在壓力升高時開啟。

meaning: 使物質流動化的過程
sentences: A fluidification step helps the powder flow evenly. 流動化步驟有助於粉末均勻流動。
The fluidification of the mixture took several minutes. 混合物的流動化花了幾分鐘。

meaning: 使物質變得更流動的物質或裝置
sentences: A fluidifier made the thick paste easier to pour. 流化劑讓濃稠的糊狀物更容易倒出。
This fluidifier keeps the mixture from clumping. 這種流化劑能防止混合物結塊。

meaning: 使流體或流動。如何使用流化造句
sentences: Older manuals use fluidify to mean to make fluid or flowing. How to use fluidify in a sentence. 較舊的手冊使用“使流體或流動。如何使用流化造句”來表示“使流體流動”。如何在句子中使用 使流體或流動。如何使用流化造句。
In practice, people fluidify when that action is required. 在實踐中，當需要採取行動時，人們會流動。

meaning: 測量液體流動或相關性質的儀器
sentences: A fluidimeter measured the oil's flow rate. 流體計測量了油的流速。
This fluidimeter gave a stable reading in cold water. 這台流體計在冷水中也能給出穩定讀值。

meaning: 以流體運動解釋自然或生理現象的學說
sentences: A fluidism theory linked health to the movement of bodily fluids. 流體主義理論把健康與體液流動聯繫起來。
This book compares fluidism with mechanical explanations. 這本書比較流體主義與機械論的解釋。

meaning: 主張流體主義的人
sentences: A fluidist explained the illness through changing bodily fluids. 流體主義者透過體液變化解釋這種疾病。
This fluidist rejected a purely mechanical account. 這位流體主義者不接受純粹機械論的說法。

meaning: 流動、變化或連貫自如的性質
sentences: A fluidity in her speech made the story easy to follow. 她說話流暢，讓故事很容易理解。
This fluidity lets the dancer change direction smoothly. 這種流動感讓舞者能順暢轉向。

meaning: 把固體顆粒轉成像流體般流動的過程
sentences: A fluidization process kept the grains moving in the tank. 流化過程讓顆粒持續在槽中移動。
This fluidization improved contact between gas and powder. 這種流化改善了氣體與粉末的接觸。

meaning: 使像流體一樣流動
sentences: Older manuals use fluidize to mean to cause to flow like a fluid. 較舊的手冊使用“流化”來表示像流體一樣流動。
In practice, people fluidize when that action is required. 實際上，當需要採取行動時，人們就會流動。

meaning: 以流暢的方式：具有流動性
sentences: Writers use fluidly to mean in a fluid manner: with fluidity. 作家使用流暢來表示以流暢的方式：具有流暢性。
She acted fluidly when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她表現得十分流暢。

meaning: 流動或變化自如的性質；流動性
sentences: A fluidness in the design makes the layout feel open. 設計的流動感讓版面顯得開闊。
This fluidness helps the material spread across the surface. 這種流動性有助於材料鋪展在表面。

meaning: 液量單位，等於八分之一液量盎司
sentences: A fluidram of syrup was added to the mixture. 混合物中加入了八分之一液量盎司的糖漿。
This recipe calls for one fluidram of the extract. 這份食譜需要八分之一液量盎司的萃取液。

meaning: 一立方公分的液體重量單位
sentences: A fluigram of water was used in the small test. 小型測試使用了一個液體立方公分重量單位的水。
This portion weighed nearly one fluigram. 這份液體的重量接近一個液體立方公分重量單位。

meaning: 漂浮的；在水面上流動的
sentences: A fluitant leaf drifted across the pond. 一片漂浮的葉子飄過池塘。
This fluitant plant stayed on the water's surface. 這株漂浮植物一直留在水面上。

meaning: 意外的好運；偶然的成功
sentences: A fluke put the lost key under my shoe. 一次意外的巧合讓遺失的鑰匙出現在我鞋下。
This victory was a fluke, not a planned outcome. 這場勝利是僥倖，不是預先策劃的結果。

meaning: 帶有吸蟲的；感染吸蟲的
sentences: A fluked fish was removed from the tank. 一條感染吸蟲的魚被移出水槽。
This fluked animal needed treatment before release. 這隻感染吸蟲的動物在放回野外前需要治療。

meaning: 沒有吸蟲或吸蟲狀構造的
sentences: A flukeless fish has no broad tail lobes. 沒有尾葉的魚沒有寬大的尾部葉片。

sentences: A fluty voice rose above the quiet crowd. 一個長笛般清亮的聲音高過安靜的人群。
This fluty whistle came from the old kettle. 這聲長笛般的哨音來自老水壺。

meaning: 河流的；由河流形成或與河流有關的
sentences: A fluvial terrace bordered the wide valley. 一座河流階地沿著寬闊山谷延伸。
This fluvial deposit contains rounded pebbles. 這層河流沉積物含有圓形卵石。

meaning: 主張河流作用是地質形成重要因素的人
sentences: A fluvialist explained the valley through river erosion. 河流作用論者用河流侵蝕解釋這座山谷。
This fluvialist compared several ancient channels. 這位河流地質學者比較了幾條古老水道。

meaning: 河流的；與河川環境有關的
sentences: A fluviatic deposit lay beneath the floodplain. 一層河流沉積物位於氾濫平原下方。
This fluviatic habitat supports small freshwater fish. 這種河川棲地孕育小型淡水魚。

meaning: 河流的；生活在河流中的
sentences: A fluviatile plant grew along the quiet bank. 一株河生植物沿著平靜河岸生長。
This fluviatile sediment came from an upstream flood. 這層河流沉積物來自上游洪水。

meaning: 棲居或常出沒於河流、溪流的；用於動物
sentences: The fluvicoline bird nested beside a stream. 這種河棲鳥在溪流旁築巢。
Scientists call the otter fluvicoline because it favors rivers. 科學家稱水獺為河棲動物，因為牠偏好河流。

meaning: 冰川融水與河流共同形成的；冰水沉積的
sentences: A fluvioglacial plain spread beyond the melting glacier. 一片冰水沉積平原延伸到融化中的冰川外。
This fluvioglacial gravel is sorted by running water. 這種冰水礫石經流動的水分選。

meaning: 自動測量並記錄河流水位的儀器
sentences: A fluviograph recorded the river's rise after the storm. 水位記錄儀記下暴風雨後河水上升的情況。
This fluviograph sends readings to the monitoring station. 這台水位記錄儀把讀值傳送到監測站。

meaning: 河湖相的；由河流和湖泊沉積共同形成的
sentences: A fluviolacustrine layer formed where the river entered the lake. 河流注入湖泊處形成了河湖相沉積層。
This fluviolacustrine deposit contains both sand and fine mud. 這層河湖相沉積物同時含有砂與細泥。

meaning: 研究河流、水道及其作用的學科
sentences: A fluviology course examined how rivers shape valleys. 河流學課程研究河流如何塑造山谷。
This fluviology study measured changes in the channel. 這項河流學研究測量了水道的變化。

meaning: 由河流和海洋共同作用形成的；河海相的
sentences: A fluviomarine delta formed at the river mouth. 河海相三角洲在河口形成。
This fluviomarine sediment contains saltwater minerals. 這層河海相沉積物含有鹹水礦物。

meaning: 測量河流或水道流速的儀器
sentences: A fluviometer measured the current beneath the bridge. 流速計測量橋下的水流。
This fluviometer works even in shallow water. 這台流速計在淺水中也能運作。

meaning: 河流的；由流水形成的
sentences: A fluviose gravel bed marked the former river course. 一層河流礫石標示出昔日的河道。
This fluviose soil drains quickly after rain. 這種河成土壤在雨後排水很快。

meaning: 與陸地及其河流環境有關的
sentences: A fluvioterrestrial zone connects the floodplain with dry land. 一個河陸交界區連接氾濫平原與乾燥陸地。
This fluvioterrestrial habitat changes with seasonal floods. 這種河陸棲地會隨季節洪水改變。

meaning: 由火山和河流共同作用形成的；與兩者有關的
sentences: A fluviovolcanic mudflow crossed the valley after the eruption. 火山噴發後，一股火山河流泥流穿過山谷。
This fluviovolcanic deposit contains ash and rounded stones. 這層火山河流沉積物含有火山灰與圓石。

meaning: 持續變化的狀態。
sentences: The schedule is in flux at the moment. 目前時間表正在變化。
Languages, like our bodies, are in a continual flux. 語言，就像我們的身體一樣，處於不斷變化之中。

meaning: 流動、變化或波動的過程
sentences: A fluxation in temperature changed the material's shape. 溫度波動改變了材料的形狀。
This fluxation makes the signal difficult to read. 這種波動讓訊號難以讀取。

meaning: 在焊接處塗助焊劑的人
sentences: A fluxer coated the metal seam before soldering. 一名助焊工人在焊接前替金屬接縫塗上助焊劑。
This fluxer removed excess paste with a cloth. 這名助焊工用布擦掉多餘膏劑。

meaning: 流動或變化的能力；可變性
sentences: A fluxibility in the design lets the parts move freely. 設計的可變性讓零件自由移動。
This fluxibility helps the material spread under pressure. 這種流動性有助於材料在壓力下鋪展。

meaning: 能流動或能被助熔劑熔化的
sentences: A fluxible mineral melted when the additive was heated. 一種可被助熔劑熔化的礦物在加入物加熱後熔化。
This fluxible material spreads across the hot surface. 這種可流動材料會鋪展在高溫表面。

meaning: 能流動或變化的性質
sentences: A fluxibleness in the resin allows easy molding. 樹脂的可流動性使塑形更容易。
This fluxibleness decreases as the mixture cools. 這種流動性會隨混合物冷卻而降低。

meaning: 以流動或變化的方式
sentences: The soft metal fluxibly filled the narrow groove. 柔軟金屬以流動的方式填滿狹窄凹槽。
This coating spreads fluxibly over the uneven surface. 這層塗料能流動地覆蓋不平表面。

meaning: 能流動的；易於變化的
sentences: A fluxile substance flowed through the warm pipe. 一種易流動的物質流過溫暖的管子。
This fluxile coating changes with the temperature. 這種易變塗層會隨溫度改變。

meaning: 流動或變動的性質
sentences: A fluxility in the wax made it easy to shape. 蠟的流動性讓它容易塑形。
This fluxility disappears after the wax hardens. 蠟變硬後，這種流動性便消失。

meaning: 流動或變化；受到流動作用的物質
sentences: A fluxion of heat moved through the metal rod. 熱流穿過金屬棒。
This fluxion changed the shape of the soft layer. 這種流動改變了柔軟層的形狀。

meaning: 與流動或變化有關的；不斷變化的
sentences: A fluxional boundary shifted as the liquid cooled. 流變邊界隨液體冷卻而移動。
This fluxional state cannot remain fixed for long. 這種流變狀態無法長久固定。

meaning: 與流變有關或流變
sentences: Writers use fluxionally to mean relating to or being a fluxion. 作家使用 與流變有關或流變 來表示與流變相關或成為流變。
She acted fluxionally when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她的行為就會變化無常。

meaning: 流變的；流變一詞的古舊變體
sentences: A fluxionary term appeared in the old mathematics text. 一個流變術語出現在古老數學文獻中。
This fluxionary spelling is seldom used today. 這種流變拼法如今很少使用。

meaning: 研究或使用流數法的人，尤其是數學家
sentences: A fluxionist solved the curve using an early calculus method. 一名流數學家用早期微積分方法解出曲線。
This fluxionist wrote about changing quantities. 這位流數學家撰寫了變量的文章。

meaning: 測量磁通量或磁通密度的儀器
sentences: A fluxmeter measured the magnetic field near the coil. 磁通計測量線圈附近的磁場。
This fluxmeter displayed the change as the magnet moved. 這台磁通計顯示磁鐵移動時的變化。

meaning: 止瀉根；傳統上用於緩解腹瀉的植物根部
sentences: A fluxroot was dried before being prepared as tea. 止瀉根在泡茶前先被曬乾。
This fluxroot was kept in a small cloth pouch. 這些止瀉根被放在小布袋裡。

meaning: 通量草；一種果梗向外展開的植物
sentences: A fluxweed grew among the dry meadow grasses. 一株通量草長在乾燥草地的草叢中。
This fluxweed has fruit stalks that spread outward. 這種通量草的果梗會向外展開。

meaning: 飛
sentences: Birds can fly high into the sky with their wings. 鳥類可以用翅膀在高空中飛翔。
It takes about thirteen hours to fly from Taipei to London. 從台北飛往倫敦大約需要 13 小時。

meaning: 適合飛行的；可以飛行的
sentences: A flyable aircraft waited beside the runway. 一架適合飛行的飛機停在跑道旁。
This flyable model handles strong crosswinds well. 這架可飛行模型很能應付強側風。

meaning: 飄散的髮絲；鬆散而向外飛揚的
sentences: A flyaway escaped from her braid in the wind. 一縷飄散的髮絲在風中脫離她的辮子。
This flyaway strand would not stay under the hat. 這根鬆散髮絲怎麼也留不在帽子裡。

meaning: 飛回的傾向或能力；也指回飛動作
sentences: During migration, flyback lets birds return to a safe island. 遷徙時，飛返能讓鳥兒回到安全的島嶼。
After the failed launch, flyback brought the small aircraft home. 發射失敗後，回飛讓小型飛機返回原地。

meaning: 由球棒擊向空中的球
sentences: During practice, flyball rose high above the outfield. 練習時，飛球高高飛過外野。
A quick catch stopped the flyball before it reached the fence. 快速接殺在飛球碰到圍網前攔住了它。

meaning: 被認為能殺死蒼蠅的植物
sentences: In the cottage garden, flybane grew beside the herbs. 小屋花園裡，滅蠅草長在香草旁邊。
Old remedies sometimes called a flybane useful against houseflies. 古老療法有時認為滅蠅草能對付家蠅。

meaning: 采采蠅出沒的地帶
sentences: Along the river, the flybelt made travel uncomfortable. 河流沿岸的采采蠅帶讓旅途很不舒服。
Maps marked the flybelt so visitors could prepare carefully. 地圖標出了采采蠅帶，讓訪客能做好準備。

meaning: 蒼蠅產卵或幼蟲造成的污染
sentences: Without a cover, flyblow spoiled the meat overnight. 沒有遮蓋時，蠅蛆污染一夜之間就弄壞了肉。
The butcher discarded the cut after finding flyblow on it. 肉販發現肉上有蠅蛆後便把那塊肉丟掉。

meaning: 被蠅蛆污染的；腐敗的
sentences: By noon, flyblown fruit had to be removed from the basket. 到中午，遭蠅蛆污染的水果必須從籃子裡拿走。
The uncovered meat became flyblown in the summer heat. 未覆蓋的肉在夏日高溫中變得腐敗。

meaning: 荷蘭式大型平底沿岸船
sentences: On the canal, a flyboat carried grain toward the harbor. 運河上，一艘荷蘭平底船載著穀物前往港口。
Merchants once trusted the broad flyboat for coastal cargo. 商人過去常靠寬大的荷蘭沿岸船運送貨物。

meaning: 空軍成員，尤其是飛行員
sentences: At the air show, a young flyboy greeted the mechanics. 航空展上，一名年輕飛行員向維修人員打招呼。
Newsreels once celebrated every daring flyboy in uniform. 過去的新聞影片曾讚頌每位穿制服的勇敢飛行員。

meaning: 捕食飛行昆蟲的雀形目鳥類，尤指鶲或霸鶲
sentences: A flycatcher seized a moth in midair. 一隻捕蠅鳥在半空中抓住了一隻蛾。
The flycatcher returned to the same branch. 那隻捕蠅鳥回到同一根樹枝上。

meaning: 捕食蒼蠅的動物或植物
sentences: Near the pond, a flyeater snapped up insects in seconds. 池塘旁，一種捕蠅生物幾秒內就吞下了昆蟲。
The gardener planted a flyeater to reduce the flies indoors. 園丁種了捕蠅植物來減少屋內的蒼蠅。

meaning: 一隻雌袋鼠；袋鼠；一隻母鹿；吉爾。
sentences: The term flyer refers to a female kangaroo; a roo; a doe; a jill. 飛行者一詞指的是雌性袋鼠；袋鼠；一隻母鹿；吉爾。
The lesson introduced flyer as a useful term to understand. 本課程介紹了傳單這個易於理解的有用術語。

meaning: 驅趕或拍死蒼蠅的器具
sentences: Beside the kitchen door, a flyflap hung from a hook. 廚房門旁，一把拍蠅器掛在掛鉤上。
With one swing, the cook used the flyflap to chase away a fly. 廚師揮了一下拍蠅器，把一隻蒼蠅趕走了。

meaning: 拍打或驅趕蒼蠅的器具
sentences: Across the porch, the flyflapper rested beside the screen door. 門廊另一端，拍蠅器放在紗門旁。
Grandfather waved a flyflapper while dinner cooled. 晚餐放涼時，祖父揮著拍蠅器。

meaning: 荷蘭式寬鬆馬褲
sentences: At the costume party, his bright flyflower drew curious looks. 化裝舞會上，他鮮豔的荷蘭馬褲引來好奇目光。
Period portraits show a flyflower worn with a short coat. 古代肖像顯示，荷蘭馬褲會搭配短外套穿著。

meaning: 飛行；在空中移動
sentences: Above the harbor, flying seabirds followed the fishing boat. 港口上空，飛行的海鳥跟著漁船。
During flying lessons, she learned to read the changing wind. 飛行課中，她學會判讀變化的風向。

meaning: 出色的
sentences: Writers use flyingly to mean with flying colors. 作家們用 出色的 來表示出色的表現。
She acted flyingly when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她表現得快速。

meaning: 書籍封面內側的空白頁
sentences: Inside the cover, the flyleaf carried a faded signature. 封面內側的空白頁上留著褪色的簽名。
On the flyleaf, the owner wrote the date of purchase. 書籍的空白扉頁上，主人寫下購買日期。

meaning: 沒有蒼蠅侵擾的
sentences: After the screen was repaired, the kitchen stayed flyless. 紗窗修好後，廚房保持沒有蒼蠅。
A clean drain helped keep the picnic area flyless. 乾淨的排水孔有助於讓野餐區沒有蒼蠅。

meaning: 劇場中操縱吊掛布景的人員
sentences: Behind the curtain, the flyman lowered a painted backdrop. 幕後，吊景工人放下一面彩繪背景。
During the scene change, the flyman raised the scenery silently. 換景時，吊景工人悄悄升起布景。

meaning: 機敏、清醒或狡黠的特質
sentences: In the negotiation, her flyness helped her notice the hidden condition. 談判中，她的機敏讓她注意到隱藏條件。
His streetwise flyness kept the wallet safe in the crowded market. 他機警的處世方式讓錢包在擁擠市場裡安然無恙。

meaning: 塗有黏性物質、用來捕殺蒼蠅的紙
sentences: Above the pantry, flypaper caught several insects overnight. 食品室上方的黏蠅紙一夜間黏住了幾隻昆蟲。
We replaced the full flypaper before opening the kitchen. 開廚房前，我們換掉了已經黏滿蒼蠅的黏蠅紙。

meaning: 通過或好像通過剝離來剝離
sentences: Older manuals use flype to mean to strip off by or as if by peeling. 較舊的手冊使用 通過或好像通過剝離來剝離 來表示「透過剝離」或「好像透過剝離」。
In practice, people flype when that action is required. 實際上，人們會在需要採取行動時飛行。

meaning: 能防止蒼蠅進入的
sentences: Behind the new screen, the porch became flyproof. 新紗門後的門廊變得能防止蒼蠅進入。
A tightly fitted cover made the food container flyproof. 密合的蓋子讓食物盒能防蒼蠅。

meaning: 蒼蠅排泄物留下的小斑點
sentences: On the white wall, one flyspeck revealed the open window. 白牆上有一個蠅斑，顯示窗戶曾經開著。
The restorer cleaned each flyspeck from the painted frame. 修復師清掉畫框上的每個蠅斑。

meaning: 形似蒼蠅尾部的部分或構造
sentences: On the insect drawing, the flytail narrowed to a fine point. 昆蟲圖上，蠅尾部位逐漸變成細尖。
A jeweler shaped the pendant with a curved flytail. 珠寶匠把吊墜做成帶有彎曲蠅尾的樣子。

meaning: 製作飛蠅釣餌的人
sentences: The flytier tied bright feathers onto the hook. 飛蠅釣餌製作者把鮮豔羽毛綁到魚鉤上。
An experienced flytier matched the lure to the river. 有經驗的飛蠅釣餌製作者讓魚餌配合河流。

meaning: 捕捉蒼蠅的陷阱
sentences: Near the fruit bowl, a flytrap lured insects into a narrow chamber. 水果盤旁，捕蠅器把昆蟲引進狹窄腔室。
The caretaker emptied the flytrap before more flies gathered. 管理員在更多蒼蠅聚集前清空了捕蠅器。

meaning: 候鳥固定使用的遷徙路線
sentences: Thousands of geese followed the coastal flyway. 數千隻雁沿著海岸遷徙路線飛行。
A wetland protects birds along this flyway. 一片濕地保護著這條遷徙路線上的鳥類。

meaning: 最輕量級拳擊手；最輕量級
sentences: At the tournament, the flyweight won with quick footwork. 比賽中，這名最輕量級拳擊手靠敏捷步法獲勝。
The coach moved the young boxer into the flyweight division. 教練把年輕拳手安排到最輕量級。

meaning: 儲存旋轉能量、使機械運轉平穩的輪盤
sentences: Inside the engine, the flywheel smoothed each power pulse. 引擎內，飛輪讓每次動力脈衝變得平順。
A heavy flywheel kept the old lathe turning evenly. 沉重的飛輪讓老車床均勻運轉。

meaning: 用於升降吊掛物的絞車
sentences: Above the stage, a flywinch lifted the scenery safely. 舞台上方，吊景絞車安全地升起布景。
The crew inspected the flywinch before raising the banner. 工作人員升起旗幟前檢查了吊景絞車。

meaning: 俗稱滅蠅草的植物
sentences: In the herbarium, flywort was listed among traditional insect-repelling plants. 標本室把滅蠅草列在傳統驅蟲植物中。
A country healer dried flywort for use near food stores. 鄉村療者曬乾滅蠅草，放在食物儲藏處附近使用。

meaning: 馬的幼駒
sentences: At sunrise, the foal stood beside its mother. 日出時，小馬駒站在母馬身旁。
The farmer watched the foal take its first steps. 農夫看著小馬駒踏出第一步。

meaning: 款冬，一種早春開花植物
sentences: Along the stream, foalfoot opened its yellow flowers early. 溪邊的款冬很早就開出黃色花朵。
After the thaw, foalfoot appeared among the damp stones. 解凍後，款冬出現在潮濕石縫間。

meaning: 小馬駒時期
sentences: During foalhood, the mare stayed close to her offspring. 小馬駒時期，母馬一直待在幼駒身邊。
Memories of foalhood shaped the horse trainer’s gentle methods. 幼駒時期的記憶影響了馬術訓練師溫和的方式。

meaning: 小馬駒的複數
sentences: Across the meadow, foals chased one another in the sun. 草地另一端，小馬駒們在陽光下互相追逐。
By evening, the foals returned to the quiet stable. 傍晚時，小馬駒們回到了安靜的馬廄。

meaning: 像小馬駒的；幼駒般的
sentences: Her foaly gait made the newborn look especially lively. 新生馬駒幼駒般的步態讓牠看起來格外有活力。
The foaly colt followed its mother through the shallow stream. 幼駒般的小馬跟著母馬穿過淺溪。

meaning: 泡棉
sentences: The new couch is made of high-quality and soft memory foam now. 這張新沙發現在是由高品質且柔軟的記憶泡棉製成的。
The waves were gently breaking on the beach, creating white foam. 海浪輕輕拍打在沙灘上，激起白色的泡沫（泡棉）。

meaning: 霧虹，一種由霧滴形成的白色虹弧
sentences: After the drizzle, a foambow arched above the valley. 小雨過後，一道霧虹橫跨山谷上方。
The hikers photographed the pale foambow before it faded. 健行者在淡淡的霧虹消失前拍下了它。

meaning: 會產生泡沫的物質或裝置
sentences: At the café, the foamer turned warm milk into a soft cap. 咖啡館裡，起泡器把熱牛奶變成柔軟泡沫。
The cleaner added a foamer to spread the soap evenly. 清潔人員加入起泡劑，讓肥皂均勻散開。

meaning: 泡沫花，一種北美多年生草本植物
sentences: In the woodland, foamflower sent white blooms above its leaves. 林地裡，泡沫花在葉片上方開出白花。
A shaded bed suited the delicate foamflower very well. 陰涼的花圃很適合嬌嫩的泡沫花。

meaning: 以泡沫狀的方式
sentences: Writers use foamily to mean in a foamy manner. 作家們用「以泡沫狀的方式」來表示「泡沫狀」的意思。
She acted foamily when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她就會表現得軟弱無力。

meaning: 泡沫的多寡或狀態
sentences: After shaking, the foaminess of the drink increased noticeably. 搖晃後，飲料的起泡程度明顯增加。
The brewer measured foaminess while adjusting the pouring speed. 釀造者調整倒入速度時測量泡沫量。

meaning: 起泡的；產生大量泡沫的
sentences: Beside the waterfall, foaming water rushed over the rocks. 瀑布旁，起泡的水流衝過岩石。
The foaming cleanser lifted oil from the pan. 起泡清潔劑把油污從鍋子上帶走。

meaning: 以起泡的方式
sentences: At the rim, the mixture foamingly spilled over the cup. 混合物以起泡的方式從杯緣溢出。
The soap foamingly spread across the wet cloth. 肥皂泡沫在濕布上起泡般地散開。

meaning: 沒有泡沫的
sentences: After settling, the broth became completely foamless. 靜置後，湯汁完全沒有泡沫。
A slow pour left the glass foamless and clear. 緩慢倒入讓玻璃杯保持清澈無泡。

meaning: 像泡沫的
sentences: Under the microscope, foamlike bubbles formed a loose network. 顯微鏡下，泡沫般的氣泡形成鬆散網絡。
The artist painted a foamlike texture along the wave. 藝術家沿著浪花畫出泡沫般的質感。

meaning: 多泡沫的；起泡的
sentences: On the beach, foamy waves covered the dark sand. 海灘上，泡沫浪花覆蓋了深色沙灘。
She poured foamy milk over the espresso. 她把起泡牛奶倒在濃縮咖啡上。

meaning: 懷錶的短鍊；飾物
sentences: From his waistcoat, a silver fob hung beside the watch. 一枚銀色懷錶飾物從他的背心旁垂下。
The antique fob carried a tiny engraved crest. 古董懷錶鍊飾上刻著小小的徽章。

meaning: 某事物的中心或最重要的元素；焦點元素。
sentences: The term focal refers to the central or most important element of something; a focal element. 術語「焦點」是指某事物的中心或最重要的元素；一個焦點元素。
The lesson introduced focal as a useful term to understand. 本課介紹了「焦點」這個術語，它是一個需要理解的有用術語。

meaning: 使視線或敘事集中於焦點的行為
sentences: In the novel, focalization shifts from the child to her mother. 小說中的敘事焦點從孩子轉到她母親身上。
Through focalization, the scene stays close to one character’s thoughts. 藉由焦點化，場景始終貼近一名角色的想法。

meaning: 引起焦點。如何使用焦點造句
sentences: Older manuals use focalize to mean to bring to a focus. How to use focalize in a sentence. 較舊的手冊使用 focusize 來表示聚焦。如何在句子中使用 focusize。
In practice, people focalize when that action is required. 在實踐中，人們會在需要採取行動時集中註意力。

meaning: 屬於、關於、存在或具有焦點。如何使用焦点造句
sentences: Writers use focally to mean of, relating to, being, or having a focus. How to use focal in a sentence. 作家使用「焦點」來表示、涉及、存在或具有焦點。如何在句子中使用焦點。
She acted focally when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她會集中精力採取行動。

meaning: 焦點狀的；近似焦點的形態
sentences: In the diagram, a focaloid marks the region around the central point. 圖表中，焦點狀區域標示出中心點周圍的範圍。
The optical pattern looked focaloid under magnification. 放大後，這種光學圖樣看起來近似焦點形狀。

meaning: 焦點或中心的複數
sentences: Along the ellipse, the two foci determine its shape. 在橢圓上，兩個焦點決定了它的形狀。
The survey identified several foci of activity around the plaza. 調查找出廣場周圍幾個活動中心。

meaning: 測量光學系統焦距的儀器
sentences: At the optics bench, a focimeter measured the eyepiece accurately. 在光學工作台上，焦度計精確測量了目鏡。
The optometrist checked the prescription with a focimeter. 驗光師用焦度計檢查處方。

meaning: 測量光學焦度或焦距的方法
sentences: In the clinic, focimetry helped verify each optical prescription. 診所裡，焦度測量法協助核對每份光學處方。
Accurate focimetry is essential when testing optical instruments. 測量光學焦度時，精確的焦度測量很重要。

meaning: 形似海豹的動物或形態群
sentences: In the old taxonomy, focoids were grouped by their seal-like form. 在早期分類中，海豹形類群依照類似海豹的外形歸類。
The museum label placed several fossils among the focoids. 博物館標籤把幾件化石列入海豹形類群。

meaning: 測量光學系統焦距的儀器
sentences: Beside the camera, a focometer showed the optical focal length. 相機旁的焦距計顯示了光學焦距。
The engineer recalibrated the focometer before the optical test. 工程師在光學測試前重新校準焦距計。

meaning: 測量焦距的技術或方法
sentences: During the experiment, focometry revealed a small optical error. 實驗中，焦距測量法揭露了小幅光學誤差。
The laboratory taught focometry as part of instrument testing. 實驗室把焦距測量列為儀器測試的一環。

meaning: 船上的艏樓或船艏住艙
sentences: Below deck, the crew slept in the cramped focsle. 甲板下，船員睡在狹窄的艏樓住艙裡。
Rainwater dripped through the focsle roof during the voyage. 航行中，雨水從艏樓屋頂滴下來。

meaning: 重點
sentences: The main focus of the meeting was to discuss the new project. 會議的主要重點是討論新專案。
I need to focus on my studies and avoid distractions from social media. 我需要專注於學業，避開社交媒體的干擾。

meaning: 可以聚焦的；可以調焦的
sentences: With a steady hand, the image became focusable again. 手穩住後，影像又可以調焦了。
The new display offers a focusable reading area. 新顯示器提供可聚焦的閱讀區域。

meaning: 使注意力集中者；調焦裝置
sentences: On the camera, the focuser moved the image into sharp detail. 相機上的調焦環讓影像變得清晰。
As a focuser, the quiet timer helped her work without distraction. 作為集中注意力的工具，安靜的計時器幫她專心工作。

meaning: 沒有焦點的；無法對焦的
sentences: After the impact, the camera produced a focusless image. 撞擊後，相機拍出的影像沒有焦點。
The unfocused speech felt focusless from beginning to end. 雜亂的發言從頭到尾都沒有重點。

meaning: 食物；供給的糧食
sentences: Before the journey, the sailors stored enough fod for winter. 出發前，水手儲存了足夠過冬的食物。
The hungry dog searched the yard for any leftover fod. 飢餓的狗在院子裡尋找剩下的食物。

meaning: 一種棉絨布
sentences: Inside the costume, fod velveteen gave the collar a soft finish. 服裝內側的棉絨布讓衣領呈現柔軟質感。
The tailor chose fod velveteen for the child’s winter jacket. 裁縫選用棉絨布製作孩子的冬季外套。

meaning: 食物；糧食
sentences: At the camp, fodda was divided equally among the travelers. 營地裡，食物平均分給每位旅人。
The old recipe uses dried fodda for a simple stew. 古老食譜用乾糧食煮成簡單燉菜。

meaning: 動物飼料；可供消耗或利用的材料
sentences: The farmer stored dry fodder for winter. 農夫儲存乾飼料過冬。
The rumor became fodder for online jokes. 那則謠言成了網路笑話的材料。

meaning: 供應或搬運飼料的人
sentences: Before dawn, the fodderer filled the stable troughs. 天亮前，飼料供應者填滿了馬廄的食槽。
The farm hired a fodderer to care for the winter feed. 農場雇人負責準備冬季飼料。

meaning: 餵養牲畜；供牲畜食用的粗飼料
sentences: At sunset, foddering began in the quiet barn. 日落時，安靜的穀倉開始餵養牲畜。
Good foddering keeps the horses healthy through cold months. 良好的飼料供應能讓馬匹健康度過寒冬。

meaning: 沒有飼料的
sentences: After the drought, several farms became fodderless. 乾旱後，幾座農場沒有飼料可用。
A fodderless winter forced the shepherd to move the flock. 缺乏飼料的冬天迫使牧羊人移動羊群。

meaning: 飼料；牲畜食物
sentences: In the mountain dialect, foder means feed for livestock. 在山區方言中，這個詞指牲畜飼料。
The mill ground grain into foder for the cattle. 磨坊把穀物磨成牛飼料。

meaning: 笨拙地混做；粗劣的混合物
sentences: Rather than fodge the parts together, the maker fitted them carefully. 製作者沒有把零件胡亂拼在一起，而是仔細接合。
The rushed repair left a fodge of wire and tape. 倉促的修理只留下電線和膠帶的粗劣混合物。

meaning: 圓胖而結實的；豐滿的
sentences: In the portrait, the fodgel merchant wore a broad smile. 肖像中的圓胖商人露出燦爛笑容。
Her fodgel figure suited the warm woolen coat. 她豐滿的身形很適合那件溫暖的羊毛外套。

meaning: 適合挖掘的；用來挖掘的
sentences: For a fodient beak, the bird used its bill to loosen soil. 這隻鳥用適合挖掘的喙鬆開泥土。
The animal’s fodient claws opened a shallow burrow. 這種動物用挖掘用的爪子挖出淺洞。

meaning: 敵人、仇敵
sentences: The two countries have been fierce foes for several decades over the border. 兩國因邊界問題幾十年來一直是死對頭（仇敵）。
The legendary hero managed to defeat his old foe in the final battle. 傳奇英雄在最後一戰中成功擊敗了他的宿敵。

meaning: 從山坡下吹的溫暖乾燥風
sentences: By afternoon, foehn melted the snow on the southern slope. 下午時，焚風融化了南坡的積雪。
The dry foehn made the valley unusually warm. 乾燥的焚風讓山谷異常溫暖。

meaning: 像焚風的；溫暖乾燥的
sentences: Under the foehnlike wind, the frozen path softened quickly. 在焚風般的風中，結冰小路很快變軟。
A foehnlike breeze carried dry heat down the mountain. 焚風般的微風把乾熱帶下山。

meaning: 像敵人的；敵意的
sentences: His foeish glare ended the friendly conversation. 他充滿敵意的瞪視結束了友善的談話。
The tale gives the dragon a foeish expression. 故事把龍描寫成帶有敵意的表情。

meaning: 沒有敵人的；不受敵人威脅的
sentences: After the treaty, the small kingdom felt foeless. 條約簽訂後，小王國覺得不再有敵人。
A foeless border allowed villagers to travel freely. 沒有敵人威脅的邊境讓村民能自由通行。

meaning: 像敵人的；具有敵意的
sentences: Beside the gate, a foelike statue guarded the entrance. 大門旁，一座像敵人的雕像守著入口。
The fox gave a foelike snarl when cornered. 狐狸被逼到角落時發出敵意的低吼。

meaning: 敵人；對手
sentences: Across the battlefield, the foeman raised his shield. 戰場另一端，敵人舉起盾牌。
The knight respected a brave foeman after the duel. 騎士在決鬥後敬重那名勇敢的對手。

meaning: 與敵手對抗的本領或行為
sentences: During the contest, his foemanship remained disciplined and fair. 比賽中，他與對手交鋒時始終自律公平。
The saga praises the captain’s foemanship in battle. 史詩讚揚船長在戰鬥中的對敵本領。

meaning: 胡蘆巴的一種變體
sentences: In the spice market, foenngreek had a warm maple-like scent. 香料市場裡，這種胡蘆巴變體帶有溫暖的楓糖氣味。
The cook added foenngreek to the lentil stew. 廚師把胡蘆巴變體加入扁豆燉菜。

meaning: 敵對關係；與敵人相交的狀態
sentences: After years of foeship, the two houses finally made peace. 敵對多年後，兩個家族終於和解。
Their former foeship ended with a shared meal. 他們過去的敵對關係以共餐告終。

meaning: 出生後保留幼體特徵的發育現象
sentences: In biology, foetalization describes adult traits that remain juvenile. 在生物學中，胎兒化描述成體保留幼年特徵的現象。
The paper linked foetalization with changes in body development. 那篇論文把胎兒化和身體發育變化連結起來。

meaning: 多霧路段
sentences: The airport was shut down for several hours due to a heavy fog. 由於大霧，機場被迫關閉了幾個小時。
Driving in thick fog can be extremely dangerous; please slow down. 在濃霧中行駛可能非常危險；請減速。

meaning: 霧燈 ，
sentences: He turned on the fog light during the storm. 暴風雨中他打開霧燈。
The mechanic checked the fog light before the trip. 技師在出發前檢查霧燈。

meaning: 因濃霧而無法移動的
sentences: By midnight, the ferry was fogbound near the island. 午夜時，渡輪因濃霧困在島嶼附近。
The fogbound hikers waited until the path became visible. 受濃霧困住的健行者等到路徑看得見才出發。

meaning: 霧中形成的白色或淡色虹弧
sentences: Above the lake, a fogbow appeared in the morning mist. 湖面上方，晨霧中出現一道霧虹。
The pale fogbow vanished when sunlight strengthened. 陽光變強時，淡淡的霧虹消失了。

meaning: 霧虹；霧中的光弧
sentences: At the shoreline, sailors called the pale arc a fogdog. 海岸邊，水手把淡淡的光弧稱為霧虹。
A brief fogdog hung over the cold water. 一道短暫的霧虹懸在冰冷水面上。

meaning: 霧氣籠罩的狀態或地域
sentences: Before noon, fogdom covered the marsh and hid the reeds. 中午前，霧氣籠罩了沼澤，也遮住蘆葦。
The photographer waited for fogdom to lift from the valley. 攝影師等待籠罩山谷的霧氣散去。

meaning: 霧虹；霧中的光弧
sentences: At dawn, a fogeater glowed above the wet meadow. 黎明時，一道霧虹在潮濕草地上方發光。
The guide pointed to the faint fogeater beyond the ridge. 導遊指向山脊外淡淡的霧虹。

meaning: 守舊的人；老古板
sentences: At the modern gallery, the old fogey complained about digital art. 在現代畫廊裡，那個老古板抱怨數位藝術。
Her grandfather was a cheerful fogey who preferred handwritten letters. 她祖父是個愉快的老古板，偏愛手寫信。

meaning: 霧果，一種馬鞭草科植物
sentences: Along the roadside, fogfruit spread its tiny white flowers. 路旁，霧果伸展出細小白花。
The gardener used fogfruit as a low ground cover. 園丁把霧果當作低矮的地被植物。

meaning: 草地的第二次生長
sentences: After the first cutting, cattle grazed on fresh foggage. 第一次割草後，牛群吃著新長的再生草。
Rain helped the field produce thick foggage in autumn. 秋雨幫助田地長出茂密的第二茬草。

meaning: 水蒸氣凝結成懸浮在低層大氣中的細小水顆粒，與雲的差異僅在於靠近地面。如何用霧造句
sentences: The alarm was fogged enough to stop the conversation. 警報聲大得足以阻止談話。
An unusually fogged roar echoed through the hall. 大廳裡迴盪著異常迷霧般的轟鳴聲。

meaning: 噴出霧狀液體的裝置
sentences: In the greenhouse, a fogger raised the humidity around seedlings. 溫室裡，噴霧器提高了幼苗周圍的濕度。
The pest controller used a fogger to spread the treatment evenly. 害蟲防治員用噴霧器均勻施放藥劑。

meaning: 以霧濛濛的方式： 朦朧地
sentences: Writers use foggily to mean in a foggy manner: mistily. 作家們用「以霧濛濛的方式： 朦朧地」來表示「以一種霧濛濛的方式」：「朦朧」。
She acted foggily when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她表現得模糊不清。

meaning: 有霧的狀態；朦朧
sentences: Because of the morning fogginess, the bridge looked distant. 由於早晨霧氣朦朧，橋看起來很遠。
The camera showed fogginess after leaving the cold room. 相機離開冷房後，影像出現霧氣。

meaning: 像霧的；朦朧不清的
sentences: In the dim light, the painting took on a foggish quality. 在昏暗光線下，畫作呈現朦朧質感。
His foggish memory made the old route hard to describe. 他模糊的記憶讓那條舊路很難描述。

meaning: 有霧的
sentences: The mountain scenery was barely visible on that cold foggy day. 在那個寒冷有霧的日子，山景幾乎看不見。
Driving in thick foggy weather can be extremely dangerous. 在濃霧的天氣中行駛可能非常危險。

meaning: 霧號；霧中發出警告聲的汽笛
sentences: Beyond the harbor, a foghorn sounded through the gray air. 港口外，一聲霧號穿過灰濛濛的空氣。
The steady foghorn guided boats around the rocky point. 持續的霧號引導船隻繞過岩石岬角。

meaning: 絲質手帕或圍巾
sentences: He tucked a blue fogle around his neck. 他把一條藍色絲巾塞在頸間。
The dancer tied a silk fogle to her belt. 舞者把絲質手帕綁在腰帶上。

meaning: 沒有霧的；清朗的
sentences: After sunrise, the mountain pass became fogless. 日出後，山口變得沒有霧氣。
A fogless morning revealed the islands across the bay. 無霧的早晨讓海灣對面的島嶼清晰可見。

meaning: 在霧中工作的嚮導或人員
sentences: Before dawn, the fogman guided boats through the narrow channel. 天亮前，霧中嚮導引船隻穿過狹窄水道。
The village hired a fogman whenever visibility became dangerous. 能見度變得危險時，村子就雇用霧中引航員。

meaning: 惡臭；難聞的氣味
sentences: Near the stagnant ditch, fogo drove everyone away. 靠近淤臭水溝時，惡臭把所有人都熏走了。
The old cellar released a sharp fogo after the door opened. 舊地窖開門後散出刺鼻惡臭。

meaning: 角落裡的壁爐，見於美國西南部建築
sentences: Inside the adobe room, a fogon warmed the family at night. 土坯房內，角落壁爐在夜裡替一家人取暖。
The restored fogon still held traces of cooking smoke. 修復後的角落壁爐仍留有烹煮煙痕。

meaning: 地下石室或洞穴
sentences: Beneath the chapel, a fogou opened into a dark passage. 小教堂下方，一座地下石室通向黑暗通道。
Archaeologists entered the fogou through its narrow doorway. 考古學家從狹窄入口進入地下石室。

meaning: 防霧的；不易受霧影響的
sentences: A fogproof coating kept the windshield clear in rain. 防霧塗層讓擋風玻璃在雨中保持清晰。
The hikers chose fogproof goggles for the cold ascent. 健行者選了防霧護目鏡進行寒冷的登山。

meaning: 守舊的人；老古板
sentences: At the lively festival, one fogram objected to every new song. 熱鬧的節慶中，一名老古板反對每首新歌。
The kindly fogram still preferred a candle to an electric lamp. 那名和善的老古板仍偏愛蠟燭而非電燈。

meaning: 化石

meaning: 掘地的；適合挖洞生活的
sentences: Fossorial claws help the mole cross hard soil. 掘地爪幫助鼴鼠穿過堅硬土壤。
The badger has a fossorial body and powerful forelimbs. 獾有適合挖洞的身體和強壯前肢。

meaning: 適合挖掘的；善於掘地的
sentences: Fossorious feet let the animal loosen compact earth. 適合挖掘的腳讓這種動物能鬆開緊實土壤。
Its fossorious snout pushed through the bank. 它善於掘地的吻部穿過了土堤。

meaning: 小凹窩；小凹陷
sentences: Fossulae dotted the surface of the stone. 石頭表面布滿小凹窩。
The surgeon measured one fossula near the joint. 外科醫師量了一處關節旁的小凹陷。

meaning: 有小凹窩的；略帶凹槽的
sentences: Fossulate scales gave the fish a rough texture. 有小凹窩的鱗片讓魚身摸起來粗糙。
The fossulate stone held rainwater in tiny pits. 那塊略帶凹槽的石頭在小坑裡留住雨水。

meaning: 小凹窩；細小凹陷
sentences: Fossules formed where the mineral crystals dissolved. 礦物晶體溶解後形成了小凹窩。
A fossule on the leaf caught a bead of dew. 葉片上的小凹陷接住了一顆露珠。

meaning: 極小的凹窩
sentences: Fossulets were visible on the polished surface. 拋光表面上看得見極小的凹窩。
The fossil’s fossulet held a grain of sand. 化石的極小凹窩裡卡著一粒沙。

meaning: 小凹窩；小凹點
sentences: Fostell marked the center of the tiny scale. 小凹點標示出細小鱗片的中心。
A red stain settled in the fostell. 紅色污痕沉在小凹窩裡。

meaning: 培養、收養
sentences: The school aims to foster a love of learning and creativity among its students. 學校旨在培養學生對學習的熱愛和創造力。
They decided to foster a child who had lost his parents in the conflict. 他們決定收養一名在衝突中失去父母的孩子。

meaning: 適合寄養的；可以培育的
sentences: Fosterable children need a stable and patient home. 適合寄養的孩子需要穩定且有耐心的家庭。
The rescue dog proved fosterable after gentle training. 那隻救援犬經過溫和訓練後適合寄養。

meaning: 寄養；養育與照護
sentences: Fosterage gave the orphan a safe childhood. 寄養讓孤兒擁有安全的童年。
The old law recognized fosterage as a family bond. 古老法律承認寄養是一種家庭連結。

meaning: 養育者；寄養照顧者
sentences: Fosterers helped the injured bird regain strength. 照顧者幫助受傷的鳥恢復體力。
Each fosterer received advice from the shelter. 每位寄養照顧者都得到收容所的建議。

meaning: 寄養身分；成為寄養兒的狀態
sentences: Fosterhood brought new duties to the household. 寄養身分為這個家庭帶來新的責任。
The memoir describes fosterhood with honesty. 那本回憶錄誠實描述寄養生活。

meaning: 寄養的現在分詞和動名詞
sentences: Older manuals use fostering to mean present participle and gerund of foster. 較舊的手冊使用寄養來表示寄養的現在分詞和動名詞。
In practice, people fostering when that action is required. 在實踐中，人們會在需要採取行動時進行培育。

meaning: 以促進或鼓勵的方式。
sentences: Writers use fosteringly to mean In a way that fosters or encourages. 作家們使用「培養」來表示「以某種方式培養或鼓勵」。
She acted fosteringly when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她會採取養育行動。

meaning: 寄養照顧者；養育者
sentences: Fosterites met monthly to share practical advice. 寄養照顧者每月見面分享實用建議。
A fosterite welcomed two siblings into her home. 一位養育者把兩名手足接到家中。

meaning: 供養宗教人士的土地；教會供養地
sentences: Fosterland supported the monastery and its residents. 教會供養地支撐修道院及其居民。
The charter transferred fosterland to the abbey. 特許狀把供養地轉給修道院。

meaning: 寄養兒；受寄養照顧的孩子
sentences: Fosterlings joined the family for the winter. 寄養兒在冬季加入了這個家庭。
The fosterling kept a drawing of her first home. 那名寄養兒留著第一個家的畫。

meaning: 寄養關係；養父母與養子女的關係
sentences: Fostership can continue after a child leaves care. 寄養關係可以在孩子離開照護後延續。
Their fostership grew into lasting friendship. 他們的寄養關係發展成長久友誼。

meaning: 女性寄養者；養母
sentences: Fostresses gathered to discuss bedtime routines. 女性寄養者聚在一起討論睡前作息。
The fostress prepared a quiet room for the child. 那位養母為孩子準備了安靜的房間。

meaning: 腳；英尺（古舊拼法）
sentences: Fot appears in several old spellings of foot. 「腳」在幾種古老拼法中寫成這樣。
The mason measured one fot along the stone. 石匠沿著石頭量了一英尺。

meaning: fetch 的發音拼寫。
sentences: Older manuals use fotch to mean Pronunciation spelling of fetch. 較舊的手冊使用 fetch 的發音拼寫。 來表示 fetch 的發音拼字。
In practice, people fotch when that action is required. 在實踐中，人們會在需要採取行動時進行抓捕。

meaning: 一車的貨物；古代重量或容量單位
sentences: Fother of grain arrived before the market opened. 一車穀物在市場開門前抵達。
The ledger charged one fother for the full load. 帳簿按整車貨物收取一個單位的費用。

meaning: 古英格蘭重量單位，通常約為一百二十磅
sentences: Fotmal once measured a large merchant load. 這種古英格蘭重量單位曾用來衡量大批商貨。
The charter records two fotmal of lead. 特許狀記載了兩個這種鉛的重量單位。

meaning: 南美洲的一種熱帶木材樹
sentences: Fotui grows in warm South American forests. 福圖伊生長在南美洲溫暖的森林裡。
Carpenters valued fotui for its light pale wood. 木匠珍視福圖伊的淡色輕木材。

meaning: 四（蘇格蘭方言）
sentences: Fou birds landed on the low wall. 四隻鳥落在矮牆上。
The old account counts fou silver coins. 舊帳本數著四枚銀幣。

meaning: 奧克尼、設得蘭或法羅群島的司法官
sentences: Foud settled the dispute between the island families. 島嶼司法官裁定了兩個家族之間的爭端。
The villagers brought the matter before the foud. 村民把這件事提交給司法官。

meaning: 突發而猛烈的；如閃電般的
sentences: Foudroyant anger ended the calm negotiation. 突發而猛烈的怒氣結束了平靜的談判。
A foudroyant flash crossed the dark valley. 一道如閃電般的強光劃過黑暗山谷。

meaning: 弗韋泰；芭蕾舞中抬腿旋轉的鞭轉動作
sentences: Fouette requires balance while the raised leg snaps outward. 弗韋泰要求舞者在抬腿向外甩動時保持平衡。
Her fouette carried the solo across the stage. 她的鞭轉動作帶著獨舞穿過舞台。

meaning: 富加德；埋設在地面下的爆炸裝置
sentences: Fougade once protected a narrow military pass. 富加德曾用來守衛狹窄的軍事通道。
The engineers removed the fougade before reopening the road. 工兵移除富加德後才重新開放道路。

meaning: 普羅旺斯格子麵包；也指一種地雷式爆炸物
sentences: Fougasse filled the bakery with the smell of olive oil. 普羅旺斯格子麵包讓麵包店充滿橄欖油香。
We shared warm fougasse with the soup. 我們把溫熱的格子麵包配湯分享。

meaning: 「戰鬥、爭鬥」的過去式與過去分詞
sentences: Veterans who had fought returned before sunrise. 參戰老兵在日出前回來了。
They fought for equal access to clean water. 他們為平等取得乾淨用水而奮鬥。

meaning: 戰鬥過的；已爭鬥的（古語）
sentences: Foughten fields lay silent after the siege. 經歷戰鬥的田野在圍城後一片寂靜。
The foughten captain lowered his worn banner. 那名久經戰鬥的隊長放下破舊旗幟。

meaning: 好鬥的；勇於戰鬥的（方言）
sentences: Foughty villagers defended the bridge all night. 好鬥的村民整夜守衛橋梁。
Her foughty spirit lifted the tired team. 她勇於戰鬥的精神振奮了疲憊的隊伍。

meaning: 印度歷史上的地方軍政官；司法長官
sentences: Foujdar supervised order in the provincial district. 地方軍政官負責維持省區秩序。
The record names a foujdar who guarded the trade road. 紀錄提到一名守護商道的軍政官。

meaning: 地方軍政官的管轄權或職位
sentences: Foujdary covered several villages along the river. 軍政官的管轄區涵蓋河邊幾個村莊。
The new ruler reorganized the foujdary. 新統治者重整了地方軍政管轄權。

meaning: 惡劣的、犯規
sentences: The game was cancelled due to the foul weather and heavy rain. 比賽因惡劣的天氣和大雨而取消。
He was penalized for a foul during the final minutes of the match. 他因在比賽最後幾分鐘犯規而受到處罰。

meaning: 踩壓或揉製布料的工序
sentences: Foulage softened the wool before it was dyed. 踩壓工序在染色前使羊毛變柔軟。
The mill added water during foulage. 工坊在揉製布料時加了水。

meaning: 輕薄平紋或斜紋絲綢；絲質印花布
sentences: Foulard scarves brightened the small market stall. 絲質印花圍巾讓小攤位明亮起來。
She tied a blue foulard around her hat. 她把藍色絲巾綁在帽子上。

meaning: 犯規者；使事物變髒的人或物
sentences: Fouler received a penalty after the dangerous tackle. 犯規者因危險鏟球受到處罰。
The river’s fouler was fined for dumping waste. 讓河流變髒的人因傾倒廢物被罰款。

meaning: 污垢沉積；結垢；弄髒或阻塞
sentences: Fouling reduced the boiler’s efficiency. 結垢降低了鍋爐效率。
Regular cleaning prevents fouling inside the pipe. 定期清潔能防止管內污垢堆積。

meaning: 骯髒的；令人厭惡的
sentences: Foulish water spilled from the cracked drain. 骯髒的水從裂開的排水管流出。
A foulish odor filled the abandoned room. 令人厭惡的氣味充滿了廢棄房間。

meaning: 以一種骯髒的方式。如何用犯規造句
sentences: Writers use foully to mean in a foul manner. How to use foully in a sentence. 作家們用「followly」來表示「以一種骯髒的方式」的意思。如何在句子中使用犯規。
She acted foully when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她做出了惡劣的行為。

meaning: 滿口髒話的；說話粗俗冒犯的
sentences: Foulmouthed callers were removed from the broadcast. 滿口髒話的來電者被節目移除。
The usually calm player became foulmouthed after the loss. 那名平時冷靜的球員落敗後說起了粗話。

meaning: 用粗話地；以冒犯性語言地
sentences: Foulmouthedly, the heckler interrupted every speaker. 那名滿口粗話的鬧場者不斷打斷每位講者。
He answered foulmouthedly instead of explaining the mistake. 他沒有解釋錯誤，反而用粗話回應。

meaning: 滿口髒話；說話粗俗冒犯的特質
sentences: Foulmouthedness made the interview difficult to continue. 滿口髒話讓訪談難以繼續。
The coach warned that foulmouthedness would hurt team trust. 教練警告，粗俗冒犯的言語會傷害團隊信任。

meaning: 污穢；令人厭惡或不潔的狀態
sentences: Foulness spread through the room after the drain backed up. 排水管回堵後，污穢散滿房間。
The inspector noted the foulness of the stagnant water. 檢查員記下了死水的污濁程度。

meaning: 令人厭惡的；污穢難聞的
sentences: Foulsome smoke drifted from the blocked chimney. 令人厭惡的煙從堵塞的煙囪飄出。
The foulsome smell drove everyone outdoors. 那股污穢難聞的氣味把所有人都逼到戶外。

meaning: 歐洲雞貂；一種小型鼬科動物
sentences: Foumart tracks crossed the muddy path at dawn. 歐洲雞貂的足跡在黎明時穿過泥路。
The keeper released the rescued foumart at dusk. 照護員在黃昏時放走獲救的歐洲雞貂。

meaning: 泉水；水源（方言）
sentences: Foun supplied the village during the dry month. 這處泉水在乾旱月份供應村子用水。
Children rested beside the cool foun. 孩子們在清涼的水源旁休息。

meaning: 成立
sentences: The company was founded in 1995 by a group of young engineers. 這家公司於 1995 年由一群年輕工程師創立。
They finally found the lost keys under the sofa in the living room. 他們最終在客廳沙發下找到了丟失的鑰匙。

meaning: 基礎
sentences: Education is the most powerful foundation for a successful future. 教育是成功未來最強大的基礎。
The charity foundation aims to provide help to poor children lately. 該慈善基金會（基礎）最近旨在為貧困兒童提供幫助。

meaning: 基礎的；構成根本的
sentences: Foundational skills support every later lesson. 基礎技能支撐之後的每一課。
Trust is foundational to a lasting partnership. 信任是長久合作的根本。

meaning: 在根本上；就基礎而言
sentences: Foundationally, the two plans share the same aim. 就根本而言，兩個計畫有相同目標。
The proposal is foundationally sound but costly. 這項提案在根本上可行，但成本高。

meaning: 基金會的；與基金或創辦基礎有關的
sentences: Foundationary grants kept the rural clinic open. 基金會的補助讓鄉村診所維持營運。
The foundationary charter set out the school’s purpose. 基金會章程訂出了學校宗旨。

meaning: 有穩固基礎的；已奠基的
sentences: Foundationed walls resisted the river flood. 有穩固基礎的牆抵擋住河水泛濫。
A foundationed settlement grew around the spring. 一座已奠基的聚落在泉水周圍發展。

meaning: 受基金或學校創辦基金支持的人
sentences: Foundationers received housing through the old college fund. 受基金支持的人透過舊學院基金取得住房。
Each foundationer thanked the donors at the ceremony. 每位受助者都在典禮上感謝捐助者。

meaning: 缺乏基礎：毫無根據
sentences: The specimen looked foundationless under the bright lab light. 在明亮的實驗室燈光下，這個標本看起來毫無基礎。
An unusually foundationless figure stood at the center of the design. 一個異常無基礎的人物站在設計的中心。

meaning: 沒有基礎；缺乏根據
sentences: Foundationlessness made the rumor easy to dismiss. 缺乏根據讓那則謠言很容易被駁回。
The judge criticized the claim’s foundationlessness. 法官批評那項主張毫無根據。

meaning: 創辦人
sentences: The company was established in 1995 by its brilliant young founder. 公司於 1995 年由其才華橫溢的年輕創辦人創立。
He is the founder of a leading non-profit organization in the city. 他是一家市內領先非營利組織的創辦人。

meaning: 會使人或物下陷的；泥濘危險的
sentences: Founderous ground trapped the wagon wheel. 會下陷的泥地卡住了車輪。
The founderous marsh forced the walkers onto the ridge. 危險泥濘的沼澤迫使行人走上山脊。

meaning: 創辦人的身分或職位
sentences: Foundership brought both recognition and responsibility. 創辦人的身分帶來肯定，也帶來責任。

meaning: 鑄造廠；鑄造業
sentences: Foundery workers poured iron into narrow molds. 鑄造廠工人把鐵液倒入狹窄模具。
The old foundery closed when fuel prices rose. 燃料價格上升後，老鑄造廠關閉了。

meaning: 創立的；建立中的
sentences: Founding members signed the society’s first charter. 創立成員簽署了協會的第一份章程。
The founding meeting lasted until midnight. 創立會議持續到午夜。

meaning: 棄嬰；被遺棄後發現的嬰兒
sentences: Foundling was cared for by the village nurse. 那名棄嬰由村裡的護士照顧。
The foundling later grew up in a loving home. 那名棄嬰後來在充滿愛的家庭中長大。

meaning: 女性創辦人
sentences: Foundress established the shelter after the flood. 那位女性創辦人在洪水後成立了收容中心。
The foundress’s portrait hangs near the entrance. 女性創辦人的肖像掛在入口附近。

meaning: 鑄造金屬的行為、過程或藝術；創立。
sentences: The term foundry refers to the act, process, or art of casting metals; founding. 鑄造廠一詞是指鑄造金屬的行為、過程或藝術；創立。
The lesson introduced foundry as a useful term to understand. 本課程介紹了鑄造廠作為一個需要理解的有用術語。

meaning: 鑄造工人
sentences: Foundryman shaped hot metal beside the furnace. 鑄造工人在熔爐旁加工熾熱金屬。
A foundryman repaired the cracked mold. 一名鑄造工人修好了裂開的模具。

meaning: 泉源；來源；豐富供應
sentences: Fount fed the gardens below the hill. 泉源供水給山丘下的花園。
Her kindness became a fount of comfort for neighbors. 她的善意成了鄰人獲得安慰的來源。

meaning: 噴泉
sentences: The children were happily playing near the fountain in the park. 孩子們正在公園噴泉附近開心地玩耍。
The city center is famous for its beautiful historical fountains. 市中心以其美麗的歷史噴泉而聞名。

meaning: 鋼筆
sentences: Fountain pens leave a smooth line on good paper. 鋼筆在好紙上留下流暢的線條。
His fountain pen leaked ink inside the case. 他的鋼筆在筆盒裡漏了墨水。

meaning: 有泉水的；由泉水供給的
sentences: Fountained courtyards stayed cool through the afternoon. 有泉水的庭院整個下午都很涼爽。

meaning: 噴泉管理員；負責維護噴泉的人
sentences: Fountaineers cleaned the stone basin each morning. 噴泉管理員每天早上清洗石盆。
A fountaineer adjusted the hidden water valve. 一名管理員調整了隱藏的水閥。

meaning: 源頭；根本來源
sentences: Fountainhead of the stream lies beneath the cedar grove. 這條溪流的源頭在雪松林下方。
Curiosity was the fountainhead of her research. 好奇心是她研究的根本來源。

meaning: 沒有水源。如何用被動造句
sentences: The specimen looked fountainless under the bright lab light. 在明亮的實驗室燈光下，該標本看起來毫無泉水。
An unusually fountainless figure stood at the center of the design. 一個異常無噴泉的人物矗立在設計的中心。

meaning: 小噴泉；小泉
sentences: Fountainlet bubbled beside the walking path. 小噴泉在步道旁汩汩作響。

meaning: 像噴泉的；泉水豐富的；大量湧出的
sentences: Fountainous water rose from the cracked hillside. 大量湧出的水從裂開的山坡升起。

meaning: 如噴泉般地；大量湧出地
sentences: Fountainously, the spring spilled over its stone rim. 泉水大量湧出，溢過石頭邊緣。
Ideas flowed fountainously during the discussion. 討論期間，想法如噴泉般不斷湧出。

meaning: 以噴泉般的方式；像泉水般地
sentences: Fountainwise, the water rose before falling in silver threads. 水以噴泉般的方式升起，再化成銀色水絲落下。
She arranged the lights fountainwise around the statue. 她把燈光以噴泉般的形狀排列在雕像周圍。

meaning: 充滿泉水的；泉源豐富的
sentences: Fountful valleys kept the pasture green all summer. 泉源豐富的山谷讓牧場整個夏天保持翠綠。
The fountful spring never dried during the drought. 這座泉水充沛的泉眼在旱季也沒有乾涸。

meaning: 福桂樹科的；與福桂樹科植物有關的
sentences: Fouquieriaceous shrubs thrive in the desert heat. 福桂樹科灌木在沙漠高溫中茂盛生長。
A fouquieriaceous stem stores water beneath its bark. 一根福桂樹科植物的莖在樹皮下儲存水分。

meaning: 四；四個

meaning: 四倍的；四倍地

meaning: 各臂末端分叉的；四叉的

A fourcher held the branches apart during repair. 一個叉狀構件在修理時撐開枝條。

The clinician checked the fourchette for irritation. 臨床人員檢查了外陰後方皺襞是否受刺激。

meaning: 四叉狀礦物或岩石的名稱

meaning: 四人組中的成員；四人制比賽者

meaning: 吹噓者；虛張聲勢的人
sentences: Fourflusher boasted about wealth he did not possess. 那個吹噓者吹擂自己並不存在的財富。
The card players quickly exposed the fourflusher. 紙牌玩家很快拆穿了那個虛張聲勢的人。

meaning: 四倍的；四重的；四倍地
sentences: Fourfold increase would strain the water supply. 四倍的增加會讓供水系統吃不消。
The emblem has a fourfold design. 這枚徽章有四重設計。

meaning: 四個一組的個體；四重孿晶

The biologist recorded a fourling birth. 生物學家記錄了一次四胞胎出生。

meaning: 四便士的金額
sentences: Fourpence bought a loaf in the old market. 四便士在舊市場能買一條麵包。
The child saved fourpence in a wooden box. 孩子把四便士存進木盒。

meaning: 四便士的；價值四便士的
sentences: Fourpenny nails fixed the thin boards. 四便士的釘子固定了薄木板。
A fourpenny loaf was once common in the village. 四便士的麵包曾在村裡很常見。

meaning: 發射四磅炮彈的火炮
sentences: Fourpounder stood beside the harbor battery. 一門四磅炮彈火炮立在港口砲台旁。
The museum restored a fourpounder from the old fort. 博物館修復了一門舊堡的四磅炮。

meaning: 覆毛的；飾以毛皮的（紋章學）
sentences: Fourre shields displayed a soft heraldic texture. 覆毛的盾牌呈現柔軟的紋章質感。
The fourre border contrasted with the metal crown. 毛皮飾邊與金屬皇冠形成對比。

meaning: 先驅；前導者
sentences: Fourrier arrived before the main expedition. 先驅在主要探險隊之前抵達。
Her invention became a fourrier for cleaner transport. 她的發明成了清潔運輸的先導。

meaning: 八十；八十個
sentences: Fourscore villagers gathered for the harvest feast. 八十位村民聚集參加收穫宴。
The poem remembers fourscore years of peace. 詩中追憶八十年的和平。

meaning: 四人一組；四個一組的團體
sentences: Foursome crossed the lake in a narrow boat. 四人一組乘著窄船渡湖。
Our foursome shared one table near the window. 我們四人一組坐在窗邊同一張桌子。

meaning: 四方的；坦率正直的
sentences: Foursquare walls enclosed the old courtyard. 四方形的牆圍住了老庭院。

meaning: 直接地；坦率正直地；以四方形地
sentences: Foursquarely, the mayor accepted responsibility for the delay. 市長坦率地承擔了延誤責任。
The tiles were laid foursquarely across the floor. 磁磚以整齊方正的方式鋪滿地板。

meaning: 方正；坦率正直
sentences: Foursquareness gave the courtyard a calm order. 方正讓庭院呈現平靜的秩序。
His foursquareness made the contract easy to trust. 他的坦率正直讓人容易信任這份合約。

meaning: 四股的；由四股纖維或線繩組成的

meaning: 十四；十四個

meaning: 十四音節詩行；特指七個抑揚格的詩行

The poet shaped the refrain as a fourteener. 詩人把副歌寫成十四音節詩行。

meaning: 十四倍的；十四倍地
sentences: Fourteenfold demand emptied the small warehouse. 十四倍的需求清空了小倉庫。
The compound became fourteenfold stronger after curing. 這種化合物固化後強了十四倍。

meaning: 第十四的；第十四個
sentences: Fourteenth place still earned a warm welcome. 第十四名仍獲得熱烈歡迎。
Her fourteenth birthday fell on a rainy Sunday. 她的十四歲生日落在下雨的星期日。

meaning: 第十四地；列為第十四項
sentences: Fourteenthly, the notice explains how appeals are filed. 第十四項說明了如何提出申訴。
The speaker addressed the final issue fourteenthly. 講者把最後一項問題列為第十四項處理。

meaning: 第四的；四分之一
sentences: Fourth place went to the youngest runner. 第四名由最年輕的跑者獲得。
She poured a fourth of the milk into the bowl. 她把四分之一的牛奶倒進碗裡。

meaning: 第四部分；四分之一（古語）
sentences: Fourther was assigned to the tenant under the old rule. 按照舊規定，第四部分分給了佃農。
The ledger lists one fourther of the annual harvest. 帳簿列出全年收成的四分之一。

meaning: 第四位
sentences: Writers use fourthly to mean in the fourth place. 作家用「fourthirity」來表示「第四位」。
She acted fourthly when the situation demanded it. 第四，當情況需要時，她採取了行動。

meaning: 馬達加斯加果子狸的另一拼法
sentences: Foussa crossed the forest floor without a sound. 馬達加斯加果子狸無聲地穿過森林地面。
The guide described foussa as a skilled climber. 解說員形容這種動物很會爬樹。

meaning: 胡鬧；無聊事（方言）
sentences: Foute delayed the workers when the bridge needed repair. 橋梁需要修理時，胡鬧耽誤了工人。
The elder dismissed the argument as foute. 長者把那場爭論斥為無聊事。

meaning: 無價值的東西；無聊的人或事
sentences: Fouter was all the trader could offer for the broken tool. 那名商人只能拿無價值的東西交換壞工具。
The critic called the boastful speech fouter. 評論家稱那篇自誇演說毫無價值。

meaning: 豐富；大量（方言）
sentences: Fouth of berries covered the hillside in late summer. 夏末時，大量莓果覆蓋山坡。
The stream carried fouth after the storm. 暴風雨後，溪流帶來大量水流。

meaning: 中央凹；視網膜中負責清晰視覺的小凹陷
sentences: Fovea provides the sharpest part of central vision. 中央凹提供中央視野中最清晰的部分。
An eye scan showed a healthy fovea. 眼睛掃描顯示中央凹健康。

meaning: 中央凹的；與中央凹有關的
sentences: Foveal vision lets readers distinguish tiny letters. 中央凹視覺讓讀者分辨細小字母。
The doctor measured foveal thickness with a scan. 醫師用掃描測量中央凹厚度。

meaning: 有凹陷的；具有中央凹的
sentences: Foveate scales covered the lizard’s back. 有凹陷的鱗片覆蓋蜥蜴背部。
The insect has a foveate surface under each wing. 這種昆蟲每片翅膀下都有凹陷表面。

meaning: 有中央凹的；呈凹陷狀的
sentences: Foveated tissue surrounded the small opening. 有中央凹的組織包圍著小開口。
The foveated stone reflected a dull pattern. 呈凹陷狀的石頭反射出暗淡圖案。

meaning: 使視線落在中央凹的動作；中央凹定位
sentences: Foveation shifts the clearest part of vision onto a chosen detail. 中央凹定位會把最清晰的視覺部分移到選定細節上。
The device tracks foveation during reading. 這台裝置追蹤閱讀時的中央凹定位。

meaning: 中央凹狀的；像小凹陷的
sentences: Foveiform spots marked the surface of the petal. 中央凹狀斑點標記著花瓣表面。
A foveiform hollow appeared in the soft clay. 一個小凹陷狀的空洞出現在軟黏土裡。

meaning: 小凹窩；視網膜中央凹中的小凹點
sentences: Foveola lies at the center of the retinal pit. 小凹點位於視網膜凹陷的中心。
A clear image revealed the foveola. 清晰影像顯示了小凹點。

meaning: 與小凹窩或中央凹有關的
sentences: Foveolarious tissue formed a ring around the opening. 與小凹窩有關的組織在開口周圍形成一圈。
The foveolarious pattern appeared under magnification. 放大後看見了這種小凹窩狀圖案。

meaning: 有小凹窩的；布滿細小凹點的

The foveolate surface felt rough beneath a finger. 布滿細小凹點的表面摸起來粗糙。

meaning: 有細小凹窩的；呈小凹點狀的
sentences: Foveolated petals gave the flower a dotted texture. 有細小凹窩的花瓣讓花朵呈現點狀質感。
The foveolated stone came from the riverbed. 那塊呈小凹點狀的石頭來自河床。

meaning: 小凹窩；細小凹點
sentences: Foveole appeared where the surface had dried unevenly. 表面不均勻乾燥後出現了小凹窩。
A foveole caught a speck of pollen. 一個細小凹點接住了一粒花粉。

meaning: 極小的凹窩
sentences: Foveolet was barely visible on the seed coat. 種皮上的極小凹窩幾乎看不見。

meaning: 滿的；充足的（方言拼法）

The pantry was fow before the winter began. 冬天開始前，食品櫃已經裝得很滿。

meaning: 人們；民眾（蘇格蘭方言）

Island fowk welcomed the visiting musicians. 島民歡迎來訪的音樂家。

meaning: 家禽、禽肉

Wild fowl can be seen clearly near the small mountain lake at sunset. 日落時分，在山間小湖附近可以清楚地看到野禽。

meaning: 獵捕野鳥的人
sentences: Fowler watched the marsh before dawn. 捕鳥獵人在黎明前觀察沼澤。
The ranger warned every fowler about the protected birds. 護林員提醒每位捕鳥獵人注意受保護鳥類。

meaning: 含鋅薔薇輝石組成的礦物
sentences: Fowlerite showed a pink sheen under the lamp. 方解石礦在燈下呈現粉紅光澤。

meaning: 家禽舍；養鳥的棚舍
sentences: Fowlery stood behind the farmhouse with a wire door. 家禽舍立在農舍後方，裝著鐵絲門。
The farmer cleaned the fowlery before feeding the hens. 農夫餵母雞前先清理家禽舍。

meaning: 鳥足草；花形或葉形像鳥腳的植物
sentences: Fowlfoot spread low across the damp meadow. 鳥足草低低地蔓延在潮濕草地上。

meaning: 捕獵野鳥
sentences: Fowling was restricted during the nesting season. 繁殖季期間禁止捕獵野鳥。

meaning: 狐狸

meaning: 狼毒；一種烏頭屬有毒植物
sentences: Foxbane grows in cool mountain meadows. 狼毒生長在涼爽的高山草地。

sentences: Foxberry covered the rocky slope with red fruit. 熊果以紅色果實覆蓋岩坡。

meaning: 狐狸的下顎；狐狸下巴（方言）
sentences: Foxchop appeared in the old hunter’s glossary. 舊獵人詞彙表裡收錄了狐狸下顎這個說法。
The carving showed a foxchop beneath the animal’s snout. 雕刻在動物吻部下方刻出狐狸下巴。

meaning: 修理鞋子或橡膠製品的工人
sentences: Foxer repaired the torn rubber boots before the hike. 修鞋與橡膠製品的工人先修好了遠足用的破靴。

meaning: 狡猾的行為；詭計
sentences: Foxery helped the small trader escape an unfair fee. 詭計幫助小商人避開不公平的費用。

meaning: 狐足石松；一種石松科植物
sentences: Foxfeet spread across the shaded forest floor. 狐足石松蔓延在陰暗的森林地面。
A plant collector once pressed foxfeet between paper sheets. 一位植物收藏家曾把狐足石松壓在紙張之間。

meaning: 毛地黃的別名
sentences: Foxfinger blooms beside the cottage wall in early summer. 毛地黃在初夏於小屋牆邊開花。

meaning: 歐洲豹䱛；一種小型海魚
sentences: Foxfish hid among the pebbles in the shallow bay. 歐洲豹䱛躲在淺灣的卵石間。

meaning: 毛地黃；一種開管狀花的有毒植物
sentences: Foxglove rose above the cottage garden. 毛地黃高高長在小屋花園裡。

meaning: 散兵坑；為躲避火力而挖的坑
sentences: Foxhole sheltered the medic during the bombardment. 炮火攻擊時，散兵坑掩護了醫護兵。

meaning: 獵狐犬
sentences: The family adopted a foxhound from the shelter. 這家人從收容所領養了一隻獵狐犬。
A foxhound slept beside the sofa all afternoon. 一隻獵狐犬整個下午睡在沙發旁。

meaning: 以狡猾的方式：狡猾地，狡猾地
sentences: Writers use foxily to mean in a foxy manner: craftily, trickily. 作家們用「以狡猾的方式：狡猾地，狡猾地」來表示「狡猾」的意思：狡猾的、狡猾的。

meaning: 狐狸般的狡猾；狡黠
sentences: Foxiness helped the cub avoid the trap. 狐狸般的狡猾幫助幼狐避開陷阱。
Her foxiness showed in the way she negotiated. 她談判時展現出狡黠。

meaning: 紙張因老化形成的褐色斑點
sentences: Foxing speckled the pages of the nineteenth-century map. 紙張老化形成的褐斑點點散布在十九世紀地圖上。

meaning: 像狐狸的；狡猾的
sentences: Foxish eyes watched from behind the hedge. 像狐狸的眼睛從樹籬後觀察著。

meaning: 防狐狸的；能防止狐狸侵入的

meaning: 狐狸般的狡猾或機敏
sentences: Foxship allowed the animal to slip through the narrow gap. 狐狸般的機敏讓那隻動物穿過狹窄縫隙。

meaning: 狐皮；狐狸的皮毛
sentences: Foxskin lined the hood of the old winter coat. 狐皮襯在那件老冬衣的帽緣裡。

meaning: 狐尾；狐尾草等外形似狐尾的植物
sentences: Foxtail brushed against the bicycle wheels. 狐尾草擦過自行車輪。

A sharp froe split thin shingles cleanly. 鋒利的劈木工具俐落地把木塊劈成薄木瓦。

meaning: 青蛙
sentences: We could hear the sound of frogs from the pond at night. 我們晚上可以聽到池塘傳來的青蛙叫聲。
The little boy caught a green frog in the garden. 小男孩在花園裡抓到了一隻綠色的青蛙。

meaning: 歐洲的一種水生漂浮植物
sentences: Frogbit covered the pond with round floating leaves. 青蛙葉用圓形浮葉覆蓋池塘。
White flowers rose above the frogbit in midsummer. 盛夏時，白花從青蛙葉上方探出。

meaning: 吃青蛙的動物
sentences: The heron is a patient frogeater at the marsh edge. 那隻鷺鳥是沼澤邊耐心的食蛙動物。
A frogeater waited motionless beside the reeds. 一隻食蛙動物在蘆葦旁一動不動地等待。

meaning: 植物葉片上的一種真菌性斑點病
sentences: Frogeye appeared as dark rings on the apple leaves. 青蛙眼病在蘋果葉上形成深色環斑。
The farmer removed infected leaves to slow frogeye. 農夫移除染病葉片以減緩青蛙眼病。

meaning: 像青蛙的臉；鼻子因息肉而變寬的臉
sentences: The mask gave the actor a comic frogface. 面具讓演員有一張滑稽的青蛙臉。
The old medical text used frogface for a broadened nose. 古老醫書用這個詞描述鼻子變寬的臉。

meaning: 躄魚科的魚；鮟鱇類的一種俗稱
sentences: A frogfish hid among the sponges on the reef. 一條躄魚躲在礁石海綿之間。
The diver nearly missed the camouflaged frogfish. 潛水員差點沒看見偽裝起來的躄魚。

meaning: 蛙花屬的一種植物
sentences: The frogflower opened beside the shallow stream. 蛙花在淺溪旁綻放。
Gardeners grew frogflower in a damp garden bed. 園丁在潮濕花圃中培育蛙花。

meaning: 蛙足狀的植物或構造
sentences: The herb’s frogfoot leaves spread over the wet soil. 這種草本的蛙足狀葉片鋪展在濕土上。
A frogfoot pattern decorated the pottery. 蛙足圖樣裝飾著陶器。

meaning: 以蛙扣裝飾或固定的
sentences: The frogged jacket closed with decorative loops. 那件有蛙扣的外套用裝飾繩圈扣合。
He wore a frogged coat for the historical parade. 他穿著有蛙扣的外套參加歷史遊行。

meaning: 青蛙群；青蛙繁多的地方
sentences: The wet meadow became a noisy froggery after rain. 雨後的濕草地成了吵鬧的青蛙聚集地。
Children watched the froggery from the safe bank. 孩子們從安全的河岸觀看那群青蛙。

meaning: 像青蛙的特質或氣味
sentences: The pond’s frogginess increased on warm evenings. 溫暖的夜晚讓池塘的青蛙氣息更明顯。
A green costume gave the play deliberate frogginess. 綠色戲服讓這齣戲刻意帶有青蛙般的趣味。

meaning: 以蛙扣裝飾的；與青蛙有關的
sentences: Frogging loops ran down the front of the uniform. 蛙扣繩圈沿著制服前襟排列。
The tailor used frogging to emphasize the coat’s military style. 裁縫用蛙扣裝飾突顯外套的軍服風格。

meaning: 像青蛙的；具有青蛙特徵的
sentences: A froggish croak came from the shaded ditch. 陰暗水溝裡傳來像青蛙的呱呱聲。
The puppet’s froggish eyes made the children laugh. 木偶的青蛙般眼睛逗得孩子們大笑。

meaning: 青蛙多的；像青蛙的
sentences: The froggy pond echoed beneath the moon. 青蛙很多的池塘在月光下回響著叫聲。
His froggy voice suited the cartoon character. 他像青蛙般的聲音很適合那個卡通角色。

meaning: 青蛙的特性或狀態
sentences: The children explored froghood through songs and drawings. 孩子們透過歌曲和畫畫探索青蛙的特性。
The exhibit explains froghood without using live animals. 展覽不用活體動物就說明青蛙的生活。

meaning: 沫蟬；會跳躍的小型昆蟲
sentences: A froghopper sprang from the grass onto my sleeve. 一隻沫蟬從草叢跳到我的袖子上。
The gardener found froghopper nymphs in the foamy nests. 園丁在泡沫巢中找到沫蟬若蟲。

meaning: 青蛙眾多的濕地或地方
sentences: The flooded field became frogland by early summer. 入夏不久，淹水田野成了青蛙之地。
Birds hunted along the edge of frogland. 鳥類在青蛙濕地邊緣覓食。

meaning: 葉片形似青蛙足的植物
sentences: Frogleaf spread its lobed leaves across the mud. 青蛙葉把裂葉鋪展在泥地上。
The pond margin supported a patch of frogleaf. 池塘邊緣長著一片青蛙葉。

meaning: 青蛙腿；青蛙的腿部
sentences: The chef grilled frogleg with garlic and herbs. 廚師用大蒜和香草烤青蛙腿。
Each frogleg was tender after slow cooking. 每隻青蛙腿慢煮後都很嫩。

meaning: 小青蛙；剛由蝌蚪變態完成的幼蛙
sentences: A froglet left the pond after losing its tail. 一隻小青蛙尾巴消失後離開池塘。
The child gently returned the froglet to the reeds. 孩子輕輕把小青蛙放回蘆葦叢。

meaning: 像青蛙的
sentences: The sculpture has a wide, froglike mouth. 這座雕像有一張寬大的青蛙般嘴巴。
Froglike eyes peered from the green helmet. 青蛙般的眼睛從綠色頭盔裡望出來。

meaning: 小青蛙；幼蛙
sentences: A frogling hid beneath the broad leaf. 一隻小青蛙躲在寬大的葉子下。
The pond sheltered dozens of frogling survivors. 池塘庇護了幾十隻倖存的小幼蛙。

meaning: 蛙人；能長時間在水下活動的人
sentences: The frogman inspected the damaged pier underwater. 蛙人在水下檢查受損的碼頭。
A trained frogman carried the marker to shore. 受過訓練的蛙人把標記帶回岸上。

meaning: 南亞至澳洲的寬嘴鳥類，與夜鷹有親緣關係
sentences: A frogmouth rested quietly on a branch. 一隻蛙嘴鳥安靜地停在樹枝上。
The frogmouth opened its wide bill at dusk. 那隻蛙嘴鳥在黃昏時張開寬嘴。

meaning: 像青蛙鼻子的寬扁鼻子
sentences: The caricature exaggerated the hero’s frognose. 這幅漫畫誇張了英雄寬扁的青蛙鼻。
The old description calls the broad tip a frognose. 古老描述把寬大的鼻尖稱為青蛙鼻。

meaning: 一美元鈔票的俚稱
sentences: The musician slipped a frogskin into the tip jar. 音樂家把一張一美元鈔票塞進小費罐。
He had only one frogskin left for the bus. 他只剩一張一美元鈔票搭公車。

meaning: 傘菌；有傘狀菌蓋的真菌
sentences: A frogstool rose from the damp log overnight. 一朵傘菌一夜之間從潮濕木頭上長出。
The child learned not to touch an unknown frogstool. 孩子學會不去碰不認識的傘菌。

meaning: 蛙舌狀的植物或構造
sentences: The wetland plant has a long frogtongue leaf. 這種濕地植物有一片長長的蛙舌狀葉子。
A frogtongue shape appeared in the carved emblem. 雕刻徽章上出現蛙舌形狀。

meaning: 蛙草屬植物的俗稱
sentences: Frogwort grew among rushes at the pond’s edge. 蛙草長在池塘邊的燈心草之間。
A gardener pressed frogwort leaves for the herbarium. 園丁把蛙草葉壓製後放入植物標本館。

meaning: 厚而大的煎餅，常與培根同食
sentences: The inn served a hot froise with crisp bacon. 小旅店端上熱騰騰的厚煎餅和香脆培根。
A single froise was enough for the hungry traveler. 一張厚煎餅就足以餵飽飢餓的旅人。

meaning: 嬉戲；歡快玩耍
sentences: Puppies frolic in the shallow stream each afternoon. 小狗每天午後都在淺溪裡嬉戲。
The dancers frolic across the stage during the finale. 舞者在結尾時歡快地跑過舞台。

meaning: 喜愛嬉戲的；活潑的
sentences: The frolicful children filled the garden with laughter. 活潑愛玩的孩子讓花園充滿笑聲。
A frolicful puppy tugged at the loose shoelace. 一隻愛嬉戲的小狗拉著鬆開的鞋帶。

meaning: 嬉戲者；愛玩鬧的人或動物
sentences: The young frolicker splashed through every puddle. 那個愛玩鬧的孩子踩過每一個水窪。
A frolicker rolled down the grassy hill laughing. 一名嬉戲者笑著滾下草坡。

meaning: 活潑嬉戲的
sentences: Her frolicky mood spread through the quiet room. 她活潑嬉戲的情緒感染了安靜的房間。
The frolicky lamb chased a leaf in the yard. 活潑的小羊在院子裡追逐一片葉子。

meaning: 嬉戲地；歡快地
sentences: The foals ran frolicly around the paddock. 小馬駒歡快地在圍欄裡奔跑。
Children danced frolicly beneath the paper lanterns. 孩子們在紙燈籠下嬉戲起舞。

meaning: 嬉戲歡快的特質
sentences: The foal’s frolicness delighted everyone nearby. 小馬駒的嬉戲活力讓附近所有人都很開心。
Music brought frolicness back to the tired dancers. 音樂讓疲憊的舞者重新恢復歡快。

meaning: 充滿歡樂、俏皮好動的
sentences: The frolicsome puppy overturned the empty basket. 那隻俏皮好動的小狗打翻了空籃子。
A frolicsome tune made the audience clap along. 一首歡快的曲子讓觀眾跟著拍手。

meaning: 歡快嬉戲地
sentences: The children moved frolicsomely through the orchard. 孩子們歡快地穿過果園。
She waved frolicsomely from the bright float. 她在鮮豔花車上開心地揮手。

meaning: 歡快俏皮的特質
sentences: The song’s frolicsomeness suited the sunny scene. 歌曲的歡快俏皮很適合晴朗場景。
His frolicsomeness eased the tension before dinner. 他的活潑歡快減輕了晚餐前的緊張。

meaning: 從
sentences: Where are you from? I'm from Taiwan. 你從哪裡來？我來自台灣。
It takes about thirty minutes to walk from my house to the office. 從我家走路到辦公室大約需要 30 分鐘。

meaning: 向後；離開某處
sentences: The old path bends fromward after the bridge. 老路過橋後向外彎離。
She stepped fromward when the gate opened. 大門打開時，她向後退開。

meaning: 遠離：遠離
sentences: Writers use fromwards to mean away from: away. 作家用 遠離：遠離 來表示遠離：遠離。
She acted fromwards when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她就採取了行動。

meaning: 蕨類或棕櫚等植物的大型葉片
sentences: A palm frond shaded the child from the sun. 一片棕櫚葉替孩子遮住陽光。
The fern unfurled a new frond after the rain. 蕨類在雨後展開一片新葉。

meaning: 葉片的集合；繁茂葉叢
sentences: Dense frondage hid the stream from the path. 茂密葉叢把溪流遮離小徑。
Birds nested safely within the tropical frondage. 鳥兒在熱帶葉叢中安全築巢。

meaning: 長有大型葉片的；有葉狀體的
sentences: Fronded palms lined the entrance to the resort. 長著大葉片的棕櫚樹排列在度假村入口。
The fronded plant needs bright but indirect light. 這種有大葉片的植物需要明亮但非直射的光線。

meaning: 長有葉片的；多葉的
sentences: Frondent branches covered the garden wall. 多葉的枝條覆蓋了花園圍牆。
A frondent fern spread across the shaded bank. 一叢多葉蕨類蔓延在陰暗河岸。

meaning: 長出葉片；開始展葉
sentences: The young trees frondesce when spring warms the soil. 春天使土壤變暖時，幼樹開始展葉。
Vines frondesce quickly after the first summer rain. 夏季第一場雨後，藤蔓很快長出葉片。

meaning: 植物展開葉片的時期或狀態
sentences: Frondescence began along the valley in early April. 四月初，山谷各處開始展葉。
The garden’s frondescence made the paths feel enclosed. 花園的葉片展開後，小徑彷彿被包圍起來。

meaning: 正在展葉的；長出葉片的
sentences: Frondescent branches turned the bare hedge green. 正在展葉的枝條讓光禿籬笆變綠。
The frondescent forest welcomed the returning birds. 正在展葉的森林迎來回歸的鳥群。

meaning: 長有葉狀體或大片葉片的
sentences: Frondiferous plants thrive beside the shaded spring. 長有大片葉片的植物在陰涼泉水旁茂盛生長。
The frondiferous species formed a dense green border. 這種多葉植物形成濃密的綠色邊界。

meaning: 葉片形的；呈葉狀的
sentences: The carved panel has a delicate frondiform ridge. 雕刻板上有一道精緻的葉狀脊。
A frondiform ornament decorated the silver bowl. 一個葉形飾物裝飾著銀碗。

meaning: 帶有葉狀體的；長葉的
sentences: Frondigerous stems rose from the wet ground. 帶有葉狀體的莖從濕地長起。
The frondigerous plant made a useful natural screen. 這種長葉植物形成實用的天然屏障。

meaning: 以葉片為食的
sentences: Frondivorous insects stripped the young branches overnight. 以葉片為食的昆蟲一夜之間啃光嫩枝。
The frondivorous caterpillar preferred tender fern leaves. 這種食葉毛毛蟲偏好嫩蕨葉。

meaning: 小葉片；小型葉狀體
sentences: A frondlet emerged beside the main fern leaf. 一片小葉從蕨類主葉旁長出。
The gardener measured each frondlet before drying it. 園丁在乾燥前測量每片小葉。

meaning: 葉片繁多的；呈葉狀的
sentences: Frondose growth covered the damp rock face. 繁茂的葉狀植物覆蓋潮濕岩壁。
The frondose ornament looked like a small fern. 那個多葉飾物看起來像一株小蕨類。

meaning: 承載葉狀體：類似葉狀體：葉狀體
sentences: Writers use frondosely to mean bearing fronds: resembling a frond: thalloid. 作家使用 承載葉狀體：類似葉狀體：葉狀體 來表示長有葉狀體：類似葉狀體：葉狀體。
She acted frondosely when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她就會表現得很乖巧。

meaning: 多葉的；像葉片的
sentences: Frondous branches bent over the garden seat. 多葉的枝條彎過花園座椅。
A muralist painted a frondous border around the map. 壁畫家在地圖四周畫上多葉邊框。

meaning: 正面
sentences: Please meet me in front of the cinema at 7:00 p.m. 請晚上七點在電影院門口等我。
He sat in the front row to see the performance clearly. 他坐在第一排以便看清表演。

meaning: 向前方地
sentences: The arrow points frontad along the tunnel. 箭頭朝向隧道前方。
He leaned frontad to read the small inscription. 他向前傾身閱讀小字銘文。

meaning: 建築物面向街道或水面的部分；臨街面
sentences: The shop has generous frontage on the main road. 這家店在主要道路上有寬敞的臨街面。
Trees softened the hotel’s long waterfront frontage. 樹木柔化了飯店漫長的臨水立面。

meaning: 擁有或使用臨街面的人
sentences: Each frontager helped maintain the shared sidewalk. 每位臨街地主都協助維護共用人行道。
The frontager objected to blocking the harbor view. 臨水面使用者反對遮住港口景色。

meaning: 前面的；正面的；額部的
sentences: The frontal pocket holds my travel pass. 前面的口袋放著我的交通卡。
Doctors checked his frontal head injury carefully. 醫生仔細檢查他前額的傷勢。

meaning: 額肌；位於前額的肌肉
sentences: The frontalis lifts the eyebrows during surprise. 驚訝時，額肌會把眉毛抬起。
The therapist massaged the frontalis to ease tension. 治療師按摩額肌以緩解緊繃。

meaning: 正面朝向的構圖或特質
sentences: The portrait’s frontality makes the gaze feel direct. 肖像的正面構圖讓目光顯得直接。
By reducing frontality, the painter created more movement. 畫家降低正面感後，畫面產生更多動態。

meaning: 掛在祭壇前面的一塊布。如何使用額葉造句
sentences: Writers use frontally to mean cloth hanging over the front of an altar. How to use frontal in a sentence. 作家用「掛在祭壇前面的一塊布。如何使用額葉造句」來表示懸掛在祭壇前面的布料。如何在句子中使用額葉。
She acted frontally when the situation demanded it. 當情況需要時，她就會挺身而出。

meaning: 英國議會前座議員；政黨領導階層成員
sentences: The frontbencher answered questions for the opposition. 反對黨前座議員代表黨回答問題。
A senior frontbencher defended the proposed bill. 一名資深前座議員為提案法案辯護。

meaning: 位於前方的；有前面或前額的
sentences: The fronted building faces the busy square. 那棟正面朝向廣場的建築面對繁忙街區。
A fronted verb appears before the subject in this construction. 這種結構中，前置動詞出現在主詞之前。

meaning: 位於前方的人或物；前線人員
sentences: The fronter held the gate while others moved inside. 前方的人守住大門，讓其他人進入。
A skilled fronter can guide the group through crowds. 熟練的前導者能帶領團體穿過人群。

meaning: 國境、新領域
sentences: The river forms a natural frontier between the two neighboring countries. 這條河形成了這兩個鄰國之間的自然邊界（國境）。
Space exploration is considered the final frontier of human discovery. 太空探索被認為是人類發現的最後新領域。

meaning: 像邊疆的；具有前沿特色的
sentences: The frontierlike settlement stood beyond the last railway. 那座邊疆式聚落位於最後一段鐵路之外。
Its frontierlike spirit attracted adventurous families. 它的拓荒氣息吸引了愛冒險的家庭。

meaning: 生活或工作在邊疆的人
sentences: The frontierman knew every trail through the hills. 那名邊疆居民熟悉穿越丘陵的每條小徑。
A frontierman guided the wagon across the pass. 一名邊疆開拓者帶領馬車越過山口。

meaning: 生活或工作在邊疆的人；拓荒者
sentences: The frontiersman built a cabin beside the river. 那名拓荒者在河邊蓋了一間小屋。
A frontiersman traded pelts for salt and tools. 一名邊疆居民用毛皮換取鹽和工具。

meaning: 位於前方的；作為表面或前面的
sentences: Fronting windows caught the morning light. 朝前的窗戶接住晨光。
The fronting wall hides the older structure behind it. 前面的牆遮住了後方較老的結構。

meaning: 以正面朝向地；在前方地
sentences: The statue stands frontingly toward the entrance. 雕像正面朝向入口而立。
She arranged the chairs frontingly for the ceremony. 她把椅子朝前排列以供儀式使用。

meaning: 書籍卷首的插圖或建築物的主要正面
sentences: The book’s frontispiece shows the author’s study. 書籍卷首插圖呈現作者的書房。
An ornate frontispiece framed the entrance of the hall. 華麗的正面裝飾框住大廳入口。

meaning: 厚顏無恥的；沒有正面的
sentences: The frontless remark embarrassed everyone at dinner. 那句厚顏無恥的話讓晚餐桌上的人都尷尬。

meaning: 受到霜凍或凍傷的影響或傷害。如何用凍傷造句

meaning: 磨砂的，覆有霜的

meaning: 結霜物；使某物結霜的人或裝置

meaning: 鱈魚科的一種魚，尤其是湯姆鱈

meaning: 冷淡或冷淡的程度：以冷漠、保守或疏離的方式。如何用 冷漠造句

meaning: 防霜或防凍的處理

meaning: 表面或內部有霜。

meaning: 表示不滿或集中註意力時皺起眉頭。如何用皺眉造句
